text.en: When ANF announced Dorfeuille as its presidential choice in September 2026, the party emphasized his parliamentary experience. The electricity project gives that experience something measurable: a place, a service and an amount.

text.ht: Pou konnen sa pwojè a bay, fòk nou ta jwenn prèv sou travay ki te fin fèt, koneksyon ki te antre an sèvis ak moun ki te responsab antretyen an. Nou pa jwenn dokiman sa yo nan ekstrè nou li a. Sa pa pwouve pwojè a echwe; li montre yon anons lansman pa ase pou evalye rezilta li.
text.en: Assessing the result would require completion records, evidence of connections entering service and responsibility for maintenance. The excerpt we read does not provide those records. That does not prove failure; it shows why a launch announcement cannot establish the outcome.

text.ht: Kesyon elektè a kapab senp: konbyen fanmi ki te jwenn kouran, pandan konbyen tan, epi ak ki depans? Se repons sa yo ki ta fè yon ansyen seremoni tounen yon bilan ki itil pou yon eleksyon.
text.en: The voter’s question can be simple: how many households received electricity, for how long, and at what cost? Those answers would turn an old ceremony into an election record worth assessing.

title.ht: Moïse Durocher: yon milyon edmi djòb bezwen plis pase yon gwo chif
title.en: Moïse Durocher: one and a half million jobs need more than a large number

description.ht: Objektif la ka chanje lavi anpil fanmi. Pou evalye l, fòk kanpay la esplike ki travay, nan konbyen tan ak avèk ki lajan.
description.en: The goal could change many families’ lives. Assessing it requires knowing which jobs, over what period and with what funding.

text.ht: Yon pwofil sou Moïse Durocher, ki te pibliye 12 Novanm 2026, prezante objektif li pou kreye 1,500,000 djòb dirèk. Li asosye pwodiksyon ak fòmasyon nan etid lanmè, pwodiksyon bèt ak etid dlo nan anviwònman an. Se pwogram kandida a jan atik la prezante l, pa travay ki deja kreye.
text.en: A profile published November 12, 2026 gives Moïse Durocher’s goal of 1,500,000 direct jobs. It connects production and training in marine science, animal production and the study of water and ecosystems. That is the program as presented in the article, rather than jobs already created.

text.ht: Ann fè yon ti kalkil pou konprann gwosè pwomès la. Si objektif sa a ta kouvri senk ane, sa ta vle di 300,000 nouvo djòb pa ane, oswa 25,000 pa mwa an mwayèn. Senk ane a se yon egzanp nou pran pou kalkil la; se pa yon delè atik la bay pou objektif la.
text.en: A little arithmetic clarifies the scale. If that goal covered five years, it would mean an average of 300,000 new jobs a year, or 25,000 a month. Five years is our illustration for the calculation; the article does not supply that deadline for the goal.

text.ht: Men ki sa ki ta konte kòm yon nouvo djòb? Yon travay sezonye ka itil san li pa bay menm sekirite ak yon salè tout ane. Yon travay ki te deja egziste, men ki vin anrejistre, pa menm ak yon nouvo plas. San definisyon sa yo, de ekip ka konte menm pwogram nan de fason diferan.
text.en: What would count as a new job? Seasonal work can be valuable without offering the security of year-round pay. Registering an existing job is different from creating a position. Without those definitions, two teams could count the same program differently.

text.ht: Gen yon lòt chif nan pwofil la: Durocher evalye satisfaksyon li sou pwòp ansyen fonksyon li yo a 95 pousan. Sa se apresyasyon pa li, se pa 95 pousan nan elektè oswa moun yon sondaj ta entèwoje. Li enpòtan pou nou pa melanje de kalite mezi sa yo.
text.en: The profile contains another number: Durocher rates his own satisfaction with his previous roles at 95 percent. That is his assessment, rather than 95 percent of voters or survey respondents. Those are different kinds of measurement.

text.ht: Yon plan travay ki kapab suiv bezwen yon premye etap ki klè: konbyen plas, kiyès k ap anboche, konbyen fòmasyon k ap disponib ak kiyès k ap peye? Lè etap sa a parèt, elektè a ka kòmanse mezire yon pwomès. Anvan sa, li konnen gwosè anbisyon an, men li poko gen yon chemen pou verifye rezilta li.
text.en: A trackable employment plan needs a clear first stage: how many positions, which employers, how much training and who pays? Once that stage is specified, voters can start testing the promise. Until then, they know the scale of the ambition without a way to verify delivery.

title.ht: Martelly ak Charles Saint-Rémy: twa lyen pou nou pa melanje
title.en: Martelly and Charles Saint-Rémy: three links to keep distinct

description.ht: Fanmi, wòl konseye ak sanksyon se twa enfòmasyon diferan. Mete yo nan bon lòd pèmèt nou mande kesyon ki pi presi sou pouvwa.
description.en: Family, an advisory role and sanctions are three different facts. Putting them in order makes questions about power more precise.

text.ht: Nan yon rapò Reuters an Janvye 2023, Charles Saint-Rémy parèt kòm bòfrè ak konseye ansyen prezidan Michel Martelly. Lyen an pa sèlman yon non fanmi: rapò a dekri yon relasyon politik tou. Men li pa bay yon manda ekri ki ta esplike limit pouvwa konseye sa a.
text.en: A January 2023 Reuters report describes Charles Saint-Rémy as former president Michel Martelly’s brother-in-law and adviser. The link extends beyond a surname to a reported political role. The report does not provide a written mandate defining that adviser’s powers.

text.ht: Nan dat 13 Janvye 2023, Kanada te anonse sanksyon kont Saint-Rémy. Li te dekri l kòm yon biznismann ak asosye Martelly epi li te deklare li gen rezon kwè moun sanksyon yo vize yo te pwoteje aktivite gang, avèk trafik dwòg ak koripsyon ladan yo. Sa se rezon otorite Kanada bay pou yon mezi administratif.
text.en: On January 13, 2023, Canada announced sanctions against Saint-Rémy, identifying a businessman and Martelly associate. It said it had reason to believe those targeted protected gang activity, including drug trafficking and corruption. Those are Canada’s stated grounds for an administrative measure.

text.ht: Nan kopi règleman Kanada ki ajou 19 Oktòb 2026 la, non Saint-Rémy rete nan pati ki konsène gwo zak koripsyon. Lis sa a pa yon jijman kriminèl. Li pa etabli, poukont li, Martelly te bay yon lòd oswa resevwa lajan nan yon operasyon gang.
text.en: The regulations current to October 19, 2026 still list Saint-Rémy in the significant-corruption category. That list is not a criminal judgment. It does not, by itself, establish that Martelly ordered or received money from a gang operation.

text.ht: Kesyon piblik la vin pi klè lè nou trase chak lyen apa. Kòm fanmi, ki aksè li te genyen? Kòm konseye, ki dosye li te enfliyanse? Kòm biznismann, èske li te patisipe nan desizyon kote li te gen yon enterè? Chak repons bezwen pwòp dokiman pa li: nominasyon, reyinyon, kontra oswa tranzaksyon.
text.en: The public question becomes clearer when each link is traced separately. What access came with family ties? Which files did he influence as an adviser? As a businessman, did he take part in decisions involving his interests? Each answer needs its own records: appointments, meetings, contracts or transactions.

text.ht: Nou poko etabli wòl Saint-Rémy nan kanpay prezidansyèl aktyèl Martelly a. Se poutèt sa yon ankèt serye dwe mande kiyès ki gen aksè ak kandida a jodi a, san li pa transfòme yon relasyon fanmi an yon akizasyon otomatik. Enfliyans enfòmèl merite kesyon menm lè li pa gen yon biwo oswa yon tit ofisyèl.
text.en: We have not established Saint-Rémy’s role in Martelly’s current presidential campaign. Serious scrutiny therefore asks who has access to the candidate today without turning kinship into an automatic accusation. Informal influence deserves questions even when it comes without an office or official title.

title.ht: Jude Célestin ak CNE: machin yo bezwen yon envantè, pa sèlman yon bidjè
title.en: Jude Célestin and CNE: the machines need an inventory, not only a budget

description.ht: Yon rapò Sena a pèmèt nou separe lajan ki te prevwa, sa kontra yo bay ak ekipman yo te kapab verifye.
description.en: A Senate report separates the allocation, the contract record and the equipment investigators could verify.

text.ht: Rapò komisyon Sena a sou PetroCaribe an 2016 retounen sou yon acha machin lou pou Sant Nasyonal Ekipman an, CNE. Li idantifye Jude Célestin kòm responsab CNE nan peryòd la epi li raple temwayaj devan palmantè sou kontra acha yo. Montan ki te prevwa pou ekipman an se te 80 milyon dola ameriken.
text.en: The Senate commission’s 2016 PetroCaribe report revisits heavy-equipment purchases for the National Equipment Center, CNE. It identifies Jude Célestin as the institution’s head during the period and recalls parliamentary testimony about the purchases. The equipment allocation was US$80 million.

text.ht: Yon liy nan tablo kontra a fè diferans ant sa yo te kòmande ak sa yo te resevwa: 81 kamyon olye 100, avèk yon soustraksyon 2,565,000 dola nan total la. Li ta twò fasil pou prezante 19 kamyon sa yo kòm kamyon ki disparèt. Tablo a menm bay yon ajisteman pou kantite ki pa t livre a.
text.en: One contract-table entry distinguishes orders from deliveries: 81 trucks instead of 100, with US$2,565,000 deducted from the total. Calling those 19 trucks “missing” would ignore the adjustment the table itself records for the undelivered quantity.

text.ht: Men komisyon an te soulve yon lòt pwoblèm ki rete enpòtan: li pa t rive jwenn yon envantè konplè CNE ki ta pèmèt li evalye tout ekipman yo ak egzistans yo. Yon papye ki montre yon acha pa sifi pou montre kote machin nan ye, si li mache ak ki sèvis li bay.
text.en: The commission raised a different, substantial problem: it had not obtained an exhaustive CNE inventory enabling it to assess all the equipment and its existence. A purchase record alone cannot establish where a machine is, whether it works or what service it provides.

text.ht: Se yon rapò ankèt palmantè, pa yon kondanasyon kriminèl Célestin. Li pa pèmèt nou mete 80 milyon dola nan pòch yon moun ak yon fraz. Li montre tou plizyè enstitisyon te antre nan finansman ak acha yo; responsablite chak aktè bezwen suiv selon siyati ak desizyon li yo.
text.en: This is a parliamentary inquiry, not a criminal conviction of Célestin. It does not allow us to put US$80 million into one person’s pocket with a sentence. Several institutions were involved in financing and procurement; each actor’s responsibility needs tracing through their signatures and decisions.

text.ht: Pou yon kandida ki gen eksperyans sa a, bilan ki itil la ta konekte twa dosye: kontra yo, peman yo ak yon lis machin ki gen nimewo pou idantifye yo. Ki ekipman ki te sèvi popilasyon an, ki te tonbe anpàn ak kiyès ki te responsab antretyen? Se la lajan piblik la tounen yon kesyon sou sèvis sitwayen yo te resevwa.
text.en: A useful record for a candidate with this experience would connect three files: contracts, payments and an inventory with machine identifiers. Which equipment served the public, which broke down and who maintained it? That is where public spending becomes a question about the service citizens received.

title.ht: Hans Joseph: 166 dosye, men kiyès ki te suiv yo apre ankèt la?
title.en: Hans Joseph: 166 referrals, but who followed them after investigation?

description.ht: Yon ankèt ECC montre poukisa kantite rapò pa mezire, poukont li, rezilta batay kont koripsyon an.
description.en: An ECC inquiry shows why report counts alone cannot measure results against corruption.

text.ht: Gen yon distans ant anonse yon ankèt ak jwenn yon desizyon lajistis. Nan rapò 2025 li a, òganizasyon Ensemble Contre la Corruption, ECC, te suiv 166 dosye ULCC ak UCREF te voye bay otorite yo pandan peryòd 2005–2024. Li te jwenn enfòmasyon sou 95; li pa t rive retrase 71 lòt yo.
text.en: There is a distance between announcing an investigation and obtaining a court decision. In its 2025 report, watchdog Ensemble Contre la Corruption, ECC, traced 166 referrals submitted by ULCC and UCREF over 2005–2024. It located information on 95 and could not trace 71.

text.ht: De enstitisyon sa yo pa menm bagay. ULCC mennen ankèt sou koripsyon; UCREF travay sou enfòmasyon finansye. Sou 166 dosye yo, 96 soti nan ULCC ak 70 nan UCREF. Hans Joseph, yon kandida prezidansyèl jodi a, parèt kòm direktè ULCC nan yon dokiman Leta te soumèt an 2021. Total ki kouvri de ajans ak prèske ven ane sa a pa yon bilan yon sèl manda pa li.
text.en: The institutions are different: ULCC investigates corruption; UCREF handles financial intelligence. Of the 166 referrals, 96 came from ULCC and 70 from UCREF. Presidential candidate Hans Joseph is named as ULCC director in a 2021 State submission. A total spanning two agencies and almost twenty years is not the record of one term under him.

text.ht: ECC rapòte difikilte pou jwenn enfòmasyon nan biwo ki konsève dosye tribinal yo, avèk rezon pèsonèl lajistis te bay tankou dife, demenajman ak atak ame. Pa jwenn yon dosye pa pwouve yon moun te detwi l pou kache yon krim. Men si Leta pa kapab retrase li, ni yon viktim ni yon moun yo akize pa kapab suiv demach la fasil.
text.en: ECC reports court-record access problems and explanations from judicial staff including fires, relocations and armed attacks. An unlocated file does not prove someone destroyed it to conceal a crime. But an untraceable process harms both victims seeking accountability and accused people seeking resolution.

text.ht: Yon soumisyon òganizasyon dwa moun bay Nasyonzini an 2026 reprann rezilta etid la: kat jijman, avèk de kondanasyon. Sa fè nou evite yon lòt rakousi: kat dosye jije pa otomatikman vle di kat moun koupab. Ni kantite rapò pa di konbyen lajan ki retounen nan kès Leta.
text.en: A 2026 human-rights coalition submission to the UN cites the study’s result: four judgments, including two convictions. Four adjudicated files do not automatically mean four guilty people. Report counts also do not tell us how much money returned to the Treasury.

text.ht: Pou evalye Joseph, fòk nou egzamine travay ULCC pandan responsablite li, epi suiv sa lajistis te fè apre. Pou evalye pwomès li yo, fòk nou mande ki sistèm ki ta pèmèt swiv yon dosye depi premye depo jouk desizyon final la. Prezidan an pa ranplase jij la; li dwe esplike ki jan li ta soutni yon sistèm ki kapab rann kont.
text.en: Assessing Joseph requires examining ULCC’s work under his responsibility and what the courts did afterward. Assessing his promises requires a system that tracks a file from referral to final decision. A president does not replace a judge; the candidate should explain how he would support an accountable process.

title.ht: Martelly ak kontra Bautista yo: istwa a te kòmanse anvan manda li
title.en: Martelly and the Bautista contracts: the story began before his term

description.ht: Dat kontra yo ak dat desizyon ki vin apre yo enpòtan. Yo pèmèt nou suiv responsablite san nou pa mete tout operasyon yo sou menm prezidan an.
description.en: Contract dates and later decisions matter. They allow responsibility to be traced without assigning every transaction to the same president.

text.ht: Dapre rapò komisyon Sena a sou PetroCaribe an 2016, sis gwo kontra ak konpayi ki lye ak Félix Bautista te siyen 8 Novanm 2010. Yo te konsène Palè Lejislatif la ak lojman nan Bowenfield ak Fò Nasyonal, pou anviwon 348 milyon dola ameriken. Se valè kontra yo, pa yon montan rapò a pwouve ki te disparèt.
text.en: According to the Senate commission’s 2016 PetroCaribe report, six major contracts with companies linked to Félix Bautista were signed on November 8, 2010. They covered Parliament and housing at Bowenfield and Fort National, worth about US$348 million. That is a contract value, not an established sum of missing money.

text.ht: Michel Martelly te antre nan fonksyon prezidan 14 Me 2011. Kidonk, li pa t prezidan lè premye kontra sa yo te siyen. Men rapò a dekri desizyon ki te kenbe oswa modifye kontra apre chanjman gouvènman an. Eritye yon kontra ak deside kontinye li se de moman diferan nan menm chèn responsablite a.
text.en: Michel Martelly took office on May 14, 2011, after those initial contracts. The report also describes decisions to retain or modify contracts after the change of government. Inheriting a contract and deciding to continue it are different moments in the same chain of responsibility.

text.ht: An 2018, Trezò ameriken an te sanksyone Bautista ak senk konpayi, ladan yo Hadom ak Constructora Rofi. Li te akize l de koripsyon nan rekonstriksyon Ayiti epi li te site yon ka kote yon konpayi te resevwa plis pase 10 milyon dola pou travay li pa t fin fè. Kominike a pa idantifye yon prezidan ayisyen ki ta resevwa lajan sa a.
text.en: In 2018, the US Treasury sanctioned Bautista and five companies, including Hadom and Constructora Rofi. It alleged reconstruction-related corruption and cited a company receiving more than US$10 million for unfinished work. The release does not identify a Haitian president receiving that money.

text.ht: Bautista te konteste akizasyon koripsyon yo nan yon plent yon tribinal ameriken te egzamine an 2021. Desizyon nou li a te rejte kat demann sou mezi Depatman Deta ki gen rapò ak antre Ozetazini; li pa t yon jijman kriminèl sou kontra Ayiti yo. Non li toujou parèt nan kopi lis sanksyon OFAC nou verifye 15 Novanm 2026 la.
text.en: Bautista disputed corruption allegations in litigation discussed by a US court in 2021. The opinion we reviewed dismissed four claims concerning State Department entry restrictions; it was not a criminal judgment about Haiti’s contracts. His name remains in the OFAC sanctions snapshot checked November 15, 2026.

text.ht: Pou egzamine bilan Martelly, kesyon ki itil la se kiyès ki te otorize chak kontinyasyon, chanjman ak peman pandan manda li. Kontra orijinal la, chanjman ki siyen apre yo ak rapò sou travay ki fèt yo dwe mache ansanm. Yon non konpayi oswa yon sanksyon pa ranplase chèn prèv sa a.
text.en: Assessing Martelly’s record means identifying who authorized each continuation, change and payment during his term. Original contracts, later signed amendments and completion reports must be read together. A company name or sanctions designation cannot replace that chain of evidence.

title.ht: Pitit Martelly a ak desizyon 2016 la: dosye a pa t pare pou jijman
title.en: Martelly’s son and the 2016 order: a file not ready for judgment

description.ht: Tit nouvèl sou yon demann dechaj pa rakonte tout desizyon an. Kopi dosye Olivier Martelly a montre sa kour la te deside ak sa li te kite ouvè.
description.en: A headline about a clearance request does not tell the whole decision. The Olivier Martelly record shows what the court decided and what it left open.

text.ht: An Septanm 2018, tit nouvèl te anonse kour kont yo te rejte yon demann dechaj Olivier Martelly, pitit ansyen prezidan Michel Martelly. Lè nou li kopi desizyon 28 Janvye 2016 la, sans la vin pi presi: kour la te deklare dosye a pa t pare pou resevwa yon jijman.
text.en: In September 2018, news headlines reported the rejection of a clearance request by former president Michel Martelly’s son, Olivier. Reading the January 28, 2016 order makes the meaning more precise: the court declared the file was not ready for judgment.

text.ht: Dosye a te konsène wòl Olivier kòm kowòdonatè yon komisyon ki te soutni enfrastrikti espòtif ak lajenès. Li menm te mande kontwòl sou jesyon li an Oktòb 2013. Yon premye ekip verifikasyon te fè konnen fon pwojè yo te sou kontwòl ministè Planifikasyon an. Avoka li te sèvi ak lekti sa a pou soutni li pa t jere lajan piblik.
text.en: The file concerned Olivier’s role coordinating a commission supporting sports infrastructure and youth. He requested a review of his management in October 2013. An initial verification team attributed project funds to the Planning Ministry. His lawyer relied on that reading to argue that he had not managed public money.

text.ht: Men te gen yon dezakò sou kalite verifikasyon ki te fèt la ak responsablite komisyon an. Sèvis ki rele Auditorat la, ki bay kour la konklizyon pa li, te mande yon verifikasyon ki pi solid. Li te souliye responsablite komisyon an ak mwayen Leta te dwe mete a dispozisyon li.
text.en: There was a dispute over the quality of verification and the commission’s responsibility. The Auditorat, the service presenting its conclusions to the court, sought a stronger examination. It pointed to the commission’s responsibilities and the resources the State was supposed to provide.

text.ht: Kour la te mete sou kote dokiman premye ekip verifikasyon an te pwodui an Novanm 2013. Li te eksplike dokiman sa a pa t gen kalite yon odit finansye oswa lòt kalite rapò li site yo. Apre sa, li te deklare dosye a pa t an eta pou jije devan chanm finansye a.
text.en: The court set aside the verification team’s November 2013 document, explaining that it did not qualify as a financial audit or the other report types it listed. It then declared the matter unready for judgment before the financial chamber.

text.ht: Sa pa t yon desizyon final ki te di Olivier koupab, ni youn ki te fin valide tout jesyon li. Atik sa a egzamine desizyon 2016 sa a; li pa sètifye eta tout dosye jidisyè a jodi a. Li pa etabli Michel Martelly te pran lajan nan operasyon sa yo.
text.en: That was neither a final finding of guilt nor a complete validation of Olivier’s management. This article examines that 2016 order; it does not certify the entire docket’s current status. The order does not establish that Michel Martelly took money from these operations.

text.ht: Pou elektè ki egzamine yon retou Martelly sou pouvwa a, kesyon an rete konkrè: si yon komisyon prezidansyèl enfliyanse pwojè piblik, kiyès ki konsève prèv sou desizyon ak depans yo? Egzamen an pa dwe limite ak moun ki siyen yon chèk la. Men responsablite chak aktè bezwen etabli ak prèv.
text.en: For voters assessing a Martelly return, the concrete question is who preserves decision and spending records when a presidential commission influences public projects. Scrutiny must look beyond the person signing a check, while establishing each actor’s responsibility with evidence.

title.ht: Jerry Tardieu ak Royal Oasis: twa fason diferan pou suiv lajan an
title.en: Jerry Tardieu and Royal Oasis: following three different kinds of money

description.ht: Yon prè, aksyon yon fondasyon achte, ak yon lavant aksyon pa menm bagay. Dosye otèl la montre poukisa diferans sa yo konte.
description.en: A loan, a foundation’s share purchase and a later share sale are different transactions. The hotel’s history shows why those distinctions matter.

text.ht: Nan rapò anyèl IFC pou 2011 la, Jerry Tardieu parèt kòm direktè jeneral Oasis Hotel. Rapò a dekri yon pwojè tranblemanntè a te kanpe, epi yon prè 7.5 milyon dola ameriken ki te ede atire 15 milyon dola anplis nan men lòt envestisè. Se yon prè, pa yon don san ranbousman.
text.en: IFC’s 2011 annual report identifies Jerry Tardieu as Oasis Hotel’s chief executive. It describes an earthquake-interrupted project and a US$7.5 million loan that helped attract another US$15 million from investors. A loan carries a repayment obligation; it is not a grant.

text.ht: Yon lòt mekanis te sèvi pou Clinton Bush Haiti Fund. Dapre atik TechnoServe pibliye 14 Janvye 2013 la, fon an te achte 2 milyon dola aksyon nan Royal Oasis. Apre sa, li te vann aksyon yo epi reyenvesti 2 milyon dola sa yo nan rekonstriksyon Fakilte Syans Inivèsite Leta d Ayiti a. Sa pa yon prèv IFC te deja jwenn ranbousman prè pa li.
text.en: Clinton Bush Haiti Fund used another mechanism. A January 14, 2013 article published by TechnoServe says the fund invested US$2 million in Royal Oasis shares, later sold them and recycled the original investment into rebuilding the State University of Haiti’s science faculty. That does not establish repayment of IFC’s separate loan.

text.ht: Pou yon elektè, istwa a bay yon pwen depa ki pi solid pase jis di « li te resevwa èd ». Tardieu te dirije yon biznis ki te jwenn finansman entènasyonal. Pou mezire bilan sa a, fòk nou separe lajan yo te prete, lajan envestisè te mete, travay yo te anonse ak rezilta yo ka verifye.
text.en: For voters, this is more useful than saying he “received aid.” Tardieu ran a business that secured international financing. Assessing that record requires separating borrowed money, investment capital, announced jobs and independently verifiable results.

text.ht: Dokiman sa yo pa etabli aksyon Tardieu posede jodi a, tout dèt aktyèl otèl la oswa sous lajan kanpay li. Yo pa pwouve detounman lajan nonplis. Yon bilan biznis ki sèvi kòm agiman politik merite kont ki pèmèt piblik la wè sa eksperyans lan te pwodui.
text.en: These documents do not establish Tardieu’s present shareholding, the hotel’s current debts or his campaign funding. They do not establish diversion of funds either. When business experience becomes a political credential, accounts should show what that experience delivered.

title.ht: Olivier Barrau: AIC te fè plis biznis, men mwens benefis
title.en: Olivier Barrau: AIC’s business grew while profit fell

description.ht: De chif nan menm rapò a rakonte de istwa diferan. Li tablo a byen anvan w fè l tounen yon jijman sou kandida a.
description.en: Two figures in one report tell different stories. Reading the table carefully changes how the candidate’s business record should be assessed.

text.ht: Nan rapò AIC pou 2022 a, Olivier Barrau parèt kòm prezidan konsèy administrasyon an. Tablo rezilta yo montre valè prim asirans konpayi an te emèt yo te monte soti anviwon 1.507 milya goud an 2021 pou rive 1.827 milya an 2022. Sa fè yon ogmantasyon anviwon 21.2%. Men benefis nèt la te bese soti anviwon 167.6 milyon goud pou rive 148.5 milyon: yon bès anviwon 11.4%.
text.en: AIC’s 2022 report names Olivier Barrau as board president. Written premiums increased from approximately 1.507 billion gourdes in 2021 to 1.827 billion in 2022, a rise of about 21.2%. Yet net profit fell from about 167.6 million gourdes to 148.5 million, a decline of approximately 11.4%.

text.ht: Tablo orijinal la ekri montan yo an milye goud. Se poutèt sa liy « 148,512 » la vle di 148,512,000 goud. Prim emèt yo mezire valè kontra asirans yo; yo pa benefis ki rete apre tout depans. Rapò a atribye bès benefis la ak yon ogmantasyon pèt yo. Li gen yon lèt odit Joseph Paillant siyen sou eta finansye yo.
text.en: The original table uses thousands of gourdes: “148,512” means 148,512,000 gourdes. Written premiums measure insurance business written, not profit remaining after expenses. The report attributes the profit decline to increased losses and includes Joseph Paillant’s audit opinion on the financial statements.

text.ht: Pou konprann diferans lan, panse ak yon boutik ki vann plis men ki depanse plis toujou. Aktivite a ka grandi pandan sa ki rete nan fen ane a diminye. Chif sa yo anpeche nou sèvi ak yon sèl pousantaj kwasans pou esplike tout bilan jesyon an. Yo pa sifi pou deklare jesyon an bon oswa move.
text.en: Think of a shop that sells more while its costs also rise. Activity can expand even as the amount left at year-end shrinks. These figures prevent one growth percentage from standing in for the entire management record. Alone, they do not establish good or bad management.

text.ht: Sa yo se rezilta konpayi an pou yon ane, pa salè Barrau, fòtin fanmi li oswa lajan kanpay li. Pou evalye eksperyans li kòm kandida, elektè yo ta bezwen wè plizyè ane, kalite sèvis kliyan yo ak fason responsablite li te separe ak responsablite lòt dirijan yo.
text.en: These are one year’s company results, not Barrau’s salary, family wealth or campaign funds. Evaluating his experience as a candidate would require several years of results, customer-service evidence and a clear account of his responsibilities alongside those of other executives.

title.ht: Olivier Barrau ak asirans peyizan: lè lapli a deside peman an
title.en: Olivier Barrau and farmers’ insurance: when rainfall determines payment

description.ht: Yon pwojè AIC ak PAM bay yon egzanp konkrè pou egzamine eksperyans kandida a: kiyès asirans lan pwoteje, epi nan ki kondisyon?
description.en: An AIC–WFP project offers a concrete way to examine the candidate’s experience: whom does insurance protect, and under what conditions?

text.ht: Yon peyizan ka pèdi rekòt li epi bezwen lajan tousuit pou rekòmanse. An 2022, AIC, konpayi kote Olivier Barrau te prezidan konsèy administrasyon an, te lanse yon pilòt asirans ak Pwogram Alimantè Mondyal la, WRMS ak SCOR. Rapò PAM la dekri 4,990 ti pwodiktè nan 11 komin nan Grandans ak Sid; 51% te fanm.
text.en: A farmer who loses a harvest needs money to plant again. In 2022, AIC, whose board president was Olivier Barrau, launched an insurance pilot with the World Food Programme, WRMS and SCOR. WFP reports 4,990 smallholders across 11 communes in Grand’Anse and Sud, 51% of them women.

text.ht: Asirans lan te vize twòp lapli ak mank lapli. PAM bay yon limit anviwon 900 dola ameriken pou chak peyizan, divize egalman ant de risk yo. Sa pa vle di chak patisipan te gen dwa resevwa 900 dola nenpòt lè li pèdi yon rekòt. Limit pwoteksyon ak lajan yo peye toutbon se de bagay diferan.
text.en: Coverage addressed excess rainfall and rainfall deficit. WFP gives a maximum of about US$900 per farmer, divided equally between the two risks. That is not a promise of US$900 whenever a harvest fails. A coverage ceiling and an actual payout are different things.

text.ht: Nan kalite asirans sa a, yon mezi ki defini davans, tankou kantite lapli, sèvi pou deklanche peman an. IFC eksplike feblès prensipal la: mezi a ka pa koresponn ak pèt yon moun sibi. Yon peyizan ka gen gwo domaj pandan endis la pa deklanche yon peman ki kouvri domaj sa yo. Sa se yon risk nan mekanis la, pa prèv pilòt AIC la te refize yon reklamasyon presi.
text.en: This kind of insurance uses a predefined measure, such as rainfall, to trigger payment. IFC explains its central weakness: the index may not match an individual’s losses. A farmer can suffer serious damage without receiving a payment that covers it. That is a design risk, not evidence that this AIC pilot rejected a particular claim.

text.ht: Enterè politik egzanp lan se kapasite pou pwoteje moun ki gen ti mwayen. Yon bilan serye ta montre konbyen moun ki te touche, konbyen tan sa te pran, ak sa patisipan yo te konprann anvan yo enskri. Kantite moun ki antre nan yon pwogram enpòtan; kondisyon ak rezilta pwoteksyon an enpòtan menm jan an.
text.en: The political test is whether a system protects people with little financial cushion. A useful record would show how many received payouts, how quickly and what participants understood before enrolling. Enrolment matters; the conditions and results of protection matter just as much.

title.ht: Muscadin: yon dosye enkonplè pa rakonte tout istwa kandidati a
title.en: Muscadin: an incomplete file does not settle a candidacy

description.ht: Nouvèl sou pyès ki manke, yon lèt demisyon ak yon non nan rejis la dekri twa etap. Fòk nou pa konfonn yo.
description.en: A missing-document report, a resignation letter and a registry entry describe three stages. They should not be treated as the same decision.

text.ht: 29 Oktòb 2026, Juno7 rapòte dosye kandidati Jean Ernest Muscadin te deklare iresevab paske li te manke deklarasyon definitif taks pou 2025 ak 2026, ansanm ak lèt demisyon li. Men jounal la te presize li poko gen dokiman ofisyèl desizyon sa a. Se yon limit enpòtan nan sa nouvèl la pèmèt nou verifye.
text.en: On October 29, 2026, Juno7 reported that Jean Ernest Muscadin’s candidacy file had been declared inadmissible because it lacked definitive tax declarations for 2025 and 2026 and his resignation letter. The newsroom also said it did not yet possess the official decision document. That limits what can be verified from its report.

text.ht: Apre sa, Juno7 rapòte 6 Novanm Minis Jistis Patrick Pélissier te aksepte demisyon Muscadin te soumèt 29 Oktòb la. Lèt ministè a, ki pote referans MJSP/SCGe/33, konsène depa li nan pòs komisè gouvènman Miragwàn. Li pa yon desizyon KEP sou apwobasyon kandidati prezidansyèl li.
text.en: Juno7 subsequently reported on November 6 that Justice Minister Patrick Pélissier accepted the resignation Muscadin submitted on October 29. Ministry letter MJSP/SCGe/33 concerns his departure as Miragoâne’s government commissioner. It is not a CEP decision approving his presidential candidacy.

text.ht: Non Muscadin parèt tou nan kopi rejis enskripsyon KEP nou verifye 14 Novanm nan, anba FCN. Prezans yon non nan rejis la pa vle di tout kondisyon legal yo deja ranpli. Yon rejis enskripsyon ak yon lis final kandida ki apwouve pa menm dokiman.
text.en: Muscadin also appears under FCN in the CEP registration snapshot reviewed November 14. An entry does not establish that every legal requirement has been satisfied. A registration registry and a final approved-candidate list are different documents.

text.ht: Pyès taks ki manke nan yon dosye pa pwouve kandida a pa peye taks. Yon lèt demisyon ki pa nan dosye a pa pwouve li pa t janm demisyone. E yon lèt ki vini apre pa esplike poukont li sa otorite elektoral yo te genyen nan men yo pi bonè.
text.en: Missing tax paperwork does not prove unpaid taxes. A resignation letter missing from a file does not prove no resignation occurred. A later letter does not, by itself, establish what electoral authorities possessed earlier.

text.ht: Sa ki ta rezoud kesyon an se desizyon ofisyèl la, lis pyès ki te depoze yo ak nenpòt regilarizasyon oswa rekou. San dokiman sa yo, deklare kandidati a definitivman rejte oswa definitivman valide ta ale pi lwen pase prèv ki egzamine isit la.
text.en: The official decision, submitted-document list and any correction or appeal would resolve the question. Without them, declaring the candidacy definitively rejected or definitively approved would go beyond the evidence examined here.

title.ht: Clarens Renois: siyati ki mare l ak pwomès tranzisyon an
title.en: Clarens Renois: the signature tying him to transition promises

description.ht: Li pa t manm Konsèy Prezidansyèl la. Men siyati li nan akò 2024 la bay elektè yo yon angajman presi pou egzamine.
description.en: He was not a Presidential Council member. His signature on the 2024 agreement nevertheless gives voters a concrete commitment to examine.

text.ht: Nan paj 13 akò politik Avril 2024 la, siyati Clarens Renois parèt pou Kolektif Pati Politik 30 Janvye 2023 yo. Liné Balthazar ak Edgard Leblanc Fils parèt nan menm gwoup la. Se yon lyen dokimante ak achitekti tranzisyon an, pa yon lyen nou dedui apati yon foto.
text.en: Page 13 of the April 2024 political agreement carries Clarens Renois’s signature for the Collective of Political Parties of January 30, 2023, alongside Liné Balthazar and Edgard Leblanc Fils. This is a documented connection to the transition’s design.

text.ht: Akò a te fikse twa priyorite: sekirite, refòm ak eleksyon. Atik 12.1 te mete fen manda Konsèy Prezidansyèl la nan dat 7 Fevriye 2026; atik 13 te entèdi pwolongasyon manda sa a. Atik 47 te prevwa yon asanble sektè yo pou suiv akò a ak fè rekòmandasyon. Kidonk, tèks la pa t sèlman distribye plas: li te ekri règ pou suiv sa ki t ap fèt.
text.en: The pact prioritized security, reform and elections. Article 12.1 set February 7, 2026 as the council’s end date; article 13 barred an extension. Article 47 envisaged a sectors’ assembly to monitor implementation and make recommendations. The text provided a mechanism for scrutiny as well as distributing roles.

text.ht: Pou sektè Renois a, manm konsèy la se te Edgard Leblanc Fils. Se pa Renois. Nou pa ka ba li tout desizyon oswa tout fot yon konsèy li pa t chita ladan. Men yon moun ki siyen yon akò ka esplike sa li te soutni, sa li te konteste ak fason li te sèvi ak mekanis swivi yo.
text.en: The collective’s council member was Edgard Leblanc Fils, not Renois. Decisions and failures cannot automatically be assigned to a nonmember. A signatory can nevertheless account for what he supported, what he challenged and how he used the proposed oversight mechanisms.

text.ht: Distenksyon sa a enpòtan nan yon eleksyon: responsablite politik pi laj pase siyen yon chèk, men li pa menm ak responsablite kriminèl. Akò a pa pwouve Renois te komèt yon enfraksyon. Li bay yon mezi konkrè pou egzamine pawòl ak aksyon li sou tranzisyon an: angajman li te siyen yo.
text.en: This distinction matters at election time. Political accountability extends beyond spending authority, while remaining distinct from criminal liability. The pact establishes no offence by Renois. It supplies a concrete standard against which to examine his transition positions and actions: the commitments he signed.

title.ht: Walsonn Sanon: refize yon akò, men ki jan pou konstwi konsansis la?
title.en: Walsonn Sanon: rejecting a pact, then building consent

description.ht: Ant 2022 ak 2025, li te kritike fason lidè yo chwazi moun ak dirije pati yo. Menm kritè sa yo ka sèvi pou egzamine pwòp òganizasyon li.
description.en: Between 2022 and 2025, he challenged political selection and party practices. Those standards also offer a way to examine his own organization.

text.ht: 27 Desanm 2022, Scoop FM rapòte Walsonn Sanon, responsab SOLID, te refize rekonèt akò 21 Desanm nan. Li te di òganizasyon li te fè rezèv sou tèks la, yo te pwomèt revize l, epi li te aprann sou rezo sosyal yo siyati a t ap fèt. Li te mande yon konsansis pi laj, olye li te rejte lide yon akò nèt.
text.en: On December 27, 2022, Scoop FM reported that SOLID leader Walsonn Sanon rejected the December 21 agreement. He said his organization’s reservations had received promises of revision, but he then learned through social media that signing would proceed. He sought broader consent rather than rejecting any agreement in principle.

text.ht: Li te kritike tou fason yo te chwazi Mirlande Manigat pou HCT a. Sa se te Wo Konsèy Tranzisyon ki te lye ak akò 2022 a. Li pa menm estrikti ak Konsèy Prezidansyèl Tranzisyon, CPT, ki te vini an 2024. Konfonn yo ta efase chanjman ki te fèt nan sistèm nan.
text.en: He also criticized the selection process for Mirlande Manigat in the HCT, the High Transition Council associated with the 2022 agreement. That body differs from the Transitional Presidential Council, or CPT, formed in 2024. Combining them would blur two separate arrangements.

text.ht: Nan yon entèvyou Rezo Nòdwès pibliye 4 Me 2025, Sanon, prezante kòm kowòdonatè ANFÒS, te akize pati politik yo sèvi privilèj pèsonèl olye yo konekte sitwayen ak Leta. Li te rele pou nouvo lidè ki soti nan reyalite lokal yo. Sa yo se jijman politik li, pa konklizyon yon ankèt sou tout pati yo.
text.en: In a May 4, 2025 Rezo Nòdwès interview, Sanon, identified as ANFÒS coordinator, accused parties of serving personal privilege instead of connecting citizens to the state. He called for new leadership rooted in local life. Those are his political assessments, not findings from an investigation of every party.

text.ht: Gen yon fil ki konekte de pozisyon yo: kiyès ki patisipe lè yo deside? Pou elektè yo, tès ki pi itil la se règ ANFÒS yo menm: kijan yo chwazi dirijan, trete dezakò ak esplike desizyon bay manm yo. Kritike eksklizyon nan tèt Leta vin pi solid lè òganizasyon ki pote kritik la rann pwòp metòd li vizib.
text.en: Both positions turn on who participates in decisions. For voters, the useful test is ANFÒS’s own rules: selecting leaders, handling disagreement and explaining decisions to members. Criticism of exclusion at state level becomes more persuasive when the critic’s organization makes its own methods visible.

title.ht: Joanas Gué: sa kanpay kont fourmi 2007 la montre sou ijans agrikòl
title.en: Joanas Gué: what a 2007 ant campaign reveals about agricultural response

description.ht: Pwoblèm nan te deja evalye. Lajan ak entèvansyon te toujou ap tann. Se nan espas ant de moman sa yo nou ka egzamine jesyon an.
description.en: The problem had been assessed; resources and action were still being arranged. The gap between those stages is where management can be examined.

text.ht: Nan Septanm 2007, pandan fourmi t ap fè dega nan Limbé, Plaisance ak Pilate, Joanas Gué te sekretè deta Agrikilti. Radio Métropole rapòte li te anonse yon kanpay twa ane. Li te estime bezwen yo nan 100 milyon goud epi li te di yo te mete 50 milyon goud nan bidjè 2007–2008 la pou premye faz la.
text.en: In September 2007, as ants damaged communities in Limbé, Plaisance and Pilate, Joanas Gué was secretary of state for agriculture. Radio Métropole reported his announcement of a three-year campaign. He estimated needs at 100 million gourdes and said 50 million had been allocated in the 2007–2008 budget for its first phase.

text.ht: Detay ki pi revele a se te tan an. Dapre Gué, espesyalis ministè a te ale evalye pwoblèm nan yon ane anvan epi yo te prepare yon dokiman. Li te rekonèt reta a te fè sitiyasyon an vin pi grav. Majistra Plaisance la te fè yon lòt apèl ijan pou entèvansyon de semèn anvan nouvèl la.
text.en: The revealing detail was timing. Gué said ministry specialists had assessed the infestation a year earlier and produced a document. He acknowledged that delay had worsened the situation. Plaisance’s mayor had made another urgent appeal for intervention two weeks before the report.

text.ht: Pou yon fanmi k ap viv sou rekòt ak bèt li, yon evalyasyon pa ankò yon solisyon. Administrasyon an dwe fè dyagnostik la tounen desizyon, fè lajan an disponib epi verifye entèvansyon an mache. Epizòd sa a montre poukisa eksperyans nan yon ministè merite egzamine ak delè repons yo, pa sèlman ak kantite pwojè yo anonse.
text.en: For a household living from crops and livestock, assessment is not yet relief. An administration must turn diagnosis into decisions, release resources and check whether intervention works. This episode shows why ministry experience should be examined through response times as well as announced projects.

text.ht: Nouvèl 2007 la pa bay yon kont depans final oswa yon mezi rezilta kanpay la. Li pa pèmèt nou rele 50 milyon yo lajan ki te depanse, ni lajan ki te disparèt. Pou konplete bilan Gué sou dosye sa a, pyès ki konte yo se rapò entèvansyon, dat debousman ak evalyasyon sa ki te chanje pou zòn ki te afekte yo.
text.en: The 2007 report supplies neither final expenditure accounts nor measured campaign outcomes. It does not establish that the 50 million was spent or went missing. Completing Gué’s record on this episode requires intervention reports, disbursement dates and evidence of what changed in the affected areas.

title.ht: Munir Joseph Mourra: apre klinik mobil la fin pase, kiyès ki pran swen malad la?
title.en: Munir Joseph Mourra: who cares for the patient after the mobile clinic leaves?

description.ht: Manifès MPH a pwopoze lopital modèn, kowòdinasyon ONG ak klinik mobil. Defi a se fè twa zouti sa yo tounen yon sèvis ki kontinye.
description.en: MPH proposes modern hospitals, NGO coordination and mobile clinics. The challenge is making those tools work as a continuing service.

text.ht: Nan manifès MPH 2026 la, pati Munir Joseph Mourra a bay twa pwopozisyon presi pou sante: modènize sant ospitalye Inivèsite Leta d Ayiti yo, òganize yon rezo ONG pou pi byen kowòdone aksyon yo, epi ankouraje klinik mobil rive nan zòn ki pi lwen yo. Se mezi ki ekri nan pwogram pati a, pa sèvis nou verifye deja egziste.
text.en: MPH’s 2026 manifesto sets out three health measures: modernizing State University of Haiti hospital centres, creating an NGO coordination network and encouraging mobile clinics in remote areas. These are proposals by Munir Joseph Mourra’s party, not services verified as already delivered.

text.ht: Pwopozisyon yo ka konplete youn lòt. Yon klinik mobil ka pote yon premye konsiltasyon; yon lopital ka pran ka ki mande plis mwayen; yon rezo ka ede òganizasyon yo pa travay chak bò pa yo. Men koneksyon ant yo bezwen òganize menm jan ak chak sèvis apa.
text.en: The measures can complement one another. A mobile clinic can offer an initial consultation; a hospital can handle more demanding cases; a network can reduce fragmented work. The connections between services need organizing as carefully as each service itself.

text.ht: Pran yon egzanp imajinè: yon pasyan jwenn yon konsiltasyon nan yon komin lwen, men li bezwen yon egzamen nan yon lopital. Plan an dwe pèmèt li konnen kote pou ale, pri li pral peye ak moun ki pral suiv rezilta a. Sinon, premye konsiltasyon an ka ouvri yon pòt san li pa bay mwayen pou franchi pwochen an.
text.en: Consider a hypothetical patient seen in a remote commune who needs a hospital test. A working plan must identify where to go, what the patient pays and who follows the result. Otherwise, an initial consultation can open one door without providing a route through the next.

text.ht: Seksyon sante nou li a pa bay yon bidjè apa, yon kalandriye deplwaman oswa règ pou transfere pasyan ant sèvis yo. Sa pa pwouve lòt dokiman pa egziste. Men sa montre sa elektè yo poko ka mezire nan manifès la: konbyen komin ki pral jwenn sèvis regilye, ak kiyès ki responsab lè yon pasyan bezwen kontinye swen.
text.en: The reviewed health section gives no separate budget, rollout timetable or patient-referral rules. That does not establish that other documents do not exist. It identifies what voters cannot yet measure from this manifesto: how many communes receive regular service and who answers for continuity of care.

title.ht: Etzer Émile: yon bidjè ki rive ta, yon pwomès ki bezwen prèv
title.en: Etzer Émile: a late budget and promises needing evidence

description.ht: An 2020, ekonomis la te mande si kalandriye ak resèt Leta te anonse yo te kredib. Tès sa a kapab sèvi pou egzamine pwòp pwomès li yo.
description.en: In 2020, the economist questioned the credibility of the government’s timetable and revenue forecasts. The same test can examine his own promises.

text.ht: 10 Jen 2020, Juno7 te pibliye analiz Etzer Émile sou bidjè 2019–2020 a. Li te souliye yon pwoblèm senp: Konsèy Minis la te adopte bidjè a 5 Jen, tandiske ane li te dwe planifye a te kòmanse 1 Oktòb 2019 epi li t ap fini 30 Septanm 2020. Pifò ane a te deja pase.
text.en: On June 10, 2020, Juno7 published Etzer Émile’s analysis of the 2019–2020 budget. He highlighted a straightforward problem: cabinet adopted it on June 5 for a year running from October 1, 2019 to September 30, 2020. Most of the period being planned had already elapsed.

text.ht: Li te poze yon dezyèm kesyon: èske lajan yo prevwa a ap antre toutbon? Li te konpare ritm resèt ki te deja antre yo ak ritm pi rapid ki t ap nesesè pou rive nan objektif ane a. Li te mete an dout tou posiblite pou tout sipò entènasyonal yo te prevwa a rive anvan fen egzèsis la. Sa yo te kesyon sou previzyon yo, pa yon rapò sou rezilta final ane a.
text.en: He also tested whether forecast money would arrive. He compared revenue already collected with the faster pace needed to reach the annual target and questioned whether expected international support could arrive before year-end. These were challenges to forecasts, not findings about the year’s final results.

text.ht: Leson an fasil pou konprann: yon bidjè dwe di sa ou kapab fè ak lajan ki gen chans antre, nan tan ki rete a. Yon kantite ekri sou papye pa finanse yon lekòl oswa yon lopital poukont li. Diferans ant lajan ou espere, lajan ki antre ak lajan ou depanse dwe rete vizib.
text.en: The lesson is accessible: a budget must connect achievable work, likely income and available time. A figure on paper does not, by itself, finance a school or hospital. Expected revenue, actual receipts and spending must remain distinguishable.

text.ht: Pou Émile kòm kandida, analiz ansyen li a kreye yon estanda itil. Nenpòt pwomès li ta finanse ak nouvo resèt oswa èd etranje merite menm kesyon an: ki sous, ki delè, epi kisa ki chanje si lajan an pa rive? Kritik 2020 la pa pwouve pwogram aktyèl li finanse; li montre kijan pou egzamine finansman an.
text.en: For Émile as a candidate, his earlier analysis supplies a useful standard. Promises funded through new revenue or foreign assistance merit the same questions: which source, what timetable and what changes if the money fails to arrive? His 2020 criticism does not finance his current programme; it shows how to scrutinize its financing.

title.ht: Etzer Émile ak Kour Dèkont la: ki limit yon prezidan dwe aksepte?
title.en: Etzer Émile and the Court of Auditors: what limits should a president accept?

description.ht: Kritik li te fè an 2020 la pèmèt nou egzamine yon kesyon pouvwa: èske kontwòl ki deranje yon advèsè ta rete lè se ou ki dirije?
description.en: His 2020 criticism opens a question about power: should scrutiny that restrains an opponent remain when you take office?

text.ht: Nan Novanm 2020, Etzer Émile te kritike sevèman yon chanjman konsènan wòl konsiltatif Kour Siperyè Dèkont ak Kontansye Administratif la. Juno7 te rapòte li wè mezi a kòm yon atak sou demokrasi ak Leta de dwa. Pierre Espérance, responsab RNDDH, te kritike l tou pou risk li te wè sou kontwòl kontra piblik yo.
text.en: In November 2020, Etzer Émile strongly criticized a change affecting the consultative role of the Superior Court of Auditors and Administrative Disputes. Juno7 reported that he considered it an attack on democracy and the rule of law. RNDDH’s Pierre Espérance also warned about scrutiny of public contracts.

text.ht: Men menm atik la te rapòte yon lòt lekti legal. Espesyalis Claudie Marsan te soutni Konstitisyon an pa t bay kour la pouvwa pou bay apwobasyon sou pwojè kontra, epi li te ensiste sou wòl odit li. Kidonk, deba a pa t senpleman ant moun ki vle kontwòl ak moun ki pa vle kontwòl: li te konsène ki kontwòl, nan ki moman, ak anba ki baz legal.
text.en: The same article recorded a different legal interpretation. Specialist Claudie Marsan argued that the Constitution did not give the court authority to approve draft contracts and emphasized its audit role. The dispute concerned which checks apply, at what stage and under what legal authority.

text.ht: Pou piblik la, diferans tan an konte. Yon egzamen anvan yon kontra siyen ka anpeche yon pwoblèm. Yon odit apre lajan depanse ka etabli sa ki te fèt ak kiyès ki dwe reponn. Youn pa otomatikman ranplase tout sèvis lòt la. Sa se yon analiz sou konsepsyon kontwòl yo, pa yon desizyon tribinal sou dekrè a.
text.en: Timing matters to the public. Review before a contract is signed can prevent a problem. An audit after spending can establish what happened and who must answer. One does not automatically perform every function of the other. This is an analysis of oversight design, not a judicial ruling on the decree.

text.ht: Dosye a bay yon tès pou Émile kòm kandida: esplike ki verifikasyon yon administrasyon li ta dirije ta aksepte anvan kontra, apre depans ak lè yon rapò mete pwòp alye li an koz. Nou pa dedui yon pwogram legal aktyèl apati yon deklarasyon 2020. Nou sèvi ak pozisyon li te pran an pou mande yon angajman ki ka verifye.
text.en: For Émile as a candidate, the test is to specify what checks his administration would accept before contracting, after expenditure and when a report implicates its allies. A 2020 statement does not establish his current legal programme. It supplies a basis for seeking a verifiable commitment.

title.ht: Jocelerme Privert: sa ki te rive apre 120 jou yo
title.en: Jocelerme Privert: what happened after the 120 days

description.ht: An 2016, yon delè kout te vin tounen yon kriz sou kiyès ki te gen dwa kontinye dirije. Rapò epòk la ede separe responsablite yo.
description.en: In 2016, a short timetable became a dispute over continued authority. Contemporary reports help separate the responsibilities.

text.ht: 14 Fevriye 2016, Asanble Nasyonal la te eli Jocelerme Privert prezidan pwovizwa. Rapò ONU a bay 77 vòt pou li, kont 34 pou Edgard Leblanc. Akò politik ki te pèmèt Michel Martelly kite pouvwa a te prevwa yon prezidan pwovizwa pou pa plis pase 120 jou, ansanm ak yon kalandriye pou fini eleksyon yo.
text.en: On February 14, 2016, the National Assembly elected Jocelerme Privert provisional president, with 77 votes against Edgard Leblanc’s 34, according to the UN report. The political agreement enabling Michel Martelly’s departure provided for a provisional presidency lasting no more than 120 days and a timetable to complete elections.

text.ht: Plan an pa t mache nan tan yo te prevwa a. Fòmasyon gouvènman an te pran reta. Eleksyon 24 Avril la pa t fèt. Yon komisyon verifikasyon te egzamine eleksyon 2015 yo, epi KEP te deside rekòmanse eleksyon prezidansyèl la. Se te plizyè desizyon enstitisyon diferan, pa yon sèl desizyon Privert ki esplike tout reta a.
text.en: The timetable broke down. Government formation was delayed, the April 24 vote did not occur, a verification commission examined the 2015 election and the CEP decided to rerun the presidential contest. Several institutions made consequential decisions; the entire delay cannot be explained as one Privert decision.

text.ht: Rapò ONU 31 Out la di manda 120 jou a te fini 14 Jen. Malgre plizyè tantativ, Asanble Nasyonal la pa t rive vote sou fason pouvwa egzekitif la t ap kontinye fonksyone. Sekretè jeneral la te mande Asanble a pran desizyon sa yo. Sa dekri yon kesyon otorite politik ki poko rezoud; li pa yon desizyon tribinal ki valide yon pwolongasyon manda.
text.en: The August 31 UN report says the 120-day term expired June 14. Despite several attempts, the National Assembly had failed to vote on arrangements for continued executive governance. The Secretary-General urged it to act. That describes unresolved political authority, not a court ruling validating an extension.

text.ht: Pou elektè k ap egzamine retou Privert, kesyon an depase si eleksyon yo te finalman fèt. Li konsène sa yon dirijan fè lè delè pouvwa li rive: ki baz li bay pou rete, ki kontwòl li aksepte ak ki fason li ede sòti nan enpas la. Eksperyans tranzisyon an dwe egzamine sou toude plan sa yo: fini misyon an ak respekte limit li.
text.en: For voters assessing Privert’s return, the issue extends beyond whether elections eventually occurred. It concerns what a leader does when authority reaches its deadline: the basis for remaining, the scrutiny accepted and the route out of deadlock. A transition record involves both completing the mission and respecting its limits.

title.ht: Jude Célestin: soti nan bòykòt pou rive nan yon nouvo eleksyon
title.en: Jude Célestin: from boycott to a new election

description.ht: Konteste yon eleksyon, fè l rekòmanse ak genyen eleksyon an se twa bagay diferan. Kriz 2015–2016 la montre sa byen.
description.en: Challenging an election, obtaining a rerun and winning it are different outcomes. The 2015–2016 crisis illustrates the distinction.

text.ht: Nan rezilta premye tou Oktòb 2015 la, Jude Célestin te klase dezyèm dèyè Jovenel Moïse. Rapò ONU Mas 2016 la dekri kijan kanpay Célestin nan te rive bòykote dezyèm tou a apre kontestasyon sou kredibilite pwosesis la. Dezyèm tou ki te prevwa 24 Janvye 2016 la pa t fèt: KEP te sispann operasyon yo 22 Janvye, pandan li te site enkyetid pou sekirite.
text.en: Jude Célestin placed second behind Jovenel Moïse in the October 2015 first-round results. The UN’s March 2016 report describes his campaign’s subsequent runoff boycott amid challenges to the process’s credibility. The January 24 runoff did not occur: on January 22, the CEP suspended operations, citing security concerns.

text.ht: Yon lòt etap te vini anba prezidans pwovizwa Jocelerme Privert. Komisyon verifikasyon an te egzamine 3,235 sou 13,725 pwosè-vèbal biwo vòt yo. Dapre rapò ONU Out 2016 la, li te jwenn iregilarite grav ak sistematik epi li te rekòmande rekòmanse eleksyon an. Sa pa t yon rekontaj ki te deklare Célestin genyen.
text.en: Under provisional President Jocelerme Privert, a verification commission examined 3,235 of 13,725 polling-station result sheets. The August UN report says it found serious, systematic irregularities and recommended a rerun. That was not a recount declaring Célestin the winner.

text.ht: Obsèvatè entènasyonal yo pa t tout dakò sou repons lan. Rapò ekspètiz UE a raple misyon obsèvasyon 2015 li a te fèmen an Jen 2016 apre dezakò sou anilasyon premye tou a. Yon lòt misyon ekspè te suiv eleksyon 20 Novanm 2016 la, kote Jovenel Moïse te genyen nan premye tou. Célestin pa t transfòme kontestasyon an an viktwa elektoral.
text.en: International observers differed over the remedy. The EU expert report recalls that its 2015 observation mission closed in June 2016 following disagreement over annulment. A separate expert mission followed the November 20 election, won by Jovenel Moïse in the first round. Célestin’s successful challenge to the earlier process did not become an electoral victory.

text.ht: Pou evalye kandida a jodi a, de kesyon merite rete apa: ki mezi li te mande pou pwoteje vòt la, epi ki kapasite li te montre pou rasanble elektè? Yon bòykòt ka peze sou yon pwosesis san li pa pwouve tout akizasyon yo. Yon nouvo vòt ka rezoud kesyon gayan an san li pa efase pwoblèm ki te fè premye vòt la pèdi konfyans.
text.en: Two questions should remain separate when assessing the candidate: what safeguards did he demand, and how effectively did he mobilize voters? A boycott can pressure a process without proving every accusation. A rerun can determine a winner without erasing the problems that undermined confidence in the earlier vote.

title.ht: Tardieu ak Bodeau an 2019: pyès yo, vòt la ak sa li pa t tranche
title.en: Tardieu and Bodeau in 2019: the records, the vote and what it did not settle

description.ht: Yon deba sou miz an akizasyon Jovenel Moïse te rive nan yon vòt konteste. Rezilta politik la pa t yon jijman sou tout akizasyon finansye yo.
description.en: A debate over impeaching Jovenel Moïse ended in a disputed vote. Its political outcome did not adjudicate every financial allegation.

text.ht: Nan Out 2019, Jerry Tardieu te mande Gary Bodeau, prezidan Chanm Depite a, rann dokiman yo te mande yo disponib pou deba sou miz an akizasyon Prezidan Jovenel Moïse. Rezo Nòdwès rapòte Tardieu te di yon angajman pou bay pyès sa yo te fèt pandan wikenn nan. Se pozisyon li sou fason deba a te dwe prepare, pa prèv Bodeau te detwi oswa kache yon pyès presi.
text.en: In August 2019, Jerry Tardieu urged Lower Chamber president Gary Bodeau to make requested documents available for the debate on impeaching President Jovenel Moïse. Rezo Nòdwès reported Tardieu’s account of a weekend commitment to supply them. This establishes his procedural demand, not destruction or deliberate concealment of a specific record by Bodeau.

text.ht: Rapò ONU S/2019/805 mete fen istwa a nan kontèks: 22 Out, apre de premye seyans sou dosye a, mosyon an te jwenn 53 vòt kont, 3 pou ak 5 abstansyon. Rapò a note depite opozisyon yo te konteste legalite vòt la paske kantite prezan yo pa t rive nan kowòm 80 yo te mande a.
text.en: UN report S/2019/805 records the outcome: after two earlier sessions, the August 22 motion received 53 votes against, three in favour and five abstentions. It also records opposition deputies’ challenge to the vote’s legality because attendance fell below the 80-member quorum they invoked.

text.ht: Chif sa yo pa di nou ki vòt Tardieu te bay. Yo pa pèmèt nou ba li youn nan twa vòt pou yo san yon rejis nominatif. Yo pa reprezante nonplis yon jijman kriminèl ki te deklare tout tranzaksyon PetroCaribe yo regilye. Yon chanm ka rejte yon mosyon pandan kesyon sou prèv ak pwosedi yo rete san repons.
text.en: Those totals do not identify Tardieu’s individual vote. Assigning him one of the three affirmative votes would require a named voting record. Nor was this a criminal judgment declaring every PetroCaribe transaction proper. A chamber can reject a motion while evidentiary and procedural questions remain unresolved.

text.ht: Pou de ansyen depite ki vin kandida, epizòd la bay de mezi diferan. Tardieu ka rann kont sou dokiman li te chèche ak fason li te suiv dosye a. Bodeau ka rann kont sou fason biwo li te òganize aksè ak deba a. Sa mande tras desizyon yo, olye sèlman pozisyon chak moun te anonse an piblik.
text.en: For two former deputies now seeking office, the episode offers distinct tests. Tardieu can account for the records he sought and his follow-through. Bodeau can account for how his bureau organized access and debate. That requires decision records alongside public statements.

title.ht: Claude Joseph an Jiyè 2021: pouvwa ijans ak transfè pouvwa
title.en: Claude Joseph in July 2021: emergency power and a handover

description.ht: Apre asasina Jovenel Moïse, te gen yon kesyon imedya sou kiyès ki t ap dirije. Suiv etap yo ede egzamine bilan politik Joseph san konfonn li ak dosye kriminèl la.
description.en: After Jovenel Moïse’s assassination, executive authority became an immediate question. Following the sequence allows scrutiny of Joseph’s political record without conflating it with the criminal case.

text.ht: 7 Jiyè 2021, apre asasina Prezidan Jovenel Moïse, kabinè ki te dirije pa Premye Minis enterimè Claude Joseph la te pran mezi ijans. Rapò ONU S/2021/828 di gouvènman an te envoke atik 149 Konstitisyon amande a epi li te deklare yon eta dijans 15 jou. Mezi yo te gen ladan mobilizasyon fòs sekirite, fouy, arestasyon ak restriksyon sou antre ak sòti nan peyi a.
text.en: After President Jovenel Moïse’s assassination on July 7, 2021, the caretaker cabinet headed by interim Prime Minister Claude Joseph adopted emergency measures. UN report S/2021/828 says it invoked article 149 of the amended Constitution and declared a 15-day emergency, including security-force mobilization, searches, arrests and restrictions on movement into and out of the country.

text.ht: Men Ariel Henry te deja nonmen pou ranplase Joseph anvan asasina a, san li pa t ankò antre an fonksyon. Rapò a dekri yon dezakò inisyal sou direksyon pouvwa a. Henry ak kabinè li a te antre an fonksyon 20 Jiyè. Joseph te rete minis Afè Etranjè ak Kilt. Kidonk, kite pòs premye minis la pa t vle di li te kite tout gouvènman an tousuit.
text.en: Ariel Henry had already been designated to replace Joseph before the assassination but had not taken office. The report describes initial differences over executive leadership. Henry and his cabinet took office July 20; Joseph remained foreign minister. Giving up the premiership therefore did not mean immediately leaving government altogether.

text.ht: Gen de kesyon politik nan epizòd sa a. Premye a se kijan yon dirijan sèvi ak pouvwa ijans lè peyi a anba chòk. Dezyèm nan se kijan li jere transfè pouvwa a lè yo konteste otorite li. Pou egzamine yo, fòk nou gade desizyon, dire mezi yo ak kontwòl ki te fèt sou yo.
text.en: The episode raises two political questions: how a leader uses emergency powers during national shock, and how he handles a handover when authority is contested. Assessing both requires the decisions themselves, their duration and the scrutiny applied to them.

text.ht: Rapò ONU a se yon tras evènman politik yo, pa yon jijman ki apwouve legalite chak mezi. Dirije kabinè a apre asasina a pa pwouve Joseph te patisipe nan asasina a. Nou egzamine isit la aksyon yon responsab nan pouvwa; nenpòt akizasyon kriminèl mande pwòp prèv ak swivi jidisyè pa li.
text.en: The UN report records political events; it is not a judgment approving every measure’s legality. Heading the cabinet after the assassination does not establish participation in it. This examines a public official’s actions in office; criminal allegations require their own evidence and procedural follow-up.

title.ht: Jerry Tardieu ak gouvènè yo: otonomi pa vle di san kontwòl
title.en: Jerry Tardieu and governors: autonomy still needs accountability

description.ht: Deba 2025 la pa sèlman konsène mo « federal ». Li konsène kiyès ki jere lajan depatman yo ak kiyès ki ka mande kont.
description.en: The 2025 dispute reaches beyond the word “federal.” It concerns who manages departmental money and who can demand accounts.

text.ht: 26 Me 2025, Juno7 rapòte Jerry Tardieu te kritike pwopozisyon pou gouvènè depatmantal yo nan avan-pwojè Konstitisyon an. Li te pè rivalite ant gouvènè ak prezidan, depatman ki pa gen ase resous ak yon sistèm ki koute chè. Li te dekri direksyon an kòm federalis. Se analiz politik li sou pwojè a.
text.en: On May 26, 2025, Juno7 reported Jerry Tardieu’s criticism of proposed departmental governors in the draft constitution. He warned of rivalry with the president, unequal departmental resources and expensive administration. He characterized the direction as federalist. That was his political interpretation.

text.ht: Nan kopi avan-pwojè Me 2025 la ki sou sit KEP la, atik 68 bay depatman yo otonomi administratif ak finansye. Atik 68-2 prevwa yon gouvènè eli pou senk ane, ki ka reeli san limit. Sa bay yon baz konkrè pou deba sou konsantrasyon pouvwa nan nivo depatman yo.
text.en: In the CEP-hosted copy of the May 2025 draft, article 68 gives departments administrative and financial autonomy. Article 68-2 provides for governors elected for five years with unlimited reelection. That supplies a concrete basis for debating concentration of power at departmental level.

text.ht: Men otonomi a pa ekri kòm absans tout kontwòl. Atik 68-6 mande kolaborasyon ak administrasyon santral la pou plan devlopman an. Atik 68-8 mande gouvènè a rann kont bay Asanble Depatmantal la epi rapòte bay administrasyon santral la. Tèks la prevwa tou yon wòl pou Kour Dèkont nan ka ki ka mennen nan destitisyon.
text.en: Autonomy is not written as an absence of scrutiny. Article 68-6 requires collaboration with the central administration on development plans. Article 68-8 requires accountability to the departmental assembly and reporting to the central administration. The text also gives the Court of Auditors a role in grounds for removal.

text.ht: Nou pa prezante avan-pwojè sa a kòm lwa ki an vigè. Men lekti li chanje kesyon an: èske kontwòl yo ta mache, epi ki règ ki ta anpeche yon depatman pòv rete dèyè? Pou egzamine pozisyon Tardieu, fòk nou mande altènativ li sou pataj resous ak kontwòl lokal. Rete nan yon Leta initè pa reponn kesyon sa yo poukont li.
text.en: This draft is not presented as law in force. Reading it sharpens the question: would its checks work, and what rules would keep poorer departments from falling behind? Scrutinizing Tardieu’s position requires his alternative for resource-sharing and local accountability. Retaining a unitary state does not, by itself, answer those questions.

title.ht: Wilson Jeudy an 2016: kat milyon nan kès, plis pase 18 milyon salè
title.en: Wilson Jeudy in 2016: four million in cash, more than 18 million in payroll

description.ht: Yon konparezon senp montre pwoblèm li te dekri a. Men li pa pwouve kiyès ki te responsab ni kote tout lajan an te ale.
description.en: A simple comparison explains the problem he described. It does not establish responsibility or trace every gourde.

text.ht: Lè Wilson Jeudy retounen kòm majistra Delmas an Jen 2016, li te deklare administrasyon an te an fayit. Dapre Radio Métropole, li te di kès la te gen sèlman 4 milyon goud pandan salè yon mwa te depase 18 milyon. Li te mete move sitiyasyon an sou jesyon ajan enterimè ki te ranplase l yo. Se akizasyon Jeudy, pa yon konklizyon odit nou verifye.
text.en: Returning as Delmas mayor in June 2016, Wilson Jeudy described the administration as bankrupt. Radio Métropole reported his statement that only four million gourdes remained in the treasury against monthly payroll exceeding 18 million. He blamed interim administrators. That was Jeudy’s allegation, not a verified audit conclusion.

text.ht: Si de chif sa yo egzak, lajan disponib la te mwens pase yon ka salè yon mwa. Diferans lan te plis pase 14 milyon goud, anvan menm lòt depans yo. Se yon fason konkrè pou wè kriz likidite li te dekri a: administrasyon an pa t gen ase lajan disponib pou peye angajman imedya li yo.
text.en: If those figures were accurate, available cash covered less than one quarter of one month’s payroll. The gap exceeded 14 million gourdes before other expenses. That makes his reported cash-flow crisis concrete: funds on hand could not meet the immediate obligation.

text.ht: Jeudy te site tou plis pase 400 milyon goud resèt pou ane anvan an. Men konpare tout resèt yon ane ak sa ki rete nan yon jou pa pwouve tout diferans lan disparèt. Fòk depans, dèt, dat peman ak lòt kont yo antre nan kalkil la. Sinon, yon gwo chif ka fè yon akizasyon san li pa esplike kont yo.
text.en: Jeudy also cited revenue exceeding 400 million gourdes for the preceding year. Comparing a year’s receipts with one day’s remaining balance does not prove the difference disappeared. Expenditure, debts, payment dates and other accounts must be reconciled. Otherwise a large number can accuse without explaining the accounts.

text.ht: Li te anonse mete prèske tout anplwaye yo an disponiblite pou restriktire administrasyon an. Pou egzamine bilan li kòm kandida prezidansyèl, pyès ki ta fè diferans lan se kont lè li te kite ak lè li te retounen, ansanm ak rezilta restriktirasyon an. Yon bon dyagnostik finansye se premye etap la; kapasite pou repare sèvis yo bezwen pwòp prèv pa li.
text.en: He announced placing nearly all employees on standby while restructuring. Assessing his presidential credentials requires handover accounts and the restructuring’s results. Diagnosing financial distress is a first step; restoring public services requires its own evidence.

title.ht: René St-Fort: menm pwogram lekòl, men ki mwayen pou anseye l?
title.en: René St-Fort: a common curriculum needs the means to teach it

description.ht: Pwopozisyon li sou lekòl yo mete de kesyon ansanm: sa timoun yo dwe aprann ak kondisyon moun ki dwe anseye yo.
description.en: His education proposals connect two issues: what children should learn and the conditions of those who teach them.

text.ht: Nan yon entèvyou Vant Bèf Info pibliye 15 Me 2026, avoka ak pwofesè René St Fort te mande inifòmize pwogram lekòl yo ak amelyore kalite ansèyman. Li te denonse tou salè pwofesè ki pa regilye epi ki pa sifi. VBI te idantifye l kòm dirijan Pati Refòmis Nasyonal la nan yon entèvyou apa an Mas.
text.en: In a May 15, 2026 Vant Bèf Info interview, lawyer and teacher René St Fort called for common school curricula and improved teaching quality. He also criticized irregular and insufficient teachers’ pay. A separate March VBI interview identified him as a National Reformist Party leader.

text.ht: Gen yon koneksyon enpòtan ant de lide yo. Menm lis leson an pa bay tout elèv menm chans si pwofesè yo pa jwenn fòmasyon, materyèl oswa salè alè. Yon règleman sou sa pou anseye bezwen yon plan pou moun ki pral anseye l. Sinon, inifòmite a ka rete sou papye.
text.en: The two ideas are connected. A common lesson list cannot give pupils equal opportunity if teachers lack training, materials or timely pay. Rules about what to teach need a plan for the people delivering it. Otherwise standardization can remain on paper.

text.ht: Pran de lekòl imajinè ki sèvi ak menm pwogram nan. Youn gen pwofesè ki prezan tout semèn nan ak liv pou elèv yo; lòt la ap pèdi jou klas. De lekòl yo ka respekte menm dokiman pandan timoun yo pa jwenn menm ansèyman. Se poutèt sa kantite jou klas ak pwogrè elèv yo konte ansanm ak tèks pwogram nan.
text.en: Consider two hypothetical schools following the same curriculum. One has teachers throughout the week and books for pupils; the other repeatedly loses teaching days. Both may follow the same document while delivering different opportunities. Teaching days and pupils’ progress therefore matter alongside the curriculum itself.

text.ht: Entèvyou a pa bay yon bidjè oswa yon kalandriye pou pwopozisyon sa yo. Sa pa fè lide yo san valè. Sa defini pwochen nivo detay yon kandida dwe bay: ki lekòl ki jwenn sipò an premye, kijan salè yo ap rive alè ak ki rezilta ki pral mezire. Se la yon mesaj pou onore pwofesè ka tounen yon pwogram piblik ki ka egzamine.
text.en: The interview gives no budget or timetable. That does not invalidate the ideas; it identifies the detail needed next: which schools receive support first, how payroll becomes reliable and which outcomes are measured. That is how a tribute to teachers can become a public programme voters can assess.

title.ht: René St-Fort ak 30,000 sipòtè yo: non yon sitwayen pa yon siyati an blan
title.en: René St-Fort and 30,000 supporters: a citizen’s name is not a blank signature

description.ht: Kontestasyon PRN lan louvri yon deba sou konsantman. Pwoteje dwa verifye yon non pa oblije ekspoze tout chwa politik moun.
description.en: PRN’s challenge opens a debate about consent. Enabling verification need not expose everyone’s political choices.

text.ht: 16 Septanm 2026, Vant Bèf Info rapòte PRN, atravè avoka René St-Fort ak Roger Balthazar, te mande KEP sispann oswa anile pwosesis elektoral la. Youn nan pwen li te konteste yo se kondisyon 30,000 manm, aderan oswa senpatizan pou yon estrikti politik. Pati a te mande piblikasyon lis yo pou sitwayen verifye si non yo te sèvi san konsantman yo.
text.en: On September 16, 2026, Vant Bèf Info reported that PRN, through lawyers René St-Fort and Roger Balthazar, sought suspension or cancellation of the electoral process. It challenged the 30,000-member, adherent or supporter condition and requested publication of lists so citizens could check for use of their names without consent.

text.ht: Somasyon an pa yon jijman. Li pa pwouve tout lis yo fo, ni tout moun pati a site te viktim fwod. Men kesyon konsantman an merite yon repons apa ak batay sou kantite sipòtè yo: èske yon moun ka jwenn konnen si yon pati konte l kòm sipòtè, epi konteste sa fasil?
text.en: A formal demand is not a judgment. It does not prove that every list is false or every person mentioned suffered fraud. Consent nevertheless deserves an answer distinct from the threshold dispute: can a citizen discover and challenge a party’s claim to their support?

text.ht: Pozisyon nou se pou verifikasyon sa a sèvi sitwayen an san li pa fòse tout moun ekspoze afilyasyon politik yo devan tout piblik la. Yon moun dwe kapab verifye pwòp non li, jwenn yon repons ak fè korije yon enskripsyon li pa t otorize. Sa mande tou yon tras sou fason pati a te jwenn konsantman li.
text.en: Our view is that verification should serve citizens without forcing everyone’s political affiliation into public view. People should be able to check their own entry, receive an answer and correct unauthorized enrolment. Parties should also retain evidence of how consent was obtained.

text.ht: Pou St-Fort kòm kandida, bon mezi a se aplike menm prensip la nan pwòp pati li. Konbyen moun pa sifi kòm repons; ki jan yo te dakò konte yo enpòtan tou. Transparans ki pwoteje sitwayen dwe pèmèt konteste yon fo lyen politik san li pa kreye yon nouvo danje pou moun nan.
text.en: For St-Fort as a candidate, the test is applying the same principle within his own party. A total is insufficient without explaining how people agreed to be counted. Transparency should let citizens challenge false political affiliation without creating a new danger for them.

title.ht: Hans Joseph: depa nan ULCC, reklamasyon endepandans ak prèv ki nesesè
title.en: Hans Joseph: leaving ULCC and claiming independence

description.ht: Ansyen direktè a bay yon eksplikasyon sou revokasyon li. Eksplikasyon yon moun ak kòz yon desizyon ki pwouve pa menm bagay.
description.en: The former director offers an explanation for his dismissal. His account and a proven motive are different things.

text.ht: Nan yon entèvyou AyiboPost pibliye 5 Jiyè 2026, Hans Ludwig Joseph te pale sou depa li nan tèt ULCC, kote li te dirije depi 2020. AyiboPost rapòte Goethie Varnelle Morency te enstale 3 Jiyè pou ranplase l. Se poutèt sa bilan ULCC Joseph prezante nan kanpay li a se bilan yon ansyen direktè.
text.en: In a July 5, 2026 AyiboPost interview, Hans Ludwig Joseph discussed leaving ULCC, which he had led since 2020. AyiboPost reported that Goethie Varnelle Morency was installed July 3 to replace him. Joseph’s campaign record is therefore that of a former director.

text.ht: Joseph te di revokasyon an te vini apre yon prezantasyon devan Konsèy Sekirite ONU a kote li te kritike dekrè sou Wo Kour Jistis la. Li te di tou pa t gen reyinyon travay ak Primati a depi Alix Didier Fils-Aimé antre an fonksyon an Novanm 2024. Sa yo se deklarasyon li bay AyiboPost, pa evènman Ayiti Sitwayen te obsève nan yon reyinyon fèmen.
text.en: Joseph said his removal followed a Security Council presentation in which he criticized the High Court of Justice decree. He also said no working meetings had occurred with the Prime Minister’s Office since Alix Didier Fils-Aimé took office in November 2024. These are his statements to AyiboPost, not events Ayiti Sitwayen witnessed in a closed meeting.

text.ht: Kalandriye sa a ka pouse moun mande si kritik li yo te jwe yon wòl. Li pa pwouve motif revokasyon an poukont li. Pou etabli yon relasyon dirèk, fòk gen desizyon, kominikasyon oswa lòt prèv ki mare kritik la ak depa a. San sa, nou ta fè yon siksesyon dat tounen yon konklizyon sou entansyon.
text.en: The sequence warrants asking whether his criticism played a role. Timing alone does not prove the dismissal’s motive. Establishing a direct connection requires decisions, communications or other evidence linking criticism and removal. Otherwise chronology becomes an unsupported conclusion about intent.

text.ht: Pou elektè yo, pi gwo tès endepandans lan se sa yon Joseph ki rive sou pouvwa a ta garanti lòt moun. Ki libète yon òganis kontwòl ta genyen pou egzamine alye li? Ki eksplikasyon piblik ki ta mache ak chanjman dirijan yo? Yon reklamasyon endepandans vin pi fò lè li tounen règ ki pwoteje enstitisyon an menm lè chèf li chanje.
text.en: For voters, the larger independence test concerns what Joseph would guarantee others if elected. How freely could oversight bodies examine his allies? What public explanation would accompany leadership changes? A claim of independence becomes stronger when translated into rules protecting an institution across changes of leadership.

title.ht: Deus Deronneth: tann sekirite, men tann jouk ki lè?
title.en: Deus Deronneth: waiting for security, but until when?

description.ht: Kritik li sou chanjman règ elektoral yo soulve yon difikilte reyèl: pwoteje votè yo san kite tranzisyon an san bout.
description.en: His criticism of changing electoral rules raises a real difficulty: protecting voters while keeping the transition time-bound.

text.ht: 10 Oktòb 2026, Deus Deronneth te kritike revizyon repete règ elektoral yo. Dapre Rezo Nòdwès, li te mande yon delè reyalis pou retabli sekirite anvan yo fikse kalandriye eleksyon an. Li te mande tou pou gouvènman Alix Didier Fils-Aimé a gen yon dire ki byen defini, objektif ki klè ak rezilta ki ka mezire.
text.en: On October 10, 2026, Deus Deronneth criticized repeated revisions to electoral rules. Rezo Nòdwès reports that he sought a realistic security-restoration timetable before fixing the election calendar, alongside a defined duration, objectives and measurable results for Alix Didier Fils-Aimé’s government.

text.ht: Sa mete de nesesite ansanm. Yon dat pou vote pa itil yon moun ki pa ka rive nan biwo vòt la an sekirite. Men si « sekirite anvan » pa gen okenn kritè, otorite yo ka toujou di kondisyon yo poko reyini. Menm prensip ki vle pwoteje eleksyon an ka vin sèvi pou ranvwaye l san fen.
text.en: Two needs are intertwined. A polling date does little for someone unable to reach a station safely. Yet “security first” without defined criteria allows authorities to say conditions are never ready. A principle meant to protect an election can become a reason for indefinite delay.

text.ht: Yon fason pou egzamine pwopozisyon an se mande desizyon presi: ki kondisyon ki dwe reyini pou biwo vòt ouvri, kiyès ki verifye yo ak ki solisyon ki genyen pou moun ki deplase? Sa yo se kritè nou pwopoze pou evalyasyon an; nou pa prezante yo kòm yon plan Deronneth deja pibliye.
