text.en: A useful assessment would specify the conditions required to open polling stations, who verifies them and the arrangements for displaced voters. These are proposed evaluation criteria, not a plan attributed to Deronneth.

text.ht: Kritik Deronneth la gen pwa sitou kote li mande otorite yo mare tan ak rezilta. Menm estanda a dwe sèvi pou nenpòt lòt tranzisyon li ta soutni: yon manda presi, etap piblik ak yon fason pou mande kont si yo pa respekte yo. Chanje ekip la pa rezoud pwoblèm nan si règ sou dire pouvwa a rete flou.
text.en: Deronneth’s criticism is strongest where it connects time to results. The same standard should apply to any alternative transition he supports: a defined mandate, public milestones and accountability for missed commitments. Replacing personnel does not resolve an unclear limit on power.

title.ht: Michelet Nestor: orijin modès, gwo pwomès ak kesyon bilan an
title.en: Michelet Nestor: modest origins, big promises and the record

description.ht: Yon pòtrè 2015 montre istwa sosyal li te pote nan politik. Istwa lavi a bay kontèks; li pa ranplase prèv sou jesyon.
description.en: A 2015 profile records the social story accompanying his political entry. A life story provides context; it does not replace evidence of management.

text.ht: Lè Michelet Nestor te kandida an 2015, yon pòtrè Marian Tupy pibliye sou sit Cato Institute te dekri l kòm pitit yon machann nan lari ak yon anplwaye kay, ki te grandi nan yon zòn Pòtoprens san dlo potab ak latrin. Otè a, ki te fè entèvyou ak li, te prezante l kòm yon antreprenè ki te dirije yon konpayi rekritman anplwaye ak inisyativ edikatif.
text.en: During Michelet Nestor’s 2015 candidacy, an interview-based profile by Marian Tupy, published by Cato Institute, described him as the child of a street vendor and a domestic worker, raised in a Port-au-Prince neighbourhood without potable water or latrines. It presented him as an entrepreneur leading a staffing business and educational initiatives.

text.ht: Nan menm tèks la, Nestor te mete aksan sou kontwòl finans piblik ak kapasite sitwayen, laprès ak dyaspora a pou suiv sa gouvènman an fè. Sa te mare de mesaj: li konnen lavi moun ki pa gen mwayen, epi li vle yon Leta ki rann kont. Sa yo se angajman politik li te eksprime, pa rezilta yon manda prezidansyèl.
text.en: In that account, Nestor emphasized fiscal accountability and public, press and diaspora scrutiny of government. The message connected lived deprivation with a promise of answerable government. Those were political commitments, not results from a presidential term.

text.ht: Orijin yon kandida ka ede konprann sa li chwazi mete devan. Men soti nan povrete pa garanti yon moun pral byen jere lajan piblik, menm jan soti nan yon fanmi rich pa pwouve koripsyon. Se aksyon, enterè ekonomik ak règ kontwòl ki dwe pèmèt elektè yo fè diferans lan.
text.en: A candidate’s origins can illuminate priorities. Growing up poor does not guarantee sound public financial management, just as a wealthy family does not establish corruption. Actions, economic interests and accountability arrangements must allow voters to judge.

text.ht: Kopi rejis KEP nou verifye a mete Nestor anba DPA pou eleksyon aktyèl yo. Retou sa a pèmèt yon kesyon sou tan ki pase a: ki travay ak prèv piblik ki soutni pwomès transparans 2015 yo jodi a? Pòtrè a se yon pwen depa pou ankèt sou pakou li, pa yon dosye konplè sou fanmi, byen oswa reyalizasyon li.
text.en: The reviewed CEP registry places Nestor under DPA in the current election process. His return invites scrutiny of the intervening years: what public work and records support those earlier transparency commitments today? The profile begins an examination of his background; it is not a complete record of family, assets or achievements.

title.ht: Nestor, Savary ak DPA: yon lansman pa t fikse tout afilyasyon yo
title.en: Nestor, Savary and DPA: a launch did not settle every affiliation

description.ht: Dokiman ki gen dat diferan montre poukisa li pa sifi pou wè yon moun nan yon aktivite pou di ki pati li reprezante.
description.en: Dated records show why appearing at a political event does not, by itself, establish someone’s eventual party affiliation.

text.ht: Nan rapò 1 Oktòb 2026 li sou lansman Debout Patriotes, Le Facteur Haïti te site Savannah Savary pami figi yo te prezante yo. Menm atik la te dekri Michelet Mike Nestor kòm yon kandida prezidansyèl yo te anvizaje, pandan li te presize chwa final la te poko fèt. Lansman an te fèt 30 Septanm nan Petyonvil.
text.en: Le Facteur Haïti’s October 1, 2026 report on the Debout Patriotes launch named Savannah Savary among figures presented. It described Michelet Mike Nestor as a prospective presidential candidate while expressly saying selection was not yet final. The launch took place September 30 in Pétion-Ville.

text.ht: Apre sa, Kayimit News te rapòte DPA te chwazi Nestor pa konsansis 2 Novanm, epi li te enskri 13 Novanm. Nan kopi rejis KEP nou verifye 14 Novanm nan, Nestor parèt anba DPA, tandiske Savary parèt anba HAMAD. Sa bay yon estati pi resan pase yon lis envite oswa kandida yo te anvizaje nan yon seremoni.
text.en: Kayimit News later reported DPA’s consensus selection of Nestor on November 2 and his registration on November 13. In the November 14 CEP snapshot, Nestor appears under DPA and Savary under HAMAD. Those records are later than a launch’s list of featured or prospective candidates.

text.ht: Dokiman sa yo pa pwouve Savary te kite DPA apre yon konfli. Yo pa pwouve nonplis Nestor ak Savary pa gen okenn relasyon politik ankò. Yo pa bay tout kontra oswa akò ant òganizasyon yo. Sa yo etabli se yon diferans ant prezans nan yon aktivite, yon chwa andedan pati ak estrikti ki parèt nan enskripsyon an.
text.en: These records do not establish that Savary left DPA following a dispute or that she and Nestor have no continuing political relationship. They do not supply every interparty agreement. They establish distinctions between appearing at an event, internal selection and the structure recorded at registration.

text.ht: Pou elektè yo, diferans lan itil: se pa sèlman kiyès ki sou estrad la ki konte. Fòk yo kapab konnen ki òganizasyon ki bay kandida a manda li, ki pwogram li angaje l respekte ak kiyès ki ka mande l kont. Yon koneksyon politik merite suiv; li pa dwe envante apati prezans yon jou sèlman.
text.en: For voters, the distinction matters. Beyond who shares a stage, they need to know which organization mandates a candidate, which programme binds them and who can hold them answerable. Political relationships deserve examination through records extending beyond one public appearance.

title.ht: René St-Fort: lè yon moun deplase, vòt li pa dwe disparèt
title.en: René St-Fort: displacement should not erase a vote

description.ht: Pozisyon li sou enskripsyon elektè yo mete aksan sou yon baryè fasil pou bliye: biwo a ka rete louvri pandan sitwayen an pa ka rive ladan.
description.en: His registration position highlights an easily missed barrier: an office can remain open while the citizen cannot reach it.

text.ht: 16 Mas 2026, René St-Fort te di Vant Bèf Info li te soutni demach KEP pou ale jwenn elektè yo. Dirijan PRN lan te souliye moun vyolans fòse kite lakay yo pa fasil jwenn sèvis enskripsyon kote yo ye kounye a. Li te mande atansyon pou zòn ki lwen yo tou.
text.en: On March 16, 2026, René St-Fort told Vant Bèf Info he supported CEP outreach to voters. The PRN leader emphasized registration barriers for people displaced by violence and called for attention to remote areas.

text.ht: Pwen li a depase distans. Yon pwosesis ka egziste ofisyèlman san li pa aksesib an pratik. Pou yon fanmi ki te kouri kite kay li, enfòmasyon sou kote pou ale ak posibilite deplase an sekirite ka konte menm jan ak lè biwo a ouvri. Sa se yon analiz sou aksè, pa yon deskripsyon ka yon fanmi nou te entèvyouve.
text.en: The point extends beyond distance. A procedure may formally exist while remaining inaccessible in practice. For a displaced household, knowing where to go and being able to travel safely can matter as much as office hours. This is an access analysis, not the account of a family interviewed by us.

text.ht: Sa bay yon tès presi pou nenpòt plan: èske li rive jwenn moun ki deplase yo, oswa li sèlman konte moun ki te deja kapab deplase poukont yo? Yon total enskripsyon pa reponn kesyon sa a si li pa montre ki gwoup ak ki zòn sèvis la rive touche.
text.en: That suggests a concrete test: does a plan reach displaced people, or mainly count those already able to travel independently? A registration total cannot answer without showing which groups and locations the service reaches.

text.ht: Deklarasyon St-Fort la pa yon plan operasyonèl ak pri, wout ak delè. Li etabli yon priyorite li te defann. Pou evalye l kòm kandida, elektè yo kapab mande kijan pwòp pati li ap ede moun konprann pwosedi a, san li pa mare sèvis sivik ak yon obligasyon pou soutni pati a.
text.en: St-Fort’s statement is not a costed operational plan. It establishes a priority he defended. Voters can ask how his own party helps people understand the process while keeping civic assistance independent of any obligation to support the party.

title.ht: Dominique Dupuy: apre kondanasyon depòtasyon yo, ki pwoteksyon?
title.en: Dominique Dupuy: after condemning deportations, what protection followed?

description.ht: Yon kominike ofisyèl 2024 montre misyon diplomatik yo te konfye li a. Bilan an bezwen suiv sa ki te rive moun yo apre sa.
description.en: A 2024 official communiqué records the diplomatic task assigned to her. Assessing the record requires following what happened to the people affected.

text.ht: 8 Oktòb 2024, Prezidans ayisyen an pibliye yon bilan alarman: ONM te konte 5,323 moun repatriye ant 4 ak 7 Oktòb, pami yo 140 timoun. Kominike a di Konsèy Prezidansyèl la te konfye Minis Afè Etranjè Dominique Dupuy demach diplomatik pou defann dwa ak diyite moun sa yo.
text.en: On October 8, 2024, Haiti’s presidency published ONM’s count of 5,323 people repatriated between October 4 and 7, including 140 children. Its communiqué says the Presidential Council assigned Foreign Minister Dominique Dupuy diplomatic work to protect their rights and dignity.

text.ht: Sa ede mete responsablite yo an plas. ONM te pote done sou resepsyon moun yo. Konsèy la te bay direksyon politik. Dupuy te resevwa misyon diplomatik la. Nou pa ka atribye tout desizyon yon lòt Leta oswa tout sèvis ki te dwe fèt sou fwontyè a ak minis Afè Etranjè ayisyen an sèlman.
text.en: The record separates responsibilities. ONM supplied reception data, the council gave political direction and Dupuy received the diplomatic assignment. Decisions by another state and every service at the border cannot all be assigned solely to Haiti’s foreign minister.

text.ht: Men gen yon lyen ki dwe egzamine ant demach aletranje ak swivi anndan peyi a. Ki plent yo te dokimante? Ki repons otorite dominiken yo te bay? Ki aranjman ki te ede fanmi yo, sitou timoun yo, apre yo rive? Se kesyon pou mezire pwoteksyon an, olye sèlman fòs yon deklarasyon piblik.
text.en: Diplomatic action and domestic follow-through nevertheless need connecting. Which complaints were documented? How did Dominican authorities respond? What arrangements helped families, particularly children, after arrival? These are measures of protection beyond the strength of a public statement.

text.ht: Kominike a pa bay rezilta final demach Dupuy yo, epi li pa yon desizyon tribinal sou tout depòtasyon yo. Pou egzamine kandida a, fòk yon bilan konpare travay li te gen pouvwa fè, sa li te mande ak chanjman ki ka verifye. Pran pozisyon pou diyite moun enpòtan; montre kijan pozisyon an te tounen pwoteksyon se pwochen etap la.
text.en: The communiqué does not establish the final outcomes of Dupuy’s diplomacy or adjudicate every deportation. Assessing the candidate requires comparing her authority, her requests and verifiable changes. Defending dignity matters; demonstrating how that position became protection is the next evidentiary step.

title.ht: Jacky Lumarque ak Mouka: kite yon zouti piblik dèyè pawòl yo
title.en: Jacky Lumarque and Mouka: a public resource behind the speech

description.ht: Yon diskou 2023 sou dwa fanm montre yon aksyon ki ka verifye. Li bay yon egzanp pou egzamine bilan yon rektè ki vin kandida.
description.en: A 2023 address on women’s rights points to a verifiable institutional action. It offers a way to examine the record of a rector seeking office.

text.ht: 9 Mas 2023, Jacky Lumarque te pale sou fanm ki pote chay fanmi yo pandan vyolans fòse moun deplase. Nan diskou li a, rektè Inivèsite Quisqueya a te prezante Mouka kòm yon espas dokimantè sou jan ak dwa fanm ayisyen, ak rechèch piblik la te dwe kapab jwenn gratis sou entènèt.
text.en: On March 9, 2023, Jacky Lumarque discussed women carrying family burdens amid forced displacement. In that address, the Université Quisqueya rector presented Mouka as an online documentary resource on gender and Haitian women’s rights, with research intended to be freely accessible.

text.ht: Nou kapab tcheke omwen yon pati nan anons lan. Sit mouka.ht aksesib epi li prezante fich rechèch, piblikasyon ak dosye tematik sou dwa fanm. Sa bay yon rezilta enstitisyonèl ki pi presi pase yon fraz jeneral sou angajman. Sa pa vle di Lumarque te fè travay la poukont li; se yon resous ki soti nan travay kolektif.
text.en: At least part of that announcement is verifiable. Mouka.ht is accessible and presents research records, publications and thematic resources on women’s rights. This is a more specific institutional output than a general declaration of commitment. It does not mean Lumarque produced it alone; the resource represents collective work.

text.ht: Men egzistans resous la ak enpak li se de mezi diferan. Yon bibliyotèk kapab itil san nou pa deja konnen konbyen pwofesè, etidyan oswa òganizasyon ki sèvi avè l. Pou mezire enpak, fòk gen done itilizasyon ak egzanp ki montre rechèch la ede chanje fòmasyon, sèvis oswa desizyon.
text.en: Existence and impact are different measures. A library can be valuable before its use by teachers, students or organizations has been quantified. Measuring impact requires usage evidence and examples connecting research to changes in training, services or decisions.

text.ht: Pou elektè yo, epizòd la sijere yon fason pou egzamine eksperyans kandida a: chèche zouti li te ede enstitisyon an kreye, rekonèt travay lòt aktè yo, epi mande rezilta yo. Yon bilan serye pa oblije sèlman yon lis diplòm. Li ka montre sa ki rete disponib pou lòt moun sèvi avè l apre diskou a fini.
text.en: For voters, the episode suggests a way to examine experience: identify resources a candidate helped an institution create, credit other contributors and investigate results. A useful record extends beyond qualifications to what remains available for others after a speech ends.

title.ht: Joanas Gué apre siklòn 2008 yo: dega pa menm ak lajan pou repare
title.en: Joanas Gué after the 2008 storms: losses are not recovery funding

description.ht: Estimasyon dega, plan reparasyon ak lajan nan bidjè se twa etap. Melanje yo fè li difisil pou mezire yon repons piblik.
description.en: Damage estimates, recovery plans and budget funding are separate stages. Combining them makes a public response harder to assess.

text.ht: 18 Septanm 2008, Joanas Gué, lè sa a minis Agrikilti, te di Radio Métropole plis pase 63,000 ekta tè kiltivab te afekte apre siklòn yo. Li te estime pèt yo nan plis pase 180 milyon dola. Nan menm nouvèl la, responsab òganizasyon peyizan Kozepep Charles Suffrard te di li poko kapab bay yon bilan konplè pou Latibonit.
text.en: On September 18, 2008, Agriculture Minister Joanas Gué told Radio Métropole that storms had affected more than 63,000 hectares of cultivable land, with losses exceeding 180 million dollars. The same report quotes Kozepep’s Charles Suffrard saying he could not yet provide a comprehensive assessment for the Artibonite valley.

text.ht: Gué te bay lòt chif sou repons lan: 123 milyon dola pou pwoteje rivyè, jwenn entran ak repare kanal, epi 200 milyon goud li te espere jwenn rapidman nan bidjè a. Se pa menm lajan, ni menm kalite chif. Youn se yon estimasyon bezwen pou travay; lòt la se resous nan bidjè li te espere mobilize.
text.en: Gué also cited 123 million dollars for river protection, inputs and canal repairs, and 200 million gourdes he hoped to obtain quickly from the budget. These are different currencies and different measures: estimated recovery work versus hoped-for budget resources.

text.ht: Nou pa ka soustrè 200 milyon goud nan 123 milyon dola pou jwenn yon « twou » finansye. Menm si nou konvèti lajan yo, fòk nou konnen ki travay chak montan kouvri ak ki dat estimasyon an fèt. Pèt yon rekòt pa nesesèman egal pri pou retabli tout pwodiksyon an.
text.en: Subtracting 200 million gourdes from 123 million dollars cannot establish a financing gap. Even with conversion, the scope and date of each estimate matter. A lost harvest’s value need not equal the cost of restoring the production system.

text.ht: Pou egzamine eksperyans Gué, se chenn repons lan ki konte: evalye, finanse, debouse epi verifye rekiperasyon an. Nouvèl la montre sa li te anonse ak ensètitid ki te genyen. Li pa bay yon kont final sou kantite peyizan ki te reprann aktivite oswa sou tout lajan yo te depanse.
text.en: Assessing Gué’s experience requires following the response from assessment through financing, disbursement and recovery. The report records announcements and uncertainty. It does not establish final spending or how many farmers resumed production.

title.ht: Joanas Gué ak mango 2007 yo: relouvri mache a pa t fini kriz la
title.en: Joanas Gué and mango exports in 2007: reopening did not end the crisis

description.ht: Yon repriz anonse nan mitan Jiyè te swiv ak yon nouvo sispansyon nan fen mwa a. Suiv dat yo chanje lekti bilan an.
description.en: An announced mid-July restart was followed by another suspension at month-end. Following the dates changes the assessment.

text.ht: 2 Jiyè 2007, ekspòtasyon mango fransik pou Etazini te sispann apre yo te jwenn lav mouch vivan nan chajman yo. Radio Métropole te rapòte 18 Jiyè sekretè deta Agrikilti Joanas Gué t ap anonse reprann ekspedisyon yo 19 Jiyè. Sis izin ki pa t konsène nan chajman ki te pwovoke pwoblèm nan te jwenn nouvo otorizasyon, dapre li.
text.en: Mango exports to the United States were suspended July 2, 2007 after live fruit-fly larvae were found in shipments. On July 18, Radio Métropole reported Agriculture Secretary of State Joanas Gué’s announcement of a July 19 restart, following renewed authorization for six plants not implicated in the triggering shipments.

text.ht: Men 31 Jiyè, menm estasyon an te rapòte yon nouvo sispansyon. Gué te esplike Ministè Agrikilti a, asosyasyon ekspòtatè yo ak USDA te dakò kanpe ekspedisyon yo akoz nivo enfestasyon an. Li te anonse yon pwogram Leta t ap finanse pou 25 milyon goud pou diminye mouch yo nan zòn pwodiksyon yo.
text.en: By July 31, the station reported another suspension. Gué said the ministry, exporters’ association and USDA had agreed to stop shipments because of infestation levels. He announced a state-funded 25-million-gourde programme to reduce fruit flies in producing areas.

text.ht: Istwa a pa pèmèt nou deklare sis izin yo te fè fwod oswa premye otorizasyon an te ilegal. Li montre yon lòt bagay: rezoud otorizasyon ekspòtasyon an pa t sifi pou elimine risk nan chenn pwodiksyon an. Relouvri yon mache ak kenbe li louvri se de travay ki konekte, men ki bezwen verifikasyon diferan.
text.en: This history does not establish fraud by the six plants or illegality of the initial authorization. It shows that reopening market access did not eliminate production-chain risks. Reopening a market and keeping it open are connected tasks requiring different checks.

text.ht: Pou elektè yo, bilan Gué sou ekspòtasyon merite mezire ak sa ki te fèt apre anons yo: kontwòl nan jaden ak izin, enfòmasyon pou pwodiktè yo, epi rezilta pwogram li te anonse a. De nouvèl Jiyè yo pa bay tout rezilta sa yo. Yo anpeche nou pran yon anons repriz pou yon siksè ki te deja dire lontan.
text.en: Voters assessing Gué’s export record should examine what followed the announcements: field and processing controls, information for producers and programme outcomes. The two July reports do not provide that complete record. They prevent an announced restart from being mistaken for durable success.

title.ht: Salomon ak OPL: konteste yon pouvwa kote yon lòt dirijan pati a te chita
title.en: Salomon and OPL: opposing a council that included another party leader

description.ht: Manifestasyon Okay 2025 la montre poukisa yon pati pa toujou pale ak yon sèl vwa. Fòk lyen ak dezakò yo rete vizib ansanm.
description.en: A 2025 protest in Les Cayes shows why a party does not always speak with one voice. Connections and disagreements both need documenting.

text.ht: 29 Jiyè 2025, Rezo Nòdwès te rapòte lapolis te dispèse yon manifestasyon kont CPT nan Okay, kote ansyen senatè Jean-Marie Junior Salomon ak manm OPL te patisipe. Atik la site sitou patisipan Hervé Saintilus, ki te kritike tou Edgard Leblanc Fils, yon lòt figi OPL ki te nan Konsèy Prezidansyèl Tranzisyon an.
text.en: On July 29, 2025, Rezo Nòdwès reported police dispersing an anti-CPT demonstration in Les Cayes involving former senator Jean-Marie Junior Salomon and OPL members. Its principal quoted participant, Hervé Saintilus, also criticized Edgard Leblanc Fils, another OPL figure serving on the council.

text.ht: Akò politik Avril 2024 la ede konprann lyen an. Li idantifye Leblanc kòm moun Kolektif Pati Politik 30 Janvye 2023 yo te deziyen nan konsèy la. Sa pa fè Salomon yon manm CPT, ni sa pa pwouve li te bay tout desizyon Leblanc yo apwobasyon. Yon alyans ki deziyen yon reprezantan ak tout moun ki nan yon pati pa menm aktè.
text.en: The April 2024 agreement clarifies the connection: it names Leblanc as the collective of January 30 political parties’ council representative. That does not make Salomon a CPT member or establish his approval of Leblanc’s decisions. A nominating coalition and every individual in one party are not the same actor.

text.ht: Menm jan an, akizasyon Saintilus sou privilèj ak enterè pèsonèl yo pa yon odit sou Leblanc. Yo montre yon dezakò politik ki te rive nan lari a. Sa ki ta fè liy politik pati a pi klè se desizyon ògàn li yo: kiyès ki te gen manda pale, ki pozisyon yo te vote ak kijan yo te trete dezakò a.
text.en: Similarly, Saintilus’s accusations about privilege and personal interests are not an audit of Leblanc. They document a political disagreement expressed through protest. Formal party decisions would clarify who had authority to speak, which positions were adopted and how disagreement was handled.

text.ht: Pou Salomon kòm kandida, epizòd la merite egzamine san de rakousi: pa ba li tout desizyon yon lòt dirijan OPL, epi pa pran patisipasyon nan yon manifestasyon kòm prèv li te kase tout lyen politik yo. Se pozisyon, manda ak aksyon ki pèmèt elektè yo suiv responsablite a.
text.en: For Salomon as a candidate, neither assigning him every OPL colleague’s decision nor treating protest as proof of severed political ties would be sound. Positions, mandates and actions allow voters to trace accountability.

title.ht: Deus Deronneth an 2024: konteste yon konsèy pa menm ak anile l
title.en: Deus Deronneth in 2024: challenging a council is not annulling it

description.ht: Li te envoke souverènte ak separasyon pouvwa yo. Pou konprann pozisyon an, fòk nou separe agiman yon kandida ak yon desizyon jidisyè.
description.en: He invoked sovereignty and separation of powers. Understanding the position requires distinguishing a candidate’s argument from a judicial decision.

text.ht: 29 Mas 2024, Rezo Nòdwès te rapòte Deus Deronneth te konteste baz konstitisyonèl Konsèy Prezidansyèl ki t ap prepare avèk fasilitasyon CARICOM nan. Li te apiye agiman li sou atik 1 ak 59 Konstitisyon an: souverènte peyi a ak fason sitwayen delege pouvwa bay twa branch Leta yo.
text.en: On March 29, 2024, Rezo Nòdwès reported Deus Deronneth challenging the constitutional basis of the presidential council being prepared with CARICOM facilitation. He relied on articles 1 and 59: national sovereignty and the delegation of power to the three branches of the state.

text.ht: Dapre atik la, Deronneth te ensiste sou devwa pouvwa jidisyè a pou garanti prensip konstitisyonèl yo nan kriz la. Sa se te yon entèpretasyon ak yon demann politik. Nouvèl la pa site yon desizyon tribinal ki te anile konsèy la oswa ki te bay yon jij otorizasyon pou pran tout pouvwa egzekitif la.
text.en: The article says Deronneth emphasized the judiciary’s duty to uphold constitutional principles during the crisis. That was an interpretation and political demand. It cites no judgment annulling the council or authorizing a judge to assume all executive authority.

text.ht: Akò Avril 2024 la te apre sa dekri yon lòt chemen: nèf moun nan Konsèy Prezidansyèl la, pami yo sèt ki gen dwa vote ak de obsèvatè. Tèks sa a etabli aranjman pati yo te negosye a. Siyati akò a pa ranplase poukont li yon jijman sou tout kesyon konstitisyonèl Deronneth te soulve yo.
text.en: The April agreement subsequently described a different route: nine council members, seven voting and two observers. It records the negotiated arrangement. Signing an agreement does not itself adjudicate every constitutional objection Deronneth raised.

text.ht: Pou evalye kandida a, kesyon an se kijan li ta fè yon pozisyon legal tounen yon sòti kriz ki gen règ. Ki enstitisyon ki ta deside, ak ki limit sou pouvwa moun ki ta dirije pandanstan? Mande respè Konstitisyon an se yon prensip. Yon mekanis ki ka aplike san kreye yon lòt pouvwa san kontwòl se travay ki dwe swiv la.
text.en: Assessing the candidate means asking how his legal position would become a governed route out of crisis: which institution decides, and what limits apply to temporary authority? Respect for the Constitution is a principle. An implementable mechanism that avoids another unchecked authority must follow.

title.ht: Michelet Nestor an 2015: defann moun ki gen orijin ayisyen pa sifi ak yon slogan
title.en: Michelet Nestor in 2015: defending people of Haitian descent beyond a slogan

description.ht: Lèt li bay Danilo Medina a montre sa li te mande. Li fè parèt yon diferans ant orijin yon moun ak estati legal li.
description.en: His letter to Danilo Medina records a concrete demand. It also highlights the distinction between a person’s ancestry and legal status.

text.ht: 24 Jen 2015, biwo kandida Michelet Nestor te pibliye yon lèt bay Prezidan dominiken Danilo Medina ak direktè Imigrasyon an. Li te mande kanpe plan ekspilsyon masiv yo epi fasilite yon chemen pou moun ki konsène yo jwenn sitwayènte. Lèt la te ensiste anpil nan yo pa t janm ale Ayiti.
text.en: On June 24, 2015, presidential candidate Michelet Nestor’s office published a letter to Dominican President Danilo Medina and the immigration director. It sought a halt to planned mass expulsions and an accessible path to citizenship, emphasizing that many affected people had never visited Haiti.

text.ht: Se te yon pozisyon kandida a, pa yon desizyon ki te bay moun sa yo dwa rezidans oswa sitwayènte. Lèt la te kritike efè politik dominiken yo epi li te mande yon chanjman. Nou pa itilize tèks 2015 sa a kòm yon gid sou règ imigrasyon ki aplikab jodi a.
text.en: This was the candidate’s position, not a decision granting residence or citizenship. The letter criticized Dominican policy and sought change. It is not used here as guidance on immigration rules applicable today.

text.ht: Pwen ki rete enpòtan pou yon elektè se presizyon an. Gen orijin ayisyen pa bay poukont li tout repons sou kote yon moun fèt, sitwayènte li oswa dwa li. Yon politik ki mete tout moun nan menm sak ka rate sitiyasyon ki diferan. Defann moun mande konprann diferans sa yo, pa sèlman rele tout moun « konpatriyòt ».
text.en: For voters, the lasting issue is precision. Haitian ancestry alone does not establish birthplace, citizenship or rights. A policy treating everyone identically can miss different situations. Defending people requires understanding those distinctions rather than relying solely on a shared-ancestry appeal.

text.ht: Lèt la bay yon angajman Nestor te pran anvan retou li nan pwosesis elektoral aktyèl la. Pou mezire swivi li, prèv ki itil yo ta montre demach ki te fèt apre lèt la, patnè ki te mobilize ak rezilta ki te jwenn. Pibliye yon demann ak jwenn yon chanjman pou moun yo pa menm etap.
text.en: The letter records a commitment made before Nestor’s return to the current electoral process. Evaluating follow-through requires evidence of subsequent initiatives, partners mobilized and outcomes obtained. Publishing a demand and securing change for the affected people are different stages.

title.ht: Claude Joseph: sa entèdiksyon dominiken 2022 a pwouve, ak sa li pa pwouve
title.en: Claude Joseph: what the 2022 Dominican entry ban establishes

description.ht: Non li te nan yon enstriksyon ki te gen lòt non ladan tou. Sa pa sifi pou etabli yon relasyon kriminèl ant moun sa yo.
description.en: His name appeared in an instruction containing other names. That alone does not establish a criminal relationship among them.

text.ht: 8 Septanm 2022, Associated Press te rapòte Prezidan dominiken Luis Abinader te bay lòd anpeche Claude Joseph antre nan peyi li. Enstriksyon an te siyen jou anvan an. Li te entèdi antre tou pou anviwon douz moun yo te prezante kòm sispèk chèf gang ayisyen.
text.en: On September 8, 2022, Associated Press reported that Dominican President Luis Abinader had barred Claude Joseph from entering the country. The instruction, signed the previous day, also restricted entry for about twelve alleged Haitian gang leaders.

text.ht: Dapre AP, dokiman an te envoke pouvwa otorite yo pou bloke etranje ki gen antesedan penal oswa yo konsidere kòm menas pou sekirite nasyonal. Fraz jeneral sa a pa di ki prèv espesifik ki te sèvi pou chak moun. Li pa pèmèt nou dedui Joseph te kondane oswa tout moun sou lis la t ap travay ansanm.
text.en: AP says the document invoked powers to exclude foreigners with criminal records or considered national-security threats. That general formulation does not identify the evidence applied to each individual. It does not establish Joseph’s conviction or that everyone listed worked together.

text.ht: Joseph te reponn li konsidere entèdiksyon an kòm yon onè nan batay li kont politik li te kalifye kòm rasis. Sa se te fason li te prezante desizyon an, pa yon anilasyon legal desizyon dominiken an. Nouvèl la mete epizòd la nan kontèks konfli diplomatik ak politik migratwa yo.
text.en: Joseph responded that he regarded the restriction as an honour in his opposition to policies he called racist. That was his political response, not legal cancellation of the Dominican decision. The report places the episode amid diplomatic and migration-policy tensions.

text.ht: Dat la konte: entèdiksyon sa a te vini an 2022, anvan kriz kanal 2023 la. Melanje epizòd yo ta kreye yon fo eksplikasyon sou kòz li. Pou egzamine kandida a, fòk nou suiv relasyon diplomatik li ak prèv ki soutni chak desizyon apa. Yon lis administratif merite egzamine; li pa yon rakousi pou pwouve yon lyen ak gang.
text.en: The date matters: this restriction came in 2022, before the 2023 canal dispute. Combining the episodes would create a false causal account. Scrutiny should follow Joseph’s diplomacy and the evidence behind each separate decision. An administrative list warrants examination; it is not a shortcut to proving gang affiliation.

title.ht: Martelly nan dosye Moïse an Jiyè 2026: temwayaj pa yon kondanasyon
title.en: Martelly in the Moïse inquiry in July 2026: testimony is not conviction

description.ht: Yon aparisyon devan jij la se yon evènman presi. Li pa dwe konfonn ak lòt akizasyon oswa sanksyon ki konsène ansyen prezidan an.
description.en: A judicial appearance is a specific event. It should be kept distinct from other allegations or sanctions concerning the former president.

text.ht: 20 Jiyè 2026, Michel Martelly te parèt devan jij enstriksyon Jean Denis Cyprien nan ankèt sou asasina Jovenel Moïse. Le National rapòte seyans lan te antre nan sipleman enfòmasyon Kour Dapèl la te mande pou apwofondi dosye a. Se yon etap ankèt ann Ayiti, pa yon vèdik nan pwosè federal ameriken an.
text.en: On July 20, 2026, Michel Martelly appeared before investigating judge Jean Denis Cyprien in the Jovenel Moïse assassination inquiry. Le National reports that it formed part of supplementary investigation ordered by the Court of Appeal. This was a Haitian investigative step, not a verdict in the US federal trial.

text.ht: Avoka Mario Delcy te di jounal la kliyan li te reponn kesyon yo kòm temwen epi li te kolabore ak jij la. Nou atribye deskripsyon estati sa a ak avoka a. Pati piblik nouvèl la pa bay tout pwosè-vèbal seyans lan oswa tout kesyon jij la te poze.
text.en: Lawyer Mario Delcy told the newspaper his client answered questions as a witness and cooperated with the judge. That description of status is attributed to the lawyer. The public report does not supply the complete hearing record or every question asked.

text.ht: Se la distenksyon yo enpòtan. Yon temwen ka ede yon ankèt san yo pa akize l. Yon akizasyon mande prèv ak yon pwosedi; yon kondanasyon mande yon jijman. Nou pa ka fè aparisyon Jiyè a tounen ni prèv Martelly te òganize asasina a, ni yon akitman sou tout lòt dosye ki konsène li.
text.en: The distinctions matter. A witness can assist an investigation without being accused. An accusation requires its evidence and procedure; conviction requires adjudication. The July appearance establishes neither that Martelly organized the assassination nor an acquittal in every other matter concerning him.

text.ht: Pou elektè yo, pi bon swivi a se suiv sa ankèt la pwodui: enfòmasyon yo verifye, kontradiksyon yo rezoud ak desizyon ki pran sou baz prèv. Pran yon foto devan tribinal oswa yon deklarasyon avoka kòm rezilta final ta kache travay ki rete pou fèt la. Atik sa a egzamine seyans Jiyè a; li pa sètifye tout dosye aktyèl la.
text.en: Voters should follow what the investigation produces: verified information, resolved contradictions and evidence-based decisions. Treating a courthouse appearance or lawyer’s statement as the final outcome obscures the work remaining. This examines the July hearing, not the entire current docket.

title.ht: Claude Joseph, EDE ak Smith Augustin: ki responsablite yon pati pote?
title.en: Claude Joseph, EDE and Smith Augustin: what responsibility does a party carry?

description.ht: Yon pati te soutni reprezantan li, epi apre sa li te mande l demisyone. Istwa sa a mande egzamen sou desizyon politik, san transfere akizasyon kriminèl ant moun.
description.en: A party defended its representative, then sought his resignation. The sequence invites scrutiny of political decisions without transferring criminal allegations between people.

text.ht: Akò Avril 2024 la te idantifye Smith Augustin kòm reprezantan RED/EDE ak Compromis Historique nan Konsèy Prezidansyèl la. Sa se lyen dokimante ant pati EDE Claude Joseph la ak nominasyon an. Claude Joseph pa t li menm manm konsèy la.
text.en: The April 2024 agreement identified Smith Augustin as the RED/EDE and Compromis Historique representative on the Presidential Council. That documents the link between Claude Joseph’s EDE party and the nomination. Joseph was not himself a council member.

text.ht: 27 Jiyè 2024, Gazette Haïti rapòte sekretarya EDE a, anba Sterline Civil, te defann dwa Augustin pou prezante repons li sou akizasyon BNC yo. Jounal la te rapòte li refize demisyone. Men 6 Septanm, Le Nouvelliste te rapòte Biwo Politik Nasyonal EDE a te mande l kite konsèy la. Se te de pozisyon nan de moman diferan.
text.en: On July 27, 2024, Gazette Haïti reported that EDE’s secretariat under Sterline Civil defended Augustin’s opportunity to answer the BNC allegations; he refused resignation. On September 6, Le Nouvelliste reported EDE’s national political bureau asking him to leave the council. These were distinct positions at different moments.

text.ht: Te gen yon swivi jidisyè apa. Nan pati desizyon 19 Fevriye 2025 RNDDH repwodui a, Kour Dapèl la mande jij la kontinye enstriksyon an pandan li deklare manda konparisyon yo inoperan pandan estati konseye yo. Sa pa t yon desizyon sou koupabilite yo. Nou pa prezante etap sa a kòm tout estati dosye a jodi a.
text.en: A separate judicial process followed. In the February 19, 2025 operative wording reproduced by RNDDH, the Court of Appeal directs continued investigation while rendering the summonses inoperative during the councillors’ status. That did not adjudicate guilt. This stage is not presented as the complete case status today.

text.ht: Pou Joseph kòm kandida, kesyon politik la se kijan pati li chwazi moun, egzamine avètisman ak aji lè yon reprezantan konteste. Nominasyon an pa pwouve Joseph te mande oswa resevwa yon kòb nan BNC. Mande yon pati rann kont sou pwòp desizyon li pi solid pase bay tout manm li akizasyon ki konsène yon lòt moun.
text.en: For Joseph as a candidate, the political issue is how his party selects representatives, examines warnings and acts when a representative is challenged. The nomination does not establish that Joseph solicited or received BNC money. Holding a party to account for its decisions is more sound than transferring another person’s allegations to all members.

title.ht: Wilner Joseph: soti nan wòl konseye pou antre nan konpetisyon an
title.en: Wilner Joseph: from advising government to competing for office

description.ht: Relasyon ak pouvwa a bezwen dokiman. Li pa sifi ni pou deklare yon kandida kontwole gouvènman an, ni pou inyore kesyon egalite nan eleksyon an.
description.en: Government relationships need documentation. They establish neither control of government nor a reason to ignore electoral fairness.

text.ht: Lè Vant Bèf Info te rapòte enskripsyon Wilner Joseph nan Septanm 2026, jounal la te idantifye l kòm konseye espesyal Premye Minis Alix Didier Fils-Aimé. Li te enskri anba Viktwa. Sa dokimante yon fonksyon jounal la te rapòte nan moman an; li pa yon verifikasyon tout salè oswa fonksyon li ta toujou kenbe jodi a.
text.en: When Vant Bèf Info reported Wilner Joseph’s registration in September 2026, it identified him as Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aimé’s special adviser. He registered under Viktwa. This documents the role reported then, not every salary payment or any position he might still hold today.

text.ht: An Out, nan pati piblik yon entèvyou Le Nouvelliste, kowòdonatè Viktwa Camille Leblanc te reponn kritik sou pwoksimite ak gouvènman an. Li te prezante fòmasyon gwoup la kòm yon chwa politik ak elektoral. Sa se eksplikasyon òganizasyon an; li pa yon kont finansman kanpay.
text.en: In August, the public excerpt of a Le Nouvelliste interview recorded coordinator Camille Leblanc responding to criticism about government proximity. He described Viktwa’s formation in political and electoral terms. That is the organization’s explanation, not campaign financial accounts.

text.ht: Pou elektè yo, lyen yon kandida ak yon gouvènman tranzisyon soulve yon kesyon presi: èske konpetitè yo jwenn menm tretman? Fòk nou kapab separe travay piblik ak aktivite pati, resous administrasyon ak resous kanpay, epi desizyon elektoral ak enterè alye yo.
text.en: For voters, a candidate’s connection with a transitional government raises a concrete question: do competitors receive equal treatment? Public duties and party activities, administrative resources and campaign resources, electoral decisions and allies’ interests need to remain distinguishable.

text.ht: Sous sa yo pa pwouve lajan Leta te finanse kanpay Joseph, ni Premye Minis la kontwole li. Pou egzamine sa, pyès ki konte yo ta gen ladan dat nenpòt chanjman fonksyon, règ sou itilizasyon resous ak kont kanpay yo. Se prèv sa yo ki pèmèt egzamine yon lyen reyèl san transfòme l otomatikman an fwod.
text.en: These sources do not establish state financing of Joseph’s campaign or prime-ministerial control over him. Relevant evidence would include dates of role changes, resource-use rules and campaign accounts. Such records allow a real relationship to be scrutinized without automatically turning it into fraud.

title.ht: Jerry Tardieu ak bous Lafrans yo: kiyès ki te finanse opòtinite a?
title.en: Jerry Tardieu and French scholarships: who financed the opportunity?

description.ht: Wòl yon depite ki rasanble patnè merite rekonèt. Lajan ak travay enstitisyon yo dwe rete vizib tou.
description.en: A deputy’s role in assembling partners deserves recognition. Institutional funding and work also need to remain visible.

text.ht: Nan yon tèks 14 Desanm 2016 ki sou pwòp sit li, Jerry Tardieu te prezante lansman bous ekselans Ayiti–Lafrans yo. Tèks la idantifye BRH kòm finansè premye gwoup etidyan an epi li site patisipasyon gwoup amitye palmantè yo. Li rapòte tou patnè yo te pwomèt seleksyon sou baz merit.
text.en: A December 14, 2016 account on Jerry Tardieu’s own website describes the Haiti–France excellence scholarship launch. It identifies BRH as financier of the first cohort and the parliamentary friendship groups as participants. It also records partners’ promise of merit-based selection.

text.ht: Se yon distenksyon ki konte: ede kreye yon patenarya pa menm ak peye tout bous yo ak lajan pèsonèl. Yon bilan ka rekonèt inisyativ depite a pandan li nonmen enstitisyon ki finanse, ki chwazi etidyan ak ki òganize fòmasyon an. Sinon, travay kolektif la ka disparèt dèyè yon non politik.
text.en: Assembling a partnership differs from personally financing every scholarship. A record can credit the deputy’s initiative while identifying who funds, selects and administers training. Otherwise collective work can disappear behind a political name.

text.ht: Yon rapò Le National sou lansman bous Lafrans 2020–2021 yo site anbasadè José Gomez sou patnè tankou BRH, Fondasyon Sogebank ak AUF. Tardieu te prezan nan seremoni an. Men nouvèl la mansyone plizyè dispozitif; li pa pèmèt nou deklare tout se menm konvansyon 2016 la oswa tout bous yo se bous Tardieu.
text.en: Le National’s report on France’s 2020–2021 scholarship launch quotes Ambassador José Gomez discussing partners including BRH, Fondation Sogebank and AUF. Tardieu attended. The report covers several arrangements; it does not establish that all were the 2016 agreement or individually attributable to Tardieu.

text.ht: Pou evalye rezilta yo, prèv ki itil yo se kritè seleksyon, kantite bous ki finanse ak sa ansyen bousye yo rive fè. Prezans nan yon seremoni pa reponn kesyon sa yo. Menm jan an, pwomèt merit pa pwouve chak chwa te san patipri. Se dokiman sa yo ki ka fè yon reyalizasyon diplomatik tounen yon bilan piblik ki solid.
text.en: Evaluating outcomes requires selection criteria, funded scholarship totals and graduates’ subsequent work. Ceremony attendance does not answer those questions, and a promise of merit does not prove every selection was impartial. Those records can turn a diplomatic initiative into a substantiated public record.

title.ht: Martelly ak deklarasyon byen yo: poukisa 20 plis 17 pa otomatikman 37
title.en: Martelly’s asset disclosures: why 20 plus 17 does not automatically mean 37

description.ht: Akizasyon ULCC yo merite egzamine ak presizyon. Kont nan de moman diferan pa nesesèman kont diferan.
description.en: ULCC’s allegations require precise scrutiny. Accounts counted at different times are not necessarily different accounts.

text.ht: 8 Desanm 2025, RHINEWS te rapòte ankèt ULCC sou deklarasyon byen Michel ak Sophia Martelly te jwenn reta, enfòmasyon ki manke ak diferans ant fòm yo ak dosye bank yo. Dapre nouvèl la, ULCC te rekòmande pouswit kont ansyen prezidan an pou fo deklarasyon byen. Se rekòmandasyon yon ankèt, pa yon kondanasyon.
text.en: On December 8, 2025, RHINEWS reported ULCC findings of delays, omissions and discrepancies between Michel and Sophia Martelly’s disclosures and banking records. It says ULCC recommended proceedings against the former president for false asset disclosure. An investigative recommendation is not a conviction.

text.ht: Nouvèl la mansyone 20 kont anplis ak yon kat kredi ki pa t deklare nan egzamen antre an fonksyon an, epi 17 kont aktif ak twa kat anplis nan egzamen sòti a. Li site kont ki lye ak kanpay ak Fondasyon Rose et Blanc tou. Sa pa vle di tout se kont pèsonèl Michel Martelly.
text.en: The report describes 20 additional accounts and a credit card omitted at entry, and 17 active accounts and three additional cards at exit. It also mentions campaign- and Fondation Rose et Blanc-related accounts. These should not all be presented as Michel Martelly’s personal accounts.

text.ht: Nou pa ka ajoute 20 ak 17 pou anonse 37 kont diferan san nou konpare lis yo. Yon kont ka parèt nan toude moman yo. Kont labank, kat kredi ak valè lajan ki nan kont yo pa menm inite nonplis. Yon kantite kont pa di poukont li konbyen lajan ki te genyen oswa ki lajan ki ta ilegal.
text.en: Adding 20 and 17 cannot establish 37 distinct accounts without comparing the lists: one account may appear at both dates. Accounts, credit cards and monetary balances are also different units. An account count alone establishes neither total wealth nor illicit funds.

text.ht: Sa pa diminye bezwen pou egzamine akizasyon yo. Li montre bon chenn verifikasyon an: idantifye pwopriyetè chak kont, konpare sa ki te dwe deklare ak sa ki te deklare, epi kite lajistis etabli responsablite. Dosye finansye ki konsène yon koup oswa yon fondasyon mande atribisyon presi, san li pa transfere tout akizasyon sou tout manm fanmi an.
text.en: That does not lessen the need to examine the allegations. It identifies the verification sequence: establish ownership, compare required and actual disclosure, and let adjudication determine responsibility. Records involving a couple or foundation require precise attribution rather than transferring every allegation across a family.

title.ht: Dekrè Hans Joseph te kritike a: ki pòt yon dosye dwe travèse?
title.en: The decree Hans Joseph criticized: which gate must a case pass?

description.ht: Tèks Desanm 2025 la mete yon etap palmantè nan chemen pouswit sèten gwo responsab. Menm tèks la rekonèt Palman an pa t fonksyone.
description.en: The December 2025 text places a parliamentary step in the prosecution of certain senior officials. Its own preamble acknowledges an inoperative legislature.

text.ht: Hans Joseph te di AyiboPost li te kritike dekrè sou Wo Kour Jistis la anvan depa li nan ULCC. Pou konprann sa ki te an jwèt, fòk nou li tèks la: Monitè 17 Desanm 2025 la prevwa yon pwosedi espesyal pou prezidan, premye minis, minis ak lòt gwo responsab li site.
text.en: Hans Joseph told AyiboPost he criticized the High Court of Justice decree before leaving ULCC. The text explains the stakes: Le Moniteur of December 17, 2025 sets out a special procedure for presidents, prime ministers, ministers and other listed senior officials.

text.ht: Atik 2 ak 5 mande yon desizyon Chanm Depite a ak yon majorite de tyè anvan Sena a chita kòm Wo Kour Jistis. Atik 12 ak 13 rezève enfraksyon ki fèt nan egzèsis fonksyon yo pou kour espesyal la, pandan lòt enfraksyon yo rete pou tribinal òdinè yo. Atik 4 sèvi ak yon fòmil ki pi laj sou zak pandan manda a; tansyon sa a bezwen egzamen legal.
text.en: Articles 2 and 5 require a two-thirds Chamber of Deputies decision before the Senate sits as the High Court. Articles 12–13 reserve official-function offences to that court while leaving unrelated offences to ordinary courts. Article 4 uses broader wording about acts during office; that tension requires legal examination.

text.ht: Pwoblèm pratik la vizib nan tèks la menm: youn nan rezon yo bay pou adopte dekrè a se pouvwa lejislatif la pa t fonksyone. Si yon chemen jidisyè mande yon pòt palmantè ki fèmen, jwenn prèv pa sifi pou dosye a avanse. Se rezon ki fè òganizasyon dwa moun yo te konteste mezi a kòm yon risk pou rann kont.
text.en: The text itself identifies the practical problem: its preamble invokes an inoperative legislature. If a judicial route requires a closed parliamentary gate, gathering evidence alone cannot move a case through it. Rights organizations therefore challenged the measure as a threat to accountability.

text.ht: Nou pa deklare isit la tout pwoteksyon pwosediral ilegal oswa tout ansyen responsab koupab. Nou pa tranche efè dekrè a nan yon dosye presi. Kesyon pou kandida ki te dirije oswa ki vle dirije a se konkrè: ki mekanis ki pèmèt jistis egzamine pouvwa a menm lè enstitisyon politik yo bloke?
text.en: This does not declare every procedural protection unlawful or every former official guilty, nor determine the decree’s effect in a particular case. The concrete question for past and aspiring leaders is which mechanism allows justice to examine power when political institutions are blocked.

title.ht: Lucmanne Delille: yon siyati sou dwa polisye pou òganize yo
title.en: Lucmanne Delille: a signature on police officers’ right to organize

description.ht: Arete Mas 2020 a bay yon mezi presi nan bilan li kòm minis. Siyen yon tèks ak garanti fason li aplike se de pati nan menm travay la.
description.en: The March 2020 order supplies a concrete measure in his ministerial record. Signing a text and securing its implementation are connected tasks.

text.ht: 10 Mas 2020, yon arete gouvènman Joseph Jouthe a te modifye estati manm PNH yo. Tèks HaïtiLibre repwodui a pote non Premye Minis la ak Minis Jistis Lucmanne Delille. Li te ajoute polisye tout grad yo kapab asosye ak òganize yo an sendika pou defann dwa yo, nan kondisyon lalwa prevwa.
text.en: A March 10, 2020 order by Joseph Jouthe’s government amended the status of PNH personnel. The text reproduced by HaïtiLibre bears the names of the prime minister and Justice Minister Lucmanne Delille. It provides for officers of all ranks to associate and organize in unions to defend their rights under conditions set by law.

text.ht: Se yon aksyon ki pi presi pase di yon minis te « pou lapolis » oswa « kont lapolis ». Li montre Delille te patisipe nan yon desizyon gouvènman ki te rekonèt yon espas òganizasyonèl. Sa pa vle di li te sèl otè mezi a oswa li te kreye poukont li tout dispozisyon sou sendika nan sèvis piblik la.
text.en: That is more specific than calling a minister simply “for” or “against” police. It shows Delille’s participation in a government decision recognizing organizational space. It does not establish sole authorship or that he independently created the entire public-service union framework.

text.ht: Yon dwa ekri bezwen règ pou mache: ki moun ki reprezante anplwaye yo, kijan yo pote plent ak kijan yo rezoud dezakò pandan sèvis piblik la kontinye. Rekonèt yon òganizasyon pa vle di apwouve tout aksyon nenpòt gwoup ta fè sou non polisye yo. Mezi a dwe egzamine ansanm ak fason Leta te aplike l.
text.en: A written right needs workable rules: representation, grievances and dispute resolution while public service continues. Recognizing organization does not endorse every act by any group claiming to speak for officers. The measure must be examined alongside its implementation.

text.ht: Atik la te prezante arete a pandan yo t ap tann yon dekrè sou dwa asosyasyon ak sendika nan fonksyon piblik la. Nou egzamine etap 2020 sa a, pa tout règ aktyèl sou grèv oswa sèvis polis. Pou kandida Delille, kesyon bilan an se kijan desizyon an te chanje relasyon ant administrasyon an ak moun li dirije yo.
text.en: The report presented the order pending a broader public-service association and union decree. This examines the 2020 step, not every current rule on strikes or police service. For Delille as a candidate, the record concerns how the decision changed relations between administration and personnel.

title.ht: Anvan antre Martine Moïse: Dupuy ak Savary nan lis 32 non an
title.en: Before Martine Moïse’s entry: Dupuy and Savary in the 32-name list

description.ht: Premye lekti 15 Novanm nan te bay de kòd F sou 32. Pi ta, antre Martine Moïse fè lis la rive 33 non ak twa kòd F. Se de moman diferan nan yon rejis k ap chanje.
description.en: The earlier November 15 reading had two entries coded F among 32. Martine Moïse’s later entry brought the list to 33, with three coded F. These are two points in a changing registry.

text.ht: Nan 32 enskripsyon prezidansyèl nou rekonsilye sou kat paj done KEP yo 15 Novanm 2026, de pote kòd F nan chan sèks la: Dominique Dupuy pou PVD ak Marie Anne Savannah Hadid Savary pou HAMAD. Trant lòt yo pote kòd M. Kalkil la fè 2 divize pa 32: 6.25%.
text.en: Of 32 presidential registrations reconciled across four CEP data pages on November 15, 2026, two carry F in the sex field: Dominique Dupuy for PVD and Marie Anne Savannah Hadid Savary for HAMAD. Thirty carry M. Two divided by 32 is 6.25%.

text.ht: Sa se yon foto nan yon moman, pandan enskripsyon yo te toujou kapab chanje. Li pa yon lis final kandida ki apwouve. Li pa di 6.25% elektè yo se fanm, ni fanm sèlman pral soutni de kandida sa yo. Nou pa sèvi ak non moun pou devine kòd la; nou konte chan ki nan sous la.
text.en: This is a time-specific snapshot while registrations could still change, not a final approved-candidate list. It does not mean women are 6.25% of voters or that only women support these candidates. The calculation counts the source field rather than inferring it from names.

text.ht: Chif la louvri yon kesyon sou chemen ki mennen nan tikè prezidansyèl yo. Ki jan pati yo chèche kandida, jwenn finansman ak fè seleksyon? Done sa yo pa pwouve ki baryè ki te bloke ki moun. Yo montre yon diferans nan prezans ki merite rechèch sou pwosedi yo.
text.en: The figure opens an investigation into routes to presidential nomination: recruitment, funding and selection. It does not identify which barrier blocked which person. It documents an imbalance in participation that warrants examining those processes.

text.ht: Pou Dupuy ak Savary, egzamen an dwe rete menm jan ak pou lòt kandida yo: eksperyans, desizyon, enterè ekonomik ak pwogram. Prezans yo nan lis la pa dwe fè yo tounen senbòl sèlman. Yon eleksyon ki bay moun chwa bezwen ni plis aksè nan konpetisyon an, ni menm nivo kesyon sou chak moun ki antre ladan.
text.en: Dupuy and Savary merit the same scrutiny as other candidates: experience, decisions, economic interests and programmes. Their presence should not reduce them to symbols. Meaningful choice requires access to competition and consistent scrutiny of everyone entering it.

text.ht: Mizajou: nan lekti ta 15 Novanm nan, Martine Moïse parèt anba GAD. Kounye a nou verifye 33 enskripsyon, ladan yo twa ak kòd F. Chif 2 sou 32 ki anlè yo konsève premye moman nou te egzamine a; yo pa chif dènye lekti a.
text.en: Update: in the late November 15 reading, Martine Moïse appears under GAD. We now verify 33 registrations, including three coded F. The two-of-32 figures above preserve the earlier reading; they are not the latest count.

title.ht: Lajan piblik, lajan prive: kandida yo dwe pèmèt nou wè diferans lan
title.en: Public money, private money: candidates should make the distinction visible

description.ht: Pozisyon nou: yon non popilè oswa yon bèl istwa pa dwe ranplase dosye finansye ki pèmèt sitwayen egzamine pouvwa.
description.en: Our view: a popular name or compelling story should not replace financial records that allow citizens to scrutinize power.

text.ht: Sou pwòp sit Jerry Tardieu, istwa lansman bous Ayiti–Lafrans yo nonmen BRH kòm finansè premye gwoup la. Nan rapò AIC 2022 a, rezilta finansye yo se kont konpayi kote Olivier Barrau te prezidan konsèy la, pa yon deklarasyon fòtin pèsonèl li. De egzanp diferan sa yo montre menm bezwen an: nonmen ki aktè ki pote oswa ki kenbe ki lajan.
text.en: Tardieu’s own account of the Haiti–France scholarship launch names BRH as first-cohort financier. AIC’s 2022 financial results concern the company chaired by Olivier Barrau, not his personal fortune. These different examples share a need: identifying which actor supplies or holds which money.

text.ht: Nan dosye machin blende yo te remèt Muscadin an 2023 a, kesyon an se te kiyès ki posede yon byen donatè achte pou yon misyon piblik. Yon foto remiz pa rezoud kesyon sa a. Sa pa yon akizasyon detounman; se yon kesyon sou règ ki dwe kontinye mache lè moun nan kite fonksyon li.
text.en: In the 2023 armoured-vehicle donations to Muscadin, the question is ownership of an asset purchased by donors for a public mission. A handover photograph cannot settle it. That is not a diversion allegation; it concerns rules that must survive an official’s departure.

text.ht: Nou defann yon estanda ki klè pou tout kandida: esplike enterè biznis ki ka rankontre desizyon Leta, idantifye donatè ak patnè finansman ki konsène kanpay oswa fonksyon piblik, epi rann règ sou byen yo fasil pou verifye. Sa pa mande ekspoze lavi prive tout fanmi yo. Li mande dokiman sou lajan ak pouvwa moun nan vle jere.
text.en: We advocate one clear standard: disclose business interests that may intersect with state decisions, identify relevant donors and financing partners, and make asset rules verifiable. This does not require exposing every relative’s private life. It requires records concerning the money and power the candidate seeks to manage.

text.ht: Pèsonn pa dwe prezime koupab paske li gen yon biznis, yon alye oswa yon fanmi enfliyan. Pèsonn pa dwe chape anba kesyon paske li gen yon bèl repitasyon nonplis. Konfyans piblik la dwe kapab sipòte yon verifikasyon ki presi, ki jis epi ki sèvi ak menm règ pou tout moun. Se estanda sa a nou mande kandida yo ak tèt nou.
text.en: Business ownership, allies or influential relatives should not create presumed guilt. A good reputation should not exempt anyone from scrutiny either. Public trust should withstand precise, fair verification under consistent rules. That is the standard we ask of candidates and ourselves.

title.ht: Yon tranzisyon bezwen yon sòti ki pa depann de volonte chèf li
title.en: A transition needs an exit beyond its leader’s discretion

description.ht: Pozisyon nou: kondisyon sekirite yo bezwen mezi piblik, epi manda tanporè yo bezwen limit sitwayen ka fè respekte.
description.en: Our view: security conditions need public measures, and temporary mandates need enforceable limits.

text.ht: Rapò ONU Out 2016 la di manda 120 jou Jocelerme Privert la te fini 14 Jen, pandan Asanble Nasyonal la pa t rive pran desizyon sou swivi pouvwa a. Akò Avril 2024 la te fikse yon lòt dat bout pou yon lòt tranzisyon: 7 Fevriye 2026. Sa yo se de aranjman diferan; yo pa menm istwa oswa menm bilan.
text.en: The UN’s August 2016 report records Privert’s 120-day mandate expiring June 14 while the National Assembly failed to decide subsequent governance. The April 2024 agreement set February 7, 2026 as another transition’s endpoint. These are different arrangements and records.

text.ht: Men yo montre poukisa ekri yon dat pa sifi. Fòk gen yon enstitisyon ki gen devwa verifye etap yo, rann reta yo piblik ak egzije yon desizyon lè dat la rive. Sinon, kalandriye a vin yon afich sou miray olye yon limit sou pouvwa.
text.en: They show why writing a date is insufficient. An institution must track milestones, disclose delays and require a decision when the deadline arrives. Otherwise a calendar becomes a wall poster instead of a limit on authority.

text.ht: Agiman sekirite a merite pran oserye. Fòse moun ale vote nan danje pa yon solisyon. Men « tann sekirite » dwe vini ak kesyon ki gen repons: ki kondisyon ki manke, ki travay ki fèt ak ki lè piblik la ap wè yon lòt evalyasyon? Se pa chèf ki bezwen plis tan an sèlman ki dwe mezire pwogrè pa li.
text.en: Security concerns deserve a serious response. Sending voters into danger is no solution. Yet waiting for security requires answers: what is missing, what has been done and when will the next assessment be public? A leader seeking more time should not be the sole judge of progress.

text.ht: Nou mande tout kandida ki ta soutni yon tranzisyon aplike menm règ la: yon manda presi, etap ki ka verifye ak yon sòti ki pa depann sèlman de moun ki sou pouvwa a. Sitwayen yo pa dwe oblije chwazi ant yon eleksyon danjere ak yon pouvwa ki pa gen bout. Devwa politik la se konstwi yon chemen ki evite toude.
text.en: Any candidate supporting a transition should accept a defined mandate, verifiable milestones and an exit beyond the incumbent’s discretion. Citizens should not have to choose between dangerous elections and indefinite authority. Political leadership must build a route avoiding both.

title.ht: Lè n ap egzamine fanmi yon kandida, se tras pouvwa a pou n suiv
title.en: When examining a candidate’s family, follow the exercise of power

description.ht: Pozisyon nou: eritaj, nominasyon ak enterè biznis merite kesyon presi. Yon lyen fanmi pa yon prèv koupabilite.
description.en: Our view: inheritance, appointments and business interests merit precise scrutiny. Kinship does not establish guilt.

text.ht: Savannah Savary te dekri biznis li eritye nan yon entèvyou Haitian Times. Yon rapò Reuters te dekri Charles Saint-Rémy kòm bòfrè ak konseye Michel Martelly. De kalite lyen sa yo pa menm bagay: youn konsène yon pakou ekonomik; lòt la ajoute yon wòl politik ak yon relasyon fanmi.
text.en: Savannah Savary described inherited businesses to The Haitian Times. Reuters described Charles Saint-Rémy as Michel Martelly’s brother-in-law and adviser. These are different relationships: economic background in one case, kinship combined with a political role in the other.

text.ht: Bon kesyon yo kòmanse kote relasyon an rankontre pouvwa piblik. Èske yon fanmi jwenn yon nominasyon? Èske yon antrepriz ki lye ak yon responsab fè biznis ak Leta? Kiyès ki pran desizyon an, ak ki règ pou evite enterè pèsonèl enfliyanse li? Se la dokiman ka pote yon repons ki sèvi sitwayen.
text.en: Useful scrutiny begins where relationships meet public authority: appointments, state business and decisions affecting connected interests. Who decided, and what rules prevented personal interests from shaping the decision? Those are questions documents can answer in the public interest.

text.ht: Yon pyebwa fanmi ki long san desizyon, kontra oswa enterè pou suiv ka bay anpil non epi pa esplike anyen. Li ka menm fè yon timoun oswa yon fanmi ki pa gen wòl piblik peye pri yon konfli politik. Nou pa bezwen konnen tout detay lavi prive yon moun pou egzamine yon nominasyon oswa yon kontra.
text.en: A long family tree without decisions, contracts or interests to trace can supply names without explanation. It can also expose children or uninvolved relatives to political conflict. Examining an appointment or contract does not require every detail of private life.

text.ht: Men fanmi pa dwe sèvi kòm yon miray pou kache yon wòl ofisyèl nonplis. Lè yon relasyon gen konsekans sou byen, lajan oswa desizyon piblik, se dwa sitwayen pou konprann li. Nou defann yon egzamen ki rive lwen nan dosye yo epi ki rete jis sou moun yo: pwouve chak lyen, esplike konsekans li, pa transmèt koupabilite tankou yon eritaj.
text.en: Family privacy should not conceal official roles either. When a relationship affects public assets, money or decisions, citizens deserve an explanation. Scrutiny should go far into the records while treating people fairly: establish each connection, explain its consequences and never make guilt hereditary.

title.ht: Sekirite dwe bay sitwayen yon pwoteksyon yo ka fè konfyans
title.en: Security should give citizens protection they can trust

description.ht: Pozisyon nou: kòlè devan gang yo bezwen yon repons Leta ki pwoteje lavi epi ki kapab rann kont sou pwòp fòs li.
description.en: Our view: anger at gang violence requires a state response that protects life and answers for its own use of force.

text.ht: Nan Novanm 2025, Vant Bèf Info te rapòte manifestan Miragwàn ki soutni Jean Ernest Muscadin paske yo te wè l kòm yon defans kont gang. Yon rapò BINUH 2026 te, bò pa li, dokimante posib enplikasyon li nan omwen 76 egzekisyon somè ant 2022 ak 2025. Se akizasyon yon rapò dwa moun, pa yon kondanasyon; chif la pa yon total tout ane jiska jodi a.
text.en: Vant Bèf Info reported Miragoâne demonstrators backing Muscadin in November 2025 as protection against gangs. A 2026 BINUH report documented his possible involvement in at least 76 summary executions during 2022–2025. Those are human-rights findings alleging involvement, not a conviction or a count covering every subsequent period.

text.ht: Nou dwe tande bezwen sekirite sa a san nou pa fè l tounen yon otorizasyon san limit. Lè moun pè, yon responsab ki aji ka parèt pi kredib pase yon enstitisyon ki sèlman fè pwomès. Men menm yon pouvwa ki popilè bezwen règ ki pèmèt egzamine sa li fè.
text.en: The demand for safety deserves to be heard without becoming unlimited authorization. Amid fear, an official who acts can appear more credible than institutions offering promises. Popular power still needs rules allowing its actions to be examined.

text.ht: Yon Leta serye dwe kapab esplike yon arestasyon, konsève prèv, prezante yon dosye epi rann kont lè yon moun mouri anba fòs li. Sa mande polis ki gen mwayen ak tribinal ki kapab travay. Si nou abandone etap sa yo, yon akizasyon ka tounen yon santans anvan pèsonn egzamine prèv la.
text.en: A serious state must explain arrests, preserve evidence, present cases and account for deaths involving its force. That requires functioning police and courts. Abandoning those stages allows accusation to become punishment before evidence is examined.

text.ht: Se menm estanda a nou mande nenpòt kandida ki pwomèt retabli lòd. Ki pwoteksyon moun inosan genyen si yon responsab fè erè? Ki moun ki egzamine yon plent kont fòs sekirite? Rann kont se yon garanti sitwayen yo bezwen pou pouvwa ki pwoteje yo pa ka kraze yo san repons.
text.en: Any candidate promising order should answer the same questions: what protects an innocent person from official error, and who investigates complaints against security forces? Accountability is a guarantee for citizens that the power protecting them cannot harm them without answering for it.

title.ht: Yon bous yon enstitisyon finanse dwe rete yon opòtinite pou sitwayen
title.en: An institution-funded scholarship should remain a civic opportunity

description.ht: Pozisyon nou: rekonèt moun ki ouvri yon pòt pa dwe fè benefisyè a santi li dwe bay yon angajman politik an retou.
description.en: Our view: crediting someone who opens a door should never create a political obligation for the recipient.

text.ht: Nan istwa bous Ayiti–Lafrans pwòp sit Jerry Tardieu pibliye an 2016, BRH parèt kòm finansè premye gwoup etidyan an. Tèks la rapòte patnè yo te pwomèt seleksyon sou merit. Sa bay yon baz ki itil: moun ki te ede rasanble patnè yo ak enstitisyon ki te peye a pa dwe konfonn.
text.en: Tardieu’s own 2016 scholarship account names BRH as financier of the first cohort and records partners’ promise of merit-based selection. It supplies a useful starting point: the person assembling partners and the institution providing funding should remain distinguishable.

text.ht: Nou ka rekonèt sèvis yon depite san nou pa transfòme yon opòtinite enstitisyonèl an yon dèt pèsonèl. Yon etidyan dwe kapab di mèsi, kenbe pwòp opinyon li epi vote jan konsyans li di l. Rekonesans pa dwe yon kontra politik ki pa ekri.
text.en: A deputy’s service can be credited without making an institutional opportunity a personal debt. A student should be free to express thanks, retain independent opinions and vote freely. Gratitude must not become an unwritten political contract.

text.ht: Pou sa, règ yo bezwen parèt anvan lis benefisyè yo: kondisyon pou aplike, kritè seleksyon, moun ki pran desizyon ak fason pou konteste yon erè. Lè enstitisyon an bay règ sa yo klèman, li pwoteje ni etidyan yo ni moun ki te defann pwogram nan kont akizasyon san prèv.
text.en: Rules should precede the beneficiary list: eligibility, selection criteria, decision-makers and a way to challenge error. Publishing them protects both students and those who advocated the programme against unsupported allegations.

text.ht: Nou pa di pwogram Tardieu a te achte vòt oswa te chwazi moun sou baz patipri. Sous la pa pwouve sa. Nou defann yon prensip pou tout kandida ak tout pwogram: fè sèvis la kontinye san li pa depann de lwayote ak yon moun. Pi gwo reyalizasyon yon lidè ka kite se yon pòt ki rete ouvè menm lè se yon lòt moun ki sou pouvwa a.
text.en: This does not allege vote-buying or partisan scholarship selection; the source establishes neither. Our principle applies to every candidate and programme: services should continue independently of personal loyalty. Leadership can leave its strongest legacy in an opportunity that remains open after power changes hands.

title.ht: Lè pati yo fin chwazi, se pou deba piblik la kòmanse
title.en: After parties choose, public debate should begin

description.ht: Pozisyon nou: yon nominasyon dwe ouvri egzamen pwogram nan devan sitwayen, olye li fèmen kesyon yo andedan yon òganizasyon.
description.en: Our view: nomination should open a programme to public scrutiny rather than close questions inside an organization.

text.ht: Kayimit News rapòte Debout Patriotes te chwazi Michelet Nestor pa konsansis an Novanm 2026. Vant Bèf Info te rapòte yon primè entèn pou Wilner Joseph nan Viktwa an Septanm. De fason diferan sa yo ka chwazi yon moun pou pote koulè yon òganizasyon. Yo pa ranplase eleksyon kote sitwayen deside kiyès ki pral dirije.
text.en: Kayimit News reports Debout Patriotes selecting Nestor by consensus in November 2026. Vant Bèf Info reports Viktwa’s internal primary for Wilner Joseph in September. Different mechanisms can select an organization’s standard-bearer. They do not replace the public election deciding who governs.

text.ht: Yon pati gen dwa esplike poukisa li fè yon chwa. Sitwayen yo gen dwa mande sa chwa a pote: ki pwoblèm kandida a pral trete an premye, ki lajan ki disponib ak ki rezilta ki ka verifye. Aplodisman nan yon sal pa reponn kesyon sa yo.
text.en: A party can explain its choice. Citizens can ask what that choice offers: first priorities, available funding and verifiable outcomes. Applause in a hall cannot answer those questions.

text.ht: Nou defann deba kote kandida yo resevwa kesyon ki konparab epi kote repons yo rete disponib pou tout moun. Pa egzanp, si yon moun pwomèt plis polisye, li dwe esplike fòmasyon ak depans yo. Si yon lòt pwomèt plis lekòl, li dwe esplike pwofesè ak finansman. Menm prensip la sèvi pou egzamine plan ki diferan.
text.en: We support debates with comparable questions and publicly accessible answers. A promise of more police should explain training and cost; more schools should explain teachers and financing. A consistent principle can examine different plans.

text.ht: Sa pa mande yon seri nòt nou envante pou deklare yon gayan. Li mande sous, repons klè ak espas pou moun verifye sa yo tande. Lè yon pati fin chwazi kandida li, travay pou konvenk ak prèv la fèk kòmanse. Pati a ka bay yon moun manda pou reprezante li; se devan piblik la moun nan dwe montre sa manda sa a vo.
text.en: That does not require invented scores declaring a winner. It requires sources, clear answers and room to verify claims. Nomination begins the work of making an evidence-based case. A party may authorize someone to represent it; the public must be able to assess what that mandate offers.

title.ht: Etzer Emile ak Muscadin: plis polisye, men anba kontwòl kiyès?
title.en: Etzer Emile vs Jean Ernest Muscadin: more police, accountable to whom?

description.ht: Youn prezante chif pou agrandi lapolis. Dosye lòt la kòm komisè gouvènman poze kesyon sou fason yo sèvi ak fòs piblik. Se de pati nan menm pwoblèm sekirite a.
description.en: One offers police recruitment targets. The other has a prosecutorial record that raises questions about the use of force. Security requires examining both.

text.ht: Yon wout san gang pa dwe tounen yon wout kote nenpòt moun ka pè ajan Leta. Konpare Etzer Emile ak Jean Ernest Muscadin mande pou nou gade de bagay ansanm: kapasite pou pwoteje moun ak kontwòl sou moun ki pote zam pou Leta.
text.en: A road free of gangs should not become a road where anyone must fear state agents. Comparing Etzer Emile and Jean Ernest Muscadin means examining two things together: the capacity to protect people and control over those who carry weapons for the state.

text.ht: Pwogram Emile la pwopoze pase soti nan anviwon 13,000 polisye operasyonèl rive 26,000 an 2033. Li pwomèt akselere rekritman ak fòmasyon 1,000–2,000 polisye nan premye 100 jou yo. Li pale tou de verifikasyon rekrit yo, sanksyon pou abi ak yon enspeksyon ki pi solid. Chif depa a ak objektif yo soti nan kanpay la.
text.en: Emile’s programme proposes increasing operational police from about 13,000 to 26,000 by 2033. It promises faster recruitment and training of 1,000–2,000 officers during the first 100 days, alongside recruit screening, sanctions for abuse and a stronger inspectorate. Both the baseline and targets come from the campaign.

text.ht: Muscadin vini ak yon dosye kòm komisè gouvènman. Gen manifestan nan Miragwàn ki te prezante l kòm yon defansè kont gang an Novanm 2025. Men rapò BINUH pou Avril–Jen 2026 la site posib patisipasyon li nan omwen 76 egzekisyon san pwosè, ki dokimante pou 2022–2025. Rapò a di pa t gen pouswit jidisyè ki te kòmanse kont li pou sa.
text.en: Muscadin brings a record as a prosecutor. Demonstrators in Miragoâne portrayed him as a defender against gangs in November 2025. But BINUH’s April–June 2026 report cites his possible involvement in at least 76 summary executions documented for 2022–2025, saying no judicial proceedings had begun against him for them.

text.ht: De dosye sa yo pa mezire menm bagay. Emile prezante yon plan; objektif sa yo poko rezilta. Rapò Nasyonzini an egzamine zak ki ta deja fèt; li pa yon kondanasyon penal. Nou pa gen yon menm mezi pou de kandida yo ki ta pèmèt nou di kiyès ki pwoteje plis moun.
text.en: These records measure different things. Emile presents a plan; its targets are not results. The UN report examines alleged past conduct; it is not a criminal conviction. We do not have a common measure for both candidates that would establish who has protected more people.

text.ht: Sa fè chwa a pi klè. Plis rekrit pa sifi si fòmasyon, salè ak sipèvizyon pa suiv. Repitasyon yon sèl moun pa montre kijan yon sistèm ap fonksyone nan tout peyi a. Toude bezwen esplike kiyès ki verifye idantite yon moun yo sispèk, kiyès ki egzamine yon abi ak kijan fanmi yon viktim jwenn jistis. Se la pwoteksyon ak rann kont rankontre.
text.en: The practical distinction becomes clearer. More recruits are insufficient without training, pay and supervision. One individual’s reputation does not show how a nationwide system would function. Both need to explain who checks a suspect’s identity, who investigates abuse and how a victim’s family obtains justice. Protection and accountability meet at that point.

title.ht: Jerry Tardieu ak Olivier Barrau: eksperyans biznis la dwe montre kiyès li sèvi
title.en: Jerry Tardieu vs Olivier Barrau: business experience must show whom it serves

description.ht: Yon otèl ak yon konpayi asirans te resevwa finansman entènasyonal. Konpare dosye yo mande pou nou suiv lajan an rive sou moun li te sipoze ede yo.
description.en: A hotel and an insurer received international financing. Comparing the records means following the money to the people it was intended to help.

text.ht: Jere yon antrepriz ka prepare yon moun pou pran gwo desizyon. Men yon prezidan ap sèvi sitwayen ki pa aksyonè li. Dosye Jerry Tardieu ak Olivier Barrau pèmèt nou egzamine diferans sa a atravè de operasyon finansman ki dokimante.
text.en: Running a business can prepare someone to make major decisions. A president, however, serves citizens who are not his shareholders. Jerry Tardieu’s and Olivier Barrau’s records allow us to examine that difference through two documented financing operations.

text.ht: Rapò anyèl IFC pou 2011 la idantifye Tardieu kòm direktè jeneral Oasis Hotel. Li dekri yon prè 7.5 milyon dola ameriken ki te ede atire 15 milyon dola anplis nan men envestisè. Se yon prè pou pwojè a, pa yon kado pèsonèl oswa yon kontribisyon elektoral.
text.en: IFC’s 2011 annual report identifies Tardieu as Oasis Hotel’s chief executive. It describes a US$7.5 million loan that helped attract another US$15 million from investors. This was project lending, not a personal gift or an election contribution.

text.ht: Pou AIC, rejis BID la montre yon prè 2 milyon dola ameriken, apwouve an Mas 2012, nan yon operasyon 8 milyon dola. Finansman prive sa a pa t gen garanti Leta. Objektif BID te bay la se te ede konpayi an elaji asirans pou moun ki gen ti revni apre tranblemanntè 2010 la. Rapò AIC pou 2022 la idantifye Barrau kòm direktè jeneral.
text.en: For AIC, the IDB register shows a US$2 million loan approved in March 2012 within an US$8 million operation. The private-sector financing had no sovereign guarantee. The IDB described an aim of expanding insurance for lower-income people after the 2010 earthquake. AIC’s 2022 report identifies Barrau as chief executive.

text.ht: Gwosè prè yo pa yon klasman sou kiyès ki pi bon administratè. Pwojè yo, ane yo ak sèvis yo diferan. Pou otèl la, egzamen an bezwen travay ki te kreye, kondisyon travay ak acha nan men founisè lokal. Pou asirans lan, li bezwen pri kliyan peye, pwoteksyon yo resevwa ak dedomajman konpayi an peye. Objektif yon finansè pa ranplase rezilta sa yo.
text.en: Loan size does not rank management ability. The projects, years and services differ. For the hotel, assessment needs jobs created, working conditions and local purchasing. For the insurer, it needs customer prices, coverage and claims paid. A financier’s stated purpose cannot substitute for those outcomes.

text.ht: Lòt egzamen an konsène pouvwa piblik: ki enterè finansye chak kandida toujou genyen, epi ki desizyon Leta li ta kite nan men lòt responsab pou evite enterè pèsonèl enfliyanse yo? Sous sa yo pa bay deklarasyon byen aktyèl konplè yo. Yo pa pwouve yon favè ilegal nonplis. Yo bay yon pwen depa pou mande prèv sou rezilta biznis la ak sou distans kandida a pral mete ant biznis li ak Leta.
text.en: The other test concerns public power: what financial interests does each candidate retain, and which state decisions would he leave to others to prevent personal interests influencing them? These sources supply neither complete current asset declarations nor proof of an unlawful favour. They provide a starting point for examining business outcomes and the safeguards each candidate would place between business and government.

title.ht: Martelly ak Privert: de ansyen prezidan, de kalite responsablite
title.en: Michel Martelly vs Jocelerme Privert: two presidents, different accountability tests

description.ht: Pwomès lekòl Martelly a ak manda tranzisyon Privert la pa menm dosye. Konpare yo mande pou nou separe lajan, pouvwa ak dat limit.
description.en: Martelly’s school promise and Privert’s transitional mandate are different records. Comparing them requires separating money, authority and deadlines.

text.ht: Yon ansyen prezidan pa bezwen sèlman di sa li pral fè. Li dwe esplike sa li te fè ak pouvwa li te deja genyen. Michel Martelly ak Jocelerme Privert pase egzamen sa a nan de kondisyon diferan: yon pwogram yon prezidan te lanse ak yon manda pwovizwa pou soti nan yon blokaj elektoral.
