text.en: A former president must explain what he did with the power he already held, as well as what he promises next. Michel Martelly and Jocelerme Privert face that test in different circumstances: a programme launched by one president and a provisional mandate to resolve an electoral deadlock.

text.ht: Sou Martelly, BRH konfime yon frè 1.50 dola ameriken sou transfè lajan, ki antre an vigè 1 Jen 2011. Finansman lekòl te nan sant pwomès la. Pou 2011–2018, tab 59 nan rapò Kou Siperyè Kont la anrejistre anviwon 120 milyon dola kolekte atravè BRH, prèske 118 milyon transfere nan Trezò ak anviwon 2.37 milyon ki rete nan fen peryòd la.
text.en: Under Martelly, the central bank confirms a US$1.50 transfer fee effective June 1, 2011. School funding was central to the promise. For 2011–2018, table 59 of the audit court’s report records about US$120 million collected through the central bank, nearly US$118 million transferred to the Treasury and about US$2.37 million remaining at the period’s end.

text.ht: Kont sa a pa vle di 2.37 milyon an disparèt. Li pa yon bilan pèsonèl Martelly nonplis: peryòd la depase prezidans li. Egzamen politik la se suiv lajan sa a jouk sou depans, lekòl ak timoun ki te benefisye yo. Yon transfè nan Trezò pa, poukont li, yon plas lekòl.
text.en: That account does not mean US$2.37 million disappeared. Nor is it Martelly’s personal balance sheet: the period extends beyond his presidency. The political test is tracing receipts through expenditure to schools and children served. A Treasury transfer is not, by itself, a school place.

text.ht: Privert te resevwa yon lòt kalite misyon. Asanble Nasyonal la eli l prezidan pwovizwa 14 Fevriye 2016, pou yon peryòd ki pa t dwe depase 120 jou. Rapò Nasyonzini an di manda a ekspire 14 Jen. Palman an pa t rive pran desizyon sou fason pouvwa egzekitif la ta kontinye. Plizyè enstitisyon te patisipe nan reta elektoral yo; se pa tout reta ki soti nan yon sèl desizyon Privert.
text.en: Privert received a different mission. The National Assembly elected him provisional president on February 14, 2016, for no more than 120 days. The UN report says the term expired June 14 and Parliament failed to decide arrangements for continued executive governance. Several institutions contributed to electoral delays; not every delay came from a single Privert decision.

text.ht: Konparezon an pa rezime ak «kiyès ki te kite plis lajan?». Martelly dwe rann kont sou chenn ki soti nan frè fanmi yo peye rive nan sèvis yo resevwa. Privert dwe rann kont sou pouvwa li te egzèse, dat limit li ak kontwòl li te aksepte. Ni yon pwomès sosyal ni yon misyon tranzisyon pa retire obligasyon pou montre rezilta ak respekte limit pouvwa.
text.en: The comparison is not simply who left more money behind. Martelly’s test follows the chain from family fees to services received. Privert’s concerns the authority exercised, its deadline and the scrutiny he accepted. Neither a social promise nor a transitional mission removes the obligation to demonstrate results and respect limits on power.

title.ht: Dominique Dupuy ak Claude Joseph: apre pawòl diplomatik yo, ki pwoteksyon?
title.en: Dominique Dupuy vs Claude Joseph: after diplomatic words, what protection?

description.ht: De ansyen chèf diplomasi gen dosye diferan devan menm fwontyè a. Yon pozisyon piblik pa sifi pou mezire sa ki chanje pou sitwayen yo.
description.en: The former foreign ministers bring different records at the same border. A public stance alone does not measure what changed for citizens.

text.ht: Pou yon fanmi ki fè fas ak depòtasyon, diplomasi pa yon diskou byen di sèlman. Li dwe ede moun jwenn pwoteksyon ak repons. Se nan distans ant pozisyon piblik ak rezilta sa yo konparezon Dominique Dupuy ak Claude Joseph la vin itil.
text.en: For a family facing deportation, diplomacy is more than a strongly worded speech. It should help people obtain protection and answers. The distance between a public stance and those results makes a comparison of Dominique Dupuy and Claude Joseph useful.

text.ht: Nan yon kominike 8 Oktòb 2024, prezidans Ayiti bay chif ONM: 5,323 moun rapatriye ant 4 ak 7 Oktòb, ladan yo 140 timoun. Konsèy Prezidansyèl la te bay Dupuy, ki te minis Afè Etranjè, misyon diplomatik pou defann dwa ak diyite moun sa yo. Sa dokimante responsablite yo te konfye l, men li pa bay tout rezilta demach li yo.
text.en: An October 8, 2024 Haitian presidency communiqué gives ONM’s count of 5,323 people repatriated between October 4 and 7, including 140 children. The Presidential Council assigned Foreign Minister Dupuy diplomatic work to defend their rights and dignity. This documents her assignment, but not all its outcomes.

text.ht: Pou Joseph, yon lòt epizòd te mete relasyon ak Repiblik Dominikèn devan piblik la. Selon AP, yon enstriksyon 7 Septanm 2022 te entèdi l antre nan peyi a. Li te rele mezi a yon onè epi li te defann pozisyon li kont rasis. Se te yon desizyon sou antre nan yon teritwa; sous la pa bay yon kondanasyon penal kont li.
text.en: For Joseph, another episode brought Dominican relations into public view. AP reported that a September 7, 2022 instruction barred his entry. He called the measure an honour and defended his stance against racism. This was an entry decision; the source supplies no criminal conviction against him.

text.ht: Nou pa ka mete de epizòd sa yo sou yon menm echèl rezilta. Dupuy te resevwa yon travay kòm minis an 2024; entèdiksyon Joseph la te vize yon ansyen minis an 2022. Sa yon lòt Leta deside sou yon kandida pa di, poukont li, kijan kandida a ta jere relasyon ant de peyi yo sou kesyon fwontyè a.
text.en: The episodes cannot be placed on a single results scale. Dupuy received an assignment as minister in 2024; Joseph’s 2022 ban targeted a former minister. Another state’s decision about a candidate does not, by itself, show how that candidate would manage border relations.

text.ht: Pou chak kandida, yon dosye ki pi itil ta montre demann ki te fèt, repons ki te vini ak chanjman ki te verifyab: dokiman pou moun, asistans konsilè, pwoteksyon timoun ak tretman plent. Yon pozisyon fèm kapab enpòtan. Men pou yon moun ki rive sou fwontyè a san resous, kesyon an se kiyès ki ede l, ak ki mwayen. Se sou etap sa a toude dwe esplike pwogram yo.
text.en: For each, a more useful record would show requests made, responses received and verifiable changes: documentation, consular help, child protection and complaint handling. A firm position can matter. For someone arriving at the border without resources, however, the question is who helps and with what means. Both candidates need to explain their programmes at that level.

title.ht: Jerry Tardieu ak Gary Bodeau: kiyès ki te kontwole pòt Palman an?
title.en: Jerry Tardieu vs Gary Bodeau: who controlled access in Parliament?

description.ht: Dosye 2019 la mete aksè ak dokiman devan nou. Sanksyon ameriken kont Bodeau a poze yon lòt kesyon sou enfliyans lajan, ki dwe rete byen separe.
description.en: The 2019 record raises access to documents. U.S. sanctions against Bodeau raise a separate question about money and influence that must remain distinct.

text.ht: Nan Palman an, pouvwa pa nan kantite vòt sèlman. Li nan kapasite pou mete yon kesyon sou tab la ak bay aksè ak dokiman anvan yon desizyon. Dosye Jerry Tardieu ak Gary Bodeau nan deba 2019 sou mete Jovenel Moïse an akizasyon montre sa.
text.en: Parliamentary power lies in more than vote totals. It also concerns putting an issue on the agenda and providing documents before a decision. Jerry Tardieu’s and Gary Bodeau’s records in the 2019 debate over impeaching Jovenel Moïse illustrate that.

text.ht: Tardieu te mande Bodeau, ki te prezidan Chanm Depite a, pou rann dokiman yo te mande yo disponib. Rezo Nòdwès te rapòte sa Tardieu te di sou yon angajman Bodeau te pran. Sa etabli demann Tardieu a; li pa pwouve Bodeau te detwi oswa fè espre kache yon dokiman presi.
text.en: Tardieu asked Chamber president Bodeau to make requested documents available. Rezo Nòdwès reported Tardieu’s account of a commitment Bodeau had made. This establishes Tardieu’s demand; it does not prove Bodeau destroyed or deliberately concealed a particular document.

text.ht: Rapò Nasyonzini S/2019/805 anrejistre vòt 22 Out la: 53 kont, twa pou ak senk abstansyon. Depite opozisyon te konteste legalite vòt la poutèt prezans lan te pi ba pase kowòm 80 manm yo te site a. Chif kolektif sa yo pa di kijan Tardieu te vote pèsonèlman. Rejte mosyon an pa t yon jijman penal ki valide tout tranzaksyon PetroCaribe yo.
text.en: UN report S/2019/805 records the August 22 vote: 53 against, three in favour and five abstentions. Opposition deputies challenged its legality because attendance fell below the 80-member quorum they invoked. These collective totals do not identify Tardieu’s personal vote. Rejecting the motion was not a criminal judgment validating every PetroCaribe transaction.

text.ht: Yon dosye diferan vini apre: an Avril 2023, Trezò ameriken te sanksyone Bodeau sou baz akizasyon koripsyon nan vòt pou nominasyon an 2018 ak 2019. Bodeau te rejte akizasyon yo. Sa pa yon kondanasyon penal, epi sous yo pa konekte peman sa yo ak vòt sou mete Moïse an akizasyon an. Melanje yo ta kreye yon lyen nou pa pwouve.
text.en: A different record followed: in April 2023, the U.S. Treasury sanctioned Bodeau over alleged corruption in appointment votes in 2018 and 2019. Bodeau denied the allegations. This is not a criminal conviction, and the sources do not connect those payments to the impeachment vote. Merging the episodes would create an unproven link.

text.ht: Diferans ki dokimante a se wòl yo: Tardieu te mande aksè; Bodeau te dirije biwo ki òganize travay Chanm lan. Pou premye a, egzamen an suiv demann lan ak sa li te fè apre. Pou dezyèm nan, li suiv règ aksè, desizyon biwo a ak repons li bay akizasyon finansye yo. Yon bon konparezon egzije tras chak zak, san bay youn yon vòt nou pa verifye oswa lòt la yon kondanasyon nou pa genyen.
text.en: The documented difference concerns their roles: Tardieu sought access; Bodeau headed the bureau organizing Chamber business. For the first, scrutiny follows the request and his subsequent actions. For the second, it follows access rules, bureau decisions and his response to financial allegations. A useful comparison requires a record of each act, without assigning an unverified vote to one or an undocumented conviction to the other.

title.ht: Clarens Renois ak Maxo Joseph: yon antant legliz pa posede vòt pèsonn
title.en: Clarens Renois vs Maxo Joseph: a church agreement does not own anyone’s vote

description.ht: Yo te patisipe nan menm demach politik an 2015. Dosye ki vin apre yo montre poukisa fòk nou date alyans yo epi separe rezo sipò ak dwa elektè a.
description.en: They participated in the same political process in 2015. Later records show why alliances need dates and support networks must be distinguished from voters’ rights.

text.ht: De moun ka soti nan menm milye relijye san yo pa pwopoze menm direksyon pou peyi a. Pou Clarens Renois ak Maxo Joseph, yon negosyasyon 2015 bay yon lyen politik ki dokimante. Li pa bay yon pèmisyon pou nou prezante tout Pwotestan kòm yon sèl blòk elektoral.
text.en: Two people can come from the same religious milieu without proposing the same direction for the country. For Clarens Renois and Maxo Joseph, a 2015 negotiation supplies a documented political connection. It does not permit treating all Protestants as one electoral bloc.

text.ht: Selon rapò Rezo Nòdwès pou Septanm 2015, yon komite fasilitasyon pastè Gérald Bataille te dirije te chwazi Renois apre negosyasyon ant sèt kandida. Maxo Joseph te patisipe nan antant lan. Yon premye etap te kenbe twa non anvan dènye chwa a tonbe sou Renois.
text.en: According to Rezo Nòdwès’s September 2015 report, a facilitation committee headed by pastor Gérald Bataille selected Renois after negotiations among seven candidates. Maxo Joseph participated in the agreement. An initial stage retained three names before the final choice went to Renois.

text.ht: Sa montre yon efò lidè te fè pou rasanble kandidati. Li pa montre chak legliz oswa chak fidèl te patisipe. Li pa etabli tout lòt kandida yo te retire non yo sou bilten an nonplis. Siyen yon antant, bay sipò ak retire yon kandidati se twa zak diferan.
text.en: That shows an effort by leaders to consolidate candidacies. It does not show every church or believer participated, or establish that all other candidates removed their names from the ballot. Signing an agreement, endorsing someone and withdrawing a candidacy are different acts.

text.ht: Yon dosye ki vin apre mete Renois nan yon lòt wòl: siyati li parèt sou pak politik Avril 2024 la pou Kolektif Pati Politik 30 Janvye 2023 a. Reprezantan kolektif la nan Konsèy Prezidansyèl la se te Edgard Leblanc Fils, pa Renois. Siyati a pa fè Renois responsab otomatikman pou chak desizyon konsèy la; li pèmèt egzamine angajman politik li te soutni yo.
text.en: A later record places Renois in another role: his signature appears on the April 2024 political pact for the Collective of Political Parties of January 30, 2023. Its council representative was Edgard Leblanc Fils, not Renois. The signature does not automatically make Renois responsible for every council decision; it allows scrutiny of the political commitments he supported.

text.ht: Rejis CEP nou te verifye a mete Renois anba UNIR AYITI INI ak Maxo Joseph anba RCH. Antant 2015 la pa sifi pou deklare yo toujou alye. Sous nou egzamine yo pa bay yon pak tranzisyon ki menm jan pou Maxo; sa pa pwouve li pa t gen okenn relasyon politik ak tranzisyon an.
text.en: The checked CEP registry records Renois under UNIR AYITI INI and Maxo Joseph under RCH. The 2015 agreement does not establish a continuing alliance. Our reviewed sources supply no equivalent transition pact for Maxo; that does not prove he had no political relationship with the transition.

text.ht: Konpare yo jodi a mande pou chak moun bay pwòp pwogram li, finansman li ak angajman li. Yon rezo ka ede yon kandida pale ak elektè. Li pa dwe sèvi kòm prèv elektè yo deja bay konsantman yo. Vòt la rete pou sitwayen an, menm lè yon lidè relijye fè yon chwa.
text.en: Comparing them today requires each person’s programme, financing and commitments. A network can help a candidate reach voters. It cannot serve as evidence that voters have already consented. The vote belongs to the citizen, even when a religious leader makes a choice.

title.ht: Etzer Emile ak Moïse Durocher: kiyès ki konte sa kòm yon travay?
title.en: Etzer Emile vs Moïse Durocher: what counts as a job?

description.ht: Prè pou yon ti biznis, yon djòb tanporè ak yon travay ki dire pa menm rezilta. Chif kanpay yo bezwen menm definisyon an anvan nou konpare yo.
description.en: A small-business loan, temporary employment and a lasting job are different outcomes. Campaign totals need common definitions before comparison.

text.ht: Yon jèn moun bezwen konnen si travay la ap peye l regilyèman, pa sèlman si non li antre nan yon estatistik. Pwopozisyon Etzer Emile ak Moïse Durocher sou travay montre kijan gwo chif ka kache diferans sa a.
text.en: A young person needs to know whether work will provide regular pay, not simply whether their name enters a statistic. Etzer Emile’s and Moïse Durocher’s employment proposals show how large numbers can obscure that distinction.

text.ht: Paj travay kanpay Emile la pwopoze 5,000 pwojè ki resevwa prè san enterè, yon milyon goud pou chak, ak yon fon garanti. Li mete mezi sa a nan premye 100 jou yo. Li bay tou objektif 50,000 djòb tanporè nan travay piblik ak 300,000 travay fòmèl an 2033.
text.en: Emile’s campaign jobs page proposes interest-free loans of one million gourdes each for 5,000 projects, alongside a guarantee fund. It places that measure within the first 100 days. It also sets targets of 50,000 temporary public-works jobs and 300,000 formal jobs by 2033.

text.ht: Yon pwofil Durocher ki parèt 12 Novanm 2026 bay yon objektif 1,500,000 travay dirèk. Li konekte pwodiksyon ak fòmasyon nan syans lanmè, elvaj ak etid dlo ak ekosistèm. Sous sa a pa bay yon dat limit presi pou tout travay sa yo. Nou pa ka mete 2033 bò kote chif li a kòm si li te pwomèt dat sa a.
text.en: A November 12, 2026 profile gives Durocher’s goal of 1,500,000 direct jobs, connecting production and training in marine science, animal production, and water and ecosystems. That source supplies no precise deadline for the full total. We cannot attach 2033 to his figure as though he promised that date.

text.ht: Diferans lan pa senpleman 1.5 milyon kont 300,000. Kalite travay yo ak delè yo poko sou menm baz. Pou Emile, miltipliye 5,000 prè pa yon milyon goud bay senk milya goud nan valè prè. Sa pa bay kantite moun pwojè yo ap anplwaye, ni tout depans Leta. Pou Durocher, kantite travay yo pa di konbyen ki sezonye oswa ki bay salè pandan tout ane a.
text.en: The difference is not simply 1.5 million against 300,000. Job types and timeframes do not yet share a common basis. For Emile, 5,000 loans of one million gourdes equal five billion gourdes in loan value. That does not establish employment created or total state expenditure. For Durocher, the job total does not show how much work would be seasonal or provide year-round wages.

text.ht: Yon konparezon serye bezwen menm tablo pou toude: nouvo pozisyon ki peye, patwon ki pral anboche, dire travay, fòmasyon, pri ak sous lajan. Fòk yo separe travay ki deja egziste ak travay yo kreye. Sinon, yon kanpay ka konte yon moun ki resevwa fòmasyon kòm yon travayè anvan moun sa a janm resevwa yon salè.
text.en: A sound comparison needs the same table from both: new paid positions, employers hiring, duration, training, cost and funding. Existing work must be separated from employment created. Otherwise a campaign can count a trainee as an employed person before that person has received a wage.

title.ht: Etzer Emile ak Munir Mourra: double polisye pa menm ak double bidjè
title.en: Etzer Emile vs Munir Mourra: doubling police is not doubling budgets

description.ht: De pwopozisyon sekirite sèvi ak lide double a. Youn konte moun; lòt la konte lajan. Rezilta pou sitwayen an bezwen plis pase de chif sa yo.
description.en: Two security proposals use doubling. One counts people; the other counts money. The outcome for citizens requires more than those figures.

text.ht: Yon moun k ap tann èd apre yon atak bezwen yon ekip ki ka rive, mennen ankèt epi fè dosye a avanse nan lajistis. Pwomès Etzer Emile ak Munir Mourra mete resous devan nou, men yo konte resous sa yo yon fason diferan.
text.en: Someone awaiting help after an attack needs a team that can respond, investigate and move a case through justice. Etzer Emile’s and Munir Mourra’s promises emphasize resources, but count those resources differently.

text.ht: Emile pwopoze pase soti nan anviwon 13,000 polisye operasyonèl rive 26,000 an 2033. Pwogram li a pale de akselere rekritman ak fòmasyon 1,000–2,000 polisye nan premye 100 jou yo, ansanm ak verifikasyon rekrit yo ak sanksyon pou abi. Sa se objektif kanpay, pa polisye anplis nou deja verifye sou teren an.
text.en: Emile proposes moving from about 13,000 operational police officers to 26,000 by 2033. His programme calls for faster recruitment and training of 1,000–2,000 officers in the first 100 days, alongside recruit screening and sanctions for abuse. These are campaign targets, not additional officers we have verified in service.

text.ht: Manifès MPH la pwopoze ogmante bidjè lajistis, lapolis ak lame pa 100 pousan. Paj kandida pati a idantifye Munir Joseph Mourra kòm kandida ki pote manifès la. Ogmante yon montan pa 100 pousan double l. Men sa pa di konbyen lajan ki pral nan chak enstitisyon san bidjè depa a.
text.en: The MPH manifesto proposes increasing justice, police and army budgets by 100 percent. The party’s candidate page identifies Munir Joseph Mourra as the candidate carrying it. Increasing an amount by 100 percent doubles it. Without the starting budgets, however, it does not establish the amount going to each institution.

text.ht: Double anplwaye ak double lajan pa menm mezi. Rekrit ka ranplase polisye ki kite sèvis la. Yon bidjè ka grandi pandan gaz ak ekipman vin pi chè. Lajan ki otorize nan yon bidjè ka pa janm depanse. Se poutèt sa nou pa ka bay youn pi bon nòt sekirite sou baz mo «double» a.
text.en: Doubling staff and doubling money are different measures. Recruits can replace departing officers. A budget can grow while fuel and equipment become more expensive. Authorized funds may never be spent. The word “double” therefore cannot establish a superior security score for either candidate.

text.ht: Emile bezwen montre pri fòmasyon, kantite ajan ki fini fòmasyon ak kantite ki rete nan sèvis. MPH bezwen montre ane referans, montan yo ak fason lajan an separe ant salè, operasyon, tribinal ak prizon. Pou toude, egzamen ki mare yo ansanm se sèvis: tan repons, bon jan ankèt, pwoteksyon kont abi ak dosye ki rive devan yon jij. Se la resous yo dwe bay rezilta.
text.en: Emile needs to show training costs, graduates and retention. MPH needs the baseline year, amounts and allocations among pay, operations, courts and prisons. Both face a common service test: response time, sound investigations, protection from abuse and cases reaching a judge. That is where resources must produce results.

title.ht: Jacky Lumarque ak René St-Fort: soti nan leson an rive nan lavi elèv la
title.en: Jacky Lumarque vs René St-Fort: from the lesson to a student’s life

description.ht: Eksperyans nan fòmasyon ak pwopozisyon sou kondisyon pwofesè yo antre nan de bout menm chenn lan. Fòk nou gade aksè, aprantisaj ak sa ki vini apre.
description.en: Training experience and proposals on teachers’ conditions address different parts of the same chain. Access, learning and what follows all need examination.

text.ht: Yon lekòl ka ouvè pòt li san chak timoun aprann. Yon sant ka bay diplòm san chak jèn jwenn travay. Konpare Jacky Lumarque ak René St-Fort mande pou nou separe non enstitisyon yo ak rezilta pou moun ki pase ladan yo.
text.en: A school can open without every child learning. A centre can issue certificates without every young person finding work. Comparing Jacky Lumarque and René St-Fort requires separating institutional names from outcomes for the people attending.

text.ht: Biyografi Université Quisqueya bay la plase Lumarque kòm direktè adjwen INFP an 1984, apre sa direktè jeneral an 1987. Li di li rektè inivèsite a depi 2007. Se yon dosye responsablite nan fòmasyon pwofesyonèl Leta ak nan yon inivèsite prive. Biyografi enstitisyon li dirije a pa yon evalyasyon endepandan sou rezilta travay li.
text.en: Université Quisqueya’s biography places Lumarque as INFP deputy director in 1984 and director-general in 1987, and says he has been the university’s rector since 2007. This records responsibilities in state vocational training and a private university. His institution’s biography is not an independent evaluation of his performance.

text.ht: Nan entèvyou Vant Bèf Info te pibliye 15 Me 2026, St-Fort mande pwogram lekòl komen ak pi bon kalite ansèyman. Li denonse salè pwofesè ki ensifizan e ki pa regilye. Li se avoka, pwofesè ak yon lidè PRN. Entèvyou sa a etabli lide li defann yo; li pa bay yon bidjè oswa yon kalandriye pou mete yo an pratik.
text.en: In Vant Bèf Info’s May 15, 2026 interview, St-Fort calls for common curricula and improved teaching quality, criticizing insufficient and irregular teacher pay. He is a lawyer, teacher and PRN leader. The interview establishes the ideas he defended, but supplies no implementation budget or timetable.

text.ht: Sa yo pa de politik ki oblije opoze. Yon sistèm bezwen ansèyman debaz ak bon jan fòmasyon apre sa. Men gen de egzamen diferan: Lumarque ka montre kantite moun ki antre, fini epi jwenn travay nan domèn yo te aprann lan. St-Fort bezwen montre kijan Leta peye pwofesè, distribye materyèl epi swiv jou ansèyman ak pwogrè elèv.
text.en: These approaches need not be opposed. A system needs basic education and sound training afterward. But there are different tests: Lumarque can show entrants, completions and subsequent work in the trained field. St-Fort needs to explain reliable teacher pay, materials and tracking of teaching days and student progress.

text.ht: Kesyon ki mare yo se aksè. Kiyès ki peye, e kisa ki rive yon fanmi ki pa gen mwayen? Eksperyans nan yon gwo enstitisyon pa reponn sa poukont li. Yon pwogram komen pa fè tout lekòl jwenn menm resous. Konparezon an vin itil lè chak kandida konekte lide li ak kantite elèv li ka sèvi, pri sèvis la ak yon fason pou verifye rezilta yo.
text.en: Access connects the two. Who pays, and what happens to a family that cannot afford it? Experience in a prominent institution does not answer that by itself. A common curriculum does not give every school equal resources. The comparison becomes useful when each candidate connects his approach to students served, cost and a way to verify results.

title.ht: Hans Joseph ak Lucmanne Delille: ankèt la bezwen rive devan yon jij
title.en: Hans Joseph vs Lucmanne Delille: an investigation must reach a judge

description.ht: Yon ansyen chèf ULCC ak yon ansyen minis Jistis gen responsablite ki diferan. Dosye yo fè nou gade tout chimen lajistis la, pa sèlman anons yon ankèt.
description.en: A former ULCC head and a former justice minister held different responsibilities. Their records direct attention to the full justice process, beyond an investigation’s announcement.

text.ht: Yon dosye ka fè gwo bri lè li anonse, epi pèsonn pa konnen sa li tounen. Se pwoblèm sa a ki bay yon pwen depa pou konpare Hans Joseph, ansyen chèf ULCC, ak Lucmanne Delille, ansyen minis Jistis. Yo pa t nan menm pòs; fòk nou suiv travay chak enstitisyon.
text.en: A case can make headlines when announced, then become impossible to follow. That problem provides a starting point for comparing former ULCC head Hans Joseph and former justice minister Lucmanne Delille. They held different posts; each institution’s work needs tracing.

text.ht: Nan etid 2025 li a, Ensemble Contre la Corruption te suiv 166 dosye ULCC ak UCREF te voye nan lajistis ant 2005 ak 2024. Li te jwenn enfòmasyon sou 95, men li pa t rive retrase 71. Nan total la, 96 soti nan ULCC ak 70 nan UCREF. Se pa 166 dosye Hans Joseph te dirije pèsonèlman: peryòd la kouvri prèske 20 ane ak de enstitisyon.
text.en: In its 2025 study, Ensemble Contre la Corruption traced 166 referrals from ULCC and UCREF during 2005–2024. It located information on 95 but could not trace 71. Of the total, 96 came from ULCC and 70 from UCREF. These are not 166 cases personally directed by Hans Joseph: the period spans almost 20 years and two institutions.

text.ht: Yon dokiman yon kowalisyon dwa moun te soumèt bay Nasyonzini an 2026 reprann rezilta etid la: kat jijman, ladan yo de kondanasyon. Yon dosye yo pa retrase pa prèv yon moun detwi l pou kache yon krim. Men sa montre poukisa konte ankèt pa sifi pou mezire rann kont.
text.en: A human-rights coalition’s 2026 UN submission cites the study’s result: four judgments, including two convictions. An unlocated file is not proof that someone destroyed it to conceal a crime. It nevertheless shows why investigation totals cannot measure accountability on their own.

text.ht: Pou Delille, yon desizyon presi parèt nan dosye a: non li kòm minis Jistis sou arete 10 Mas 2020 ki rekonèt dwa polisye asosye ak òganize sendika anba kondisyon lalwa. Premye minis Joseph Jouthe te siyen l tou. Sa etabli patisipasyon Delille nan desizyon an, pa otè li poukont li ni yon rezilta nou mezire sou tout plent polisye yo.
text.en: For Delille, a specific decision appears in the record: his name as justice minister on the March 10, 2020 order recognizing police officers’ right to associate and organize in unions under legal conditions. Prime Minister Joseph Jouthe also signed. This establishes Delille’s participation, not sole authorship or a measured outcome for all police grievances.

text.ht: Diferans enstitisyonèl la enpòtan: ULCC mennen ankèt sou koripsyon; yon ministè Jistis gen lòt responsablite nan administrasyon sistèm nan. Ni direktè ni minis pa jij; yo pa dwe bay lòd pou fè kondane yon moun. Toude kandida bezwen esplike kijan yo ta ede suiv yon dosye, pwoteje endepandans moun k ap deside yo epi fè piblik la konnen sa ki rive li. Se chimen sa a ki ka fè yon anons tounen jistis.
text.en: The institutional difference matters: ULCC investigates corruption; a justice ministry has other responsibilities in administering the system. Neither director nor minister is a judge; neither should order a conviction. Both candidates need to explain case tracking, protection for independent decision-making and public information on outcomes. That process can turn an announcement into justice.

title.ht: Wilson Jeudy ak Jude Célestin: travay piblik dwe pran moun li afekte yo an kont
title.en: Wilson Jeudy vs Jude Célestin: public works must account for the people affected

description.ht: Degèpisman nan kan Delmas yo ak acha ekipman CNE yo se de dosye diferan. Yo bay de fason pou egzamine otorite, resous ak sèvis piblik.
description.en: Delmas camp clearances and CNE equipment purchases are different records. They offer two ways to examine authority, resources and public service.

text.ht: Netwaye yon espas oswa achte machin lou ka parèt kòm siy yon otorite k ap aji. Men efè sou moun ak tras depans yo fè pati rezilta a. Se de bout sa yo dosye Wilson Jeudy ak Jude Célestin pèmèt nou egzamine.
text.en: Clearing an area or buying heavy machinery can look like decisive action. Effects on people and a traceable spending record are also part of the outcome. Wilson Jeudy’s and Jude Célestin’s records allow examination of those two aspects.

text.ht: Amnesty International rapòte plis pase 300 fanmi te sibi ekspilsyon nan de kan Delmas an Me 2011, avèk destriksyon abri ak byen. Jeudy te majistra a. Haïti en Marche te defann responsablite majistra a pou sekirite epi kritike fason Leta santral ak lòt òganizasyon te jere deplasman moun yo.
text.en: Amnesty International reports more than 300 families evicted from two Delmas camps in May 2011, with shelters and belongings destroyed. Jeudy was mayor. Haïti en Marche defended the mayor’s security responsibilities and criticized the central state’s and other organizations’ handling of displacement.

text.ht: Òganizasyon legal BAI te anonse yon plent kont Jeudy. Sa pa yon kondanasyon; nan dosye nou egzamine yo, nou pa jwenn desizyon final sou plent sa a. Yon rezon sekirite pa di ki avi fanmi yo te resevwa, ki lòt kote yo te ka ale oswa ki posiblite yo te genyen pou konteste operasyon an.
text.en: Legal organization BAI announced a complaint against Jeudy. That is not a conviction; the reviewed records supplied no final decision on that complaint. A security rationale does not establish what notice families received, where else they could go or how they could challenge the operation.

text.ht: Pou Célestin, komisyon Sena sou PetroCaribe a te retounen sou acha ekipman CNE pandan li te dirije enstitisyon an. Rapò 2016 la pale de yon alokasyon 80 milyon dola ameriken epi li di komisyon an pa t jwenn yon envantè konplè. Yon antre nan tablo kontra yo montre 81 kamyon livre olye 100, avèk yon dediksyon 2,565,000 dola. Prezante 19 lòt yo kòm kamyon disparèt ta efase dediksyon tablo a anrejistre a.
text.en: For Célestin, the Senate PetroCaribe commission revisited CNE equipment purchases during his leadership. Its 2016 report records an US$80 million allocation and says it lacked a complete inventory. One contract-table entry shows 81 trucks delivered instead of 100, with US$2,565,000 deducted. Calling the other 19 missing would erase the adjustment the table records.

text.ht: Ankèt palmantè sa a pa yon kondanasyon Célestin. Konparezon an pa fè de dosye yo menm. Li bay chak kandida yon egzamen presi: Jeudy dwe esplike pwosedi ak pwoteksyon pou moun operasyon minisipal afekte; Célestin dwe konekte kontra, peman ak machin ki egziste epi ki sèvi piblik la. Aksyon piblik merite jijman sou sèvis li bay ak limit li respekte, pa sou imaj fòs sèlman.
text.en: The parliamentary inquiry is not a conviction of Célestin. This comparison does not equate the two records. It gives each candidate a specific test: Jeudy must explain procedures and protection for people affected by municipal operations; Célestin must connect contracts and payments to equipment that exists and serves the public. Public action warrants assessment through service delivered and limits respected, beyond an image of strength.

title.ht: Savannah Savary ak Olivier Barrau: biznis fanmi an devan enterè piblik la
title.en: Savannah Savary vs Olivier Barrau: family businesses and the public interest

description.ht: Istwa antrepriz yo esplike yon pati nan chemen kandida yo. Kesyon pou Leta a se sa yo kontwole jodi a ak règ yo aksepte pou demen.
description.en: Their business histories explain part of their careers. The public question concerns what they control today and the safeguards they accept for tomorrow.

text.ht: Eritye yon antrepriz pa yon fòt. Li pa yon garanti kapasite pou dirije yon peyi nonplis. Pou Savannah Savary ak Olivier Barrau, fanmi ak biznis antre nan dosye piblik la paske yo ka ede esplike enterè finansye moun ki mande pouvwa a.
text.en: Inheriting a business is no offence. Nor does it guarantee an ability to govern. For Savannah Savary and Olivier Barrau, family and business belong in the public record where they help explain the financial interests of someone seeking power.

text.ht: Nan entèvyou Haitian Times te pibliye an Oktòb 2026, Savary di li eritye Distillerie 1928 ak Habitation Robert, epi antrepriz yo anplwaye plis pase 100 moun. Sa se kont li bay, pa yon total anplwa nou verifye endepandamman. Li pa t bay detay finansye, poutèt li te pè tounen yon sib.
text.en: In an October 2026 Haitian Times interview, Savary says she inherited Distillerie 1928 and Habitation Robert and that the businesses employ more than 100 people. That is her account, not an independently verified employment total. She declined financial details, citing fear of becoming a target.

text.ht: Rapò anyèl AIC pou 2022 la di Barrau te reprann jesyon koutye asirans fanmi an apre etid li. Li idantifye Lucien Barrau kòm papa li epi li date kreyasyon AIC an Desanm 2001. Sa dokimante yon istwa biznis ak yon lyen fanmi; li pa bay yon envantè konplè sou byen li genyen jodi a.
text.en: AIC’s 2022 annual report says Barrau took over management of the family insurance brokerage after his studies. It identifies Lucien Barrau as his father and dates AIC’s creation to December 2001. This documents business history and a family relationship; it supplies no complete inventory of his current assets.

text.ht: De sous yo gen limit diferan. Pou Savary, nou gen pwòp deklarasyon li nan yon entèvyou. Pou Barrau, nou gen istwa konpayi an rakonte. Ni youn ni lòt pa yon odit pèsonèl endepandan. Nou pa ka sèvi ak kantite anplwaye youn oswa dat kreyasyon konpayi lòt la pou klase richès yo oswa efikasite yo.
text.en: The sources have different limits. For Savary, there is her interview account. For Barrau, there is the company’s history. Neither is an independent personal financial audit. One candidate’s employment claim and the other company’s founding date cannot rank their wealth or effectiveness.

text.ht: Egzamen ki komen an kòmanse ak desizyon Leta: kiyès ki ta jere antrepriz yo pandan manda a, e kiyès ki ta deside sou yon kontra oswa yon avantaj ki touche yo? Yon pwosedi ki anpeche enterè pèsonèl enfliyanse desizyon piblik pi itil pase lis fanmi san okenn wòl ki dokimante. Sous sa yo pa etabli yon kontra ilegal. Yo montre poukisa règ sou enterè finansye yo dwe vini anvan egzèsis pouvwa a.
text.en: The common test starts with state decisions: who would manage the businesses during a term, and who would decide on a contract or benefit affecting them? A process preventing personal interests influencing public decisions is more useful than a list of relatives without documented roles. These sources establish no unlawful contract. They show why financial-interest safeguards should precede taking power.

title.ht: Martine Moïse antre nan lis la: kounye a, 33 enskripsyon prezidansyèl
title.en: Martine Moïse joins the list: 33 presidential registrations

description.ht: Twa fanm parèt nan lekti ta 15 Novanm nan. Yon enskripsyon ouvè yon dosye pou egzamine; li pa yon apwobasyon final oswa yon chif sou chans genyen.
description.en: Three women appear in the late November 15 reading. Registration opens a record to examine; it is neither final approval nor a measure of election chances.

text.ht: Martine Moïse antre nan rejis prezidansyèl CEP a anba GAD, sou non konplè Marie Etienne Martine Joseph Moise. Lekti nou fè ta 15 Novanm nan bay 33 enskripsyon. Reuters idantifye nouvo kandida a kòm ansyen Premyè dam nan, vèv Jovenel Moïse. Sa konekte non konplè rejis la ak non piblik moun nan, san envante yon lòt idantite.
text.en: Martine Moïse appears in the CEP presidential registry under GAD, with the full name Marie Etienne Martine Joseph Moise. Our late November 15 reading records 33 registrations. Reuters identifies the new registrant as the former first lady and Jovenel Moïse’s widow. This connects the registry’s full name with her public name without inventing another identity.

text.ht: Gen yon chanjman nan chif la: anvan sa, nou te verifye 32 non, ladan yo Dominique Dupuy ak Savannah Savary kòm de enskripsyon ki pote kòd F. Avèk nouvo antre a, gen twa sou 33, sa vle di anviwon 9.1 pousan. Se kalkil prezans nan rejis la. Se pa rezilta yon sondaj, yon prediksyon vòt oswa yon konklizyon sou kota legal.
text.en: The count has changed: an earlier check recorded 32 names, with Dominique Dupuy and Savannah Savary as the two entries coded F. The new entry makes three of 33, or about 9.1 percent. This measures registry presence. It is not a poll, a vote forecast or a finding about a legal quota.

text.ht: Enskripsyon pa vle di CEP fin egzamine tout pyès oswa fin apwouve kandidati a. Non GAD nan rejis la pa bay finansman kanpay la, lis donatè oswa tout alyans li yo. Li montre estrikti ki anrejistre ansanm ak kandida a. Etap sa yo dwe rete separe pou elektè pa pran yon antre sou yon sit pou yon desizyon final.
text.en: Registration does not mean the CEP has finished examining documents or approved the candidacy. GAD’s registry label supplies neither campaign financing, donors nor all alliances. It identifies the structure recorded with the candidate. These steps must stay separate so voters do not mistake a website entry for a final decision.

text.ht: Yon non anpil moun konnen pa ranplase yon pwogram. Pou egzamine nouvo kandidati a, fòk nou separe wòl li te genyen, desizyon ki dokimante ak angajman li pran kounye a. Deklarasyon byen, sous finansman, ekip ak mezi presi sou sekirite ak lavi chè ap pèmèt piblik la ale pi lwen pase repitasyon. Menm egzamen sa a dwe aplike pou chak lòt kandida.
text.en: A familiar name does not replace a programme. Examining the candidacy requires separating her previous role, documented decisions and current commitments. Asset declarations, funding sources, personnel and specific measures on security and living costs would let the public move beyond reputation. The same scrutiny must apply to every other candidate.

title.ht: Daniest Adrien ak Ricardo Jean Pierre: lis yon pati pa kantite vòt li
title.en: Daniest Adrien vs Ricardo Jean Pierre: a party slate is not its vote total

description.ht: PRC gen plis antre pou Sena; PANAH gen yon antre anplis pou depite. Done yo montre ki kote pati yo antre nan konpetisyon an, san predi kiyès k ap genyen.
description.en: PRC has more Senate entries; PANAH has one more deputy entry. The data show participation in the contest without predicting who will win.

text.ht: Anvan nou deklare yon kandida «fò» oswa «fèb», fòk nou di kisa nou mezire. Pou Daniest Adrien ak Ricardo Jean Pierre, rejis CEP a bay yon pwen konparezon ki verifyab: lòt enskripsyon ki pote menm kòd pati ak yo.
text.en: Before describing a candidate as strong or weak, we need to say what is being measured. For Daniest Adrien and Ricardo Jean Pierre, the CEP registry provides a checkable comparison: other registrations carrying their party codes.

text.ht: Adrien parèt anba PRC; Jean Pierre anba PANAH. Nan koleksyon 11,142 antre nou rekonsilye a, PRC gen sèt antre pou Sena ak uit pou Chanm Depite. PANAH gen twa pou Sena ak nèf pou Chanm Depite. Nou konte antre anba kòd egzak sa yo, pa moun nou sipoze alye ak kandida yo.
text.en: Adrien appears under PRC; Jean Pierre under PANAH. In the reconciled collection of 11,142 entries, PRC has seven Senate and eight Chamber of Deputies entries. PANAH has three Senate and nine deputy entries. We count exact codes, not people presumed to be their allies.

text.ht: Konparezon an chanje selon pòs la. PRC gen kat antre anplis pou Sena; PANAH gen youn anplis pou depite. Se kalkil sou menm kopi a. Sa pa bay kantite syèj yo pral genyen, ni yon majorite palmantè pou yon prezidan. CEP poko fin apwouve tout kandidati sa yo, epi chak sikonskripsyon gen pwòp elektè li.
text.en: The comparison changes with the office. PRC has four more Senate entries; PANAH has one more deputy entry. These calculations use the same snapshot. They establish neither seats won nor a president’s parliamentary majority. The CEP has not finished approving these candidacies, and each constituency has its own voters.

text.ht: Done sa yo itil paske yon pwogram prezidansyèl ka bezwen lwa ak desizyon lòt nivo Leta. Men yon enskripsyon pa yon angajman vote menm jan sou chak lwa. Antant ak lòt pati kapab egziste san yo pa parèt nan konte sa a. Nou pa gen baz isit la pou envante pwogram, finansman oswa istwa fanmi kandida yo. Premye egzamen an se mande menm dokiman sa yo nan men toude, pandan nou konsève diferans dosye a montre deja yo.
text.en: These data matter because a presidential programme may require laws and decisions at other levels of government. Registration is not a commitment to vote together on every law. Agreements with other parties may exist outside this count. This record does not support inventing either candidate’s programme, financing or family history. The next test is obtaining the same documents from both while preserving the differences already established.

title.ht: Kely Bastien ak Junior Salomon: yon tit nan Sena pa esplike tout pouvwa a
title.en: Kely Bastien vs Junior Salomon: a Senate title does not explain all the power

description.ht: Dosye yo poze de kesyon diferan: kijan yon dirijan rann kont, epi kijan li resevwa otorite pou dirije.
description.en: Their records raise different questions: how a leader accounts for his decisions, and how he obtains authority to lead.

text.ht: Yon moun ka gen eksperyans nan Sena san sa pa esplike kijan li te sèvi ak pouvwa li. Kely Bastien ak Jean-Marie Junior Salomon bay de egzanp ki mande dokiman diferan: tras administrasyon yon enstitisyon ak règ ki bay dwa dirije l.
text.en: Senate experience does not, by itself, explain how someone exercised power. Kely Bastien and Jean-Marie Junior Salomon provide two examples requiring different records: the administration of an institution and the rules granting authority to lead it.

text.ht: Yon brèf nan yon rapò vwayaj 2011 sou sit Komite Afè Etranjè Sena ameriken an idantifye Bastien kòm senatè Nò epi li rapòte eleksyon li kòm prezidan Sena an 2008. Li prezante transparans ak pi bon relasyon ant branch Leta kòm objektif li. Sa se objektif nan dokiman an, pa yon odit ki konfime yo te reyalize.
text.en: A briefing in a 2011 trip report hosted by the U.S. Senate Foreign Relations Committee identifies Bastien as a northern senator and records his election as Senate president in 2008. It presents transparency and better relations between branches as his objectives. Those are documented aims, not an audit confirming delivery.

text.ht: Pou Salomon, yon rapò Rezo Nòdwès 13 Janvye 2020 dekri anons li te fè pou pran prezidans Sena a pwovizwaman pandan konfli sou manda yo. Li te site karaktè pèmanan Sena a nan atik 95-1 Konstitisyon an. Sekretè jeneral Rony Gilot te raple règ sou eleksyon biwo a ak wòl pwovizwa doyèn laj la.
text.en: For Salomon, Rezo Nòdwès’s January 13, 2020 report describes his announcement that he was provisionally assuming the Senate presidency during the dispute over terms. He cited the Senate’s permanent character under Constitution Article 95-1. Secretary-general Rony Gilot recalled rules on electing the bureau and an interim role for the oldest member.

text.ht: Dire yon enstitisyon ak dwa yon moun dirije l pa menm kesyon. Pou Bastien, egzamen an suiv bidjè, depans ak piblikasyon desizyon pandan responsablite li. Pou Salomon, li bezwen pwosedi, vòt ak pwosè vèbal ki esplike otorite li te reklame a. Nou pa sèvi ak de rapò sa yo pou tranche tout konfli legal sou Sena a.
text.en: An institution’s continuity and an individual’s authority to lead it are different questions. For Bastien, scrutiny follows budgets, expenditure and publication of decisions during his responsibilities. For Salomon, it requires procedures, votes and minutes explaining the authority claimed. These two reports cannot adjudicate every legal dispute over the Senate.

text.ht: Kandida ki pale de respekte enstitisyon bezwen esplike tou ki pwosedi li aksepte lè pwosedi a ka limite pwòp pouvwa li. Se pwen ki konekte de dosye yo: règ yo dwe mache lè yo ede yon lidè ak lè yo anpeche l fè sa li vle.
text.en: A candidate advocating respect for institutions must also explain which procedures he accepts when they limit his own power. That connects the records: rules must operate both when they help a leader and when they prevent him doing what he wants.

title.ht: Déus Deronneth ak Marc-Arthur Drouillard: yon rezilta pa tout istwa yon eleksyon
title.en: Déus Deronneth vs Marc-Arthur Drouillard: a result is not the whole election story

description.ht: Youn te jwenn yon chanjman rezilta apre kontestasyon. Lòt la te anonse retrè li pou soutni Jovenel Moïse. Se de zak diferan pou egzamine nan dosye yo.
description.en: One obtained a changed result after challenges. The other announced withdrawal to support Jovenel Moïse. These are different political acts to examine.

text.ht: Yon lis vòt ka kache jan yon kandida te rive nan pozisyon li. Nan dosye 2016 yo, Déus Deronneth ak Marc-Arthur Drouillard montre poukisa fòk nou li desizyon ak alyans ki vini ansanm ak chif yo.
text.en: A vote table can obscure how a candidate reached his position. Déus Deronneth’s and Marc-Arthur Drouillard’s 2016 records show why decisions and alliances must be read alongside totals.

text.ht: Rapò obsèvatè Inyon Ewopeyen yo di egzamen 34 kontestasyon lejislatif te chanje yon sèl rezilta depite: Marigo. Rezo Nòdwès te rapòte an Janvye 2017 desizyon final la bay Deronneth, ki te kandida PONT, viktwa sou Dieudonné Lhérisson, ki te devan nan rezilta preliminè yo. Atik la pa kopi jijman elektoral la.
text.en: The EU observers’ report says examination of 34 legislative challenges reversed one deputy result: Marigot. In January 2017, Rezo Nòdwès reported that the final decision gave PONT candidate Deronneth victory over Dieudonné Lhérisson, who led in preliminary results. The article is not the electoral judgment itself.

text.ht: Pou Drouillard, menm rapò Inyon Ewopeyen an note retrè li an favè Jovenel Moïse 27 Septanm 2016. Anèks rezilta pwovizwa yo bay Drouillard 978 vòt. De enfòmasyon yo ka mache ansanm: anonse retrè pa otomatikman retire yon non nan tout materyèl elektoral oswa anpeche moun vote pou li.
text.en: For Drouillard, the same EU report records his September 27, 2016 withdrawal in favour of Jovenel Moïse. Its provisional-results annex gives Drouillard 978 votes. Both can be true: announcing withdrawal does not automatically remove a name from every electoral material or prevent votes for it.

text.ht: Deronneth bezwen esplike dosye ak règ ki te chanje rezilta a. Drouillard bezwen esplike chwa soutni Moïse a ak fason li evalye l apre sa. Lè yon kandida genyen yon kontestasyon, sa pa otomatikman prèv fwod; soutni yon kandida pa prèv patisipasyon nan zak lòt moun fè pita. Nou pa sèvi ak 978 vòt pwovizwa yo pou mezire sipò Drouillard genyen jodi a.
text.en: Deronneth’s record calls for the documents and rules that changed the result. Drouillard’s calls for an account of his endorsement and how he assesses it afterward. Winning a challenge is not automatically proof of fraud; endorsing a candidate is not participation in others’ later acts. The provisional 978 votes do not measure Drouillard’s support today.

text.ht: Konparezon an se sou fason yo antre nan konpetisyon ak aksepte règ li yo. Elektè bezwen desizyon ki aksesib ak alyans ki gen dat, pou yo pa pran yon chif pou tout yon karyè.
text.en: The comparison concerns how they compete and accept the contest’s rules. Voters need accessible decisions and dated alliances so a single figure does not stand in for an entire career.

title.ht: Gandhy Dorfeuille ak Joanas Gué: apre seremoni an, èske sèvis la dire?
title.en: Gandhy Dorfeuille vs Joanas Gué: after the launch, does the service last?

description.ht: Elektrisite ak irigasyon pa menm sèvis. Yo pataje yon egzamen: konekte lajan, travay ki fèt ak antretyen moun bezwen apre sa.
description.en: Electricity and irrigation are different services. Both require tracing money through completed work to the maintenance people need afterward.

text.ht: Yon liy elektrik bezwen bay kouran. Yon kanal bezwen pote dlo lè plant yo bezwen li. Dosye Gandhy Dorfeuille ak Joanas Gué mande pou nou gade sa ki rete apre yon travay anonse oswa inogire.
text.en: An electricity line needs to deliver power. A canal needs to carry water when crops need it. Gandhy Dorfeuille’s and Joanas Gué’s records call for examining what remains after work is announced or inaugurated.

text.ht: Nan yon atik 22 Avril 2014, Le Nouvelliste dekri dezyèm faz elektrifikasyon Senlwi Disid, avèk depite Dorfeuille. Ekstrè piblik la bay yon bidjè 24 milyon goud finanse nan Trezò, ak 18 milyon ki te deja disponib. Diferans sis milyon an pa prèv lajan disparèt: bidjè, lajan disponib ak depans ki fèt se mezi diferan.
text.en: An April 22, 2014 Le Nouvelliste report describes a second electrification phase in Saint-Louis du Sud involving deputy Dorfeuille. The public excerpt gives a Treasury-funded budget of 24 million gourdes, with 18 million already available. The six-million difference is not proof of missing money: a budget, available funds and executed expenditure are different measures.

text.ht: Pou Gué, Métropole rapòte 7 Janvye 2009 deklarasyon li kòm minis Agrikilti: fon ijans te sèvi pou repare 115 sistèm irigasyon apre siklòn 2008 yo. Se kont minis la bay; se pa odit pa nou sou chak sistèm. Kantite reparasyon an pa bay kantite rekòt ki te pwoteje pandan ane apre yo.
text.en: For Gué, Métropole reported his January 7, 2009 statement as agriculture minister that emergency funds had repaired 115 irrigation systems after the 2008 hurricanes. This is his account, not our audit of each system. A repair total does not establish harvests protected in subsequent years.

text.ht: Nou pa kapab klase de travay sa yo ak yon sèl chif. Ane yo, pòs yo ak sèvis yo diferan. Pou Dorfeuille, nou bezwen resepsyon travay, koneksyon ki te antre an sèvis ak dire sèvis la. Pou Gué, nou bezwen kote 115 sistèm yo ye, sa yo repare ak responsab antretyen yo. Nan toude, kontra ak peman dwe konekte ak yon sèvis moun kapab verifye.
text.en: A single figure cannot rank the two records. Years, roles and services differ. For Dorfeuille, assessment needs completion records, connections entering service and duration of supply. For Gué, it needs the 115 systems’ locations, repairs and maintenance responsibilities. In both, contracts and payments must connect to a service people can verify.

text.ht: Yon pann jodi a pa pwouve yon travay ansyen pa t fèt: lòt dezas ak lòt administrasyon kapab pase apre. Men eksperyans yon kandida dwe ede l esplike kijan pwochen pwojè a pral kontinye sèvi piblik la. Antretyen se yon pati nan pwomès la, menm si li fè mwens foto pase yon inogirasyon.
text.en: A failure today does not prove earlier work never occurred: later disasters and administrations can intervene. A candidate’s experience should nevertheless explain how the next project will keep serving the public. Maintenance belongs in the promise, even when it produces fewer photographs than an inauguration.

title.ht: Jude Elie ak Wilner Joseph: non yon enstitisyon pa esplike wòl yon moun
title.en: Jude Elie vs Wilner Joseph: an institution’s name does not explain a person’s role

description.ht: Yon tablo NYCHA ak yon rapò sou yon konseye gouvènman bay de pwen depa. Fòk nou separe pòs, dat ak rezilta anvan nou evalye eksperyans yo.
description.en: A NYCHA chart and a report identifying a government adviser provide two starting points. Roles, dates and outcomes need separating before experience can be assessed.

text.ht: Lè yon kandida site yon gwo enstitisyon, elektè bezwen konnen sa moun nan te fè ladan l. Dosye Jude Elie ak Wilner Joseph fè nou egzamine travay presi, san fè tout reyalizasyon yon administrasyon tounen reyalizasyon yon sèl moun.
text.en: When a candidate cites a major institution, voters need to know what the person did there. Jude Elie’s and Wilner Joseph’s records call for specific responsibilities, without turning an entire administration’s achievements into one individual’s record.

text.ht: Nan yon tablo òganizasyon 2018 sou sit Vil Nouyòk la, non Jude Elie parèt pami twa planifikatè «A/E» nan ekip planifikasyon kapital NYCHA, anba responsab bezwen fizik yo. Nou te verifye plasman sa a vizyèlman. Sa konfime yon wòl ekip nan dat la, pa direksyon tout ajans lan, travay aktyèl li oswa yon evalyasyon pèfòmans li.
text.en: A 2018 organization chart on New York City’s website places Jude Elie among three “A/E Planners” in NYCHA capital planning, under the Physical Needs Manager. We checked that placement visually. It confirms a team role at that time, not leadership of the entire agency, current employment or a performance evaluation.

text.ht: Vant Bèf Info, nan rapò 16 Septanm 2026 sou enskripsyon Wilner Joseph anba VIKTWA, idantifye l kòm konseye espesyal Premye minis la. Nou pa pran rapò sa a kòm prèv salè oswa fonksyon li genyen jodi a. Li bay yon wòl rapòte nan yon dat presi, ki pèmèt egzamine kijan travay gouvènman ak aktivite elektoral te rete separe.
text.en: Vant Bèf Info’s September 16, 2026 report on Wilner Joseph’s registration under VIKTWA identifies him as the prime minister’s special adviser. We do not treat that report as verification of his current payroll or role. It supplies a dated reported position from which to examine the separation of government work and electoral activity.

text.ht: Sa yo pa de tit ki sou yon menm echèl. NYCHA se yon otorite lojman nan Nouyòk; yon konseye Premye minis la nan yon lòt estrikti politik. Pou Elie, dosye itil yo se pwojè, responsablite desizyon ak rezilta. Pou Joseph, yo se manda konseye a, travay li te livre ak règ sou itilizasyon resous piblik pandan kanpay. Yon tit pa bay repons sa yo poukont li.
text.en: These are not two titles on a common ladder. NYCHA is a New York housing authority; a prime minister’s adviser works in a different political structure. Useful records for Elie concern projects, decision responsibilities and outcomes. For Joseph, they concern the adviser’s mandate, work delivered and rules on public resources during a campaign. A title does not supply those answers by itself.

text.ht: Konparezon an pa deklare youn pi wo pase lòt la. Li mande menm disiplin nan men toude: montre sa w te responsab fè, sa w te gen dwa deside ak sa piblik la ka verifye apre sa.
text.en: The comparison does not rank one above the other. It requires the same discipline from both: establish assigned responsibilities, actual decision authority and what the public can verify afterward.

title.ht: Walsonn Sanon ak Clarens Renois: refize yon pak, siyen yon lòt
title.en: Walsonn Sanon vs Clarens Renois: rejecting one pact, signing another

description.ht: Se pa menm akò a ni menm ane a. De pozisyon yo pèmèt egzamine kiyès ki patisipe nan desizyon tranzisyon yo ak kijan lidè yo rann kont.
description.en: The agreements and years differ. Their positions allow scrutiny of participation in transitional decisions and how leaders account for those choices.

text.ht: Siyen yon akò pa sifi pou fè l lejitim pou tout moun; refize yon akò pa otomatikman yon refi dyalòg. Dosye Walsonn Sanon ak Clarens Renois montre poukisa fòk nou li kondisyon yon pozisyon politik, pa sèlman foto siyati yo.
text.en: Signing an agreement does not establish legitimacy for everyone; rejecting one does not automatically reject dialogue. Walsonn Sanon’s and Clarens Renois’s records show why a political position’s conditions matter alongside photographs of signatures.

text.ht: Nan entèvyou Scoop FM te rapòte 27 Desanm 2022, Sanon, lidè SOLID lè sa a, te rejte akò 21 Desanm nan. Li di yo te pwomèt fè chanjman pou reponn ak rezèv òganizasyon li te fè yo, men li te aprann sou rezo sosyal yo siyati a t ap fèt. Li te kritike fason yo chwazi Mirlande Manigat nan Wo Konsèy Tranzisyon an tou. Sa se kont li bay sou pwosesis la.
text.en: In Scoop FM’s December 27, 2022 interview, Sanon, then SOLID’s leader, rejected the December 21 agreement. He said his organization’s reservations had received promises of revision, but he learned through social media that signing would proceed. He also criticized Mirlande Manigat’s selection in the High Transition Council. This is his account of the process.

text.ht: Renois parèt kòm siyatè yon lòt pak: akò politik Avril 2024 la, pou Kolektif Pati Politik 30 Janvye 2023 a. Edgard Leblanc Fils, pa Renois, te reprezantan kolektif la nan Konsèy Prezidansyèl Tranzisyon an. Pak sa a te bay sekirite, refòm ak eleksyon kòm priyorite, ak mekanis pou suiv aplikasyon l.
text.en: Renois appears as a signatory to a different pact: the April 2024 agreement, for the Collective of Political Parties of January 30, 2023. Edgard Leblanc Fils, not Renois, was its Transitional Presidential Council representative. The pact prioritized security, reform and elections, with implementation-monitoring mechanisms.

text.ht: Wo Konsèy Tranzisyon ki mache ak akò 2022 a pa menm ak Konsèy Prezidansyèl 2024 la. Konpare de dosye yo pa fè Sanon ak Renois pran pozisyon opoze sou yon menm tèks. Siyati Renois pa fè l otè chak desizyon konsèy la; kritik Sanon pa pwouve pwòp pati li ouvè devan tout manm li.
text.en: The High Transition Council associated with the 2022 agreement differs from the 2024 Presidential Council. Comparing these records does not place Sanon and Renois on opposing sides of one text. Renois’s signature does not make him the author of every council decision; Sanon’s criticism does not prove his own party is open to all its members.

text.ht: Egzamen ki komen an se règ patisipasyon: kiyès ki chwazi reprezantan yo, kijan yon dezakò anrejistre ak kiyès ki ka mande eksplikasyon apre yon echèk? Toude ka montre sa yo te mande pou tranzisyon an ak sa yo pratike nan pwòp òganizasyon yo. Se konsa konsansis ka vin yon pwosesis sitwayen ka suiv, olye li rete yon mo lidè itilize sèlman.
text.en: The common test concerns participation: who selects representatives, how disagreement is recorded and who can demand explanations after failure. Both can show what they required of the transition and what their own organizations practise. That lets consensus become a process citizens can follow rather than a word leaders invoke.

title.ht: Martine Moïse ak Claude Joseph: menm asasina, wòl jidisyè diferan
title.en: Martine Moïse vs Claude Joseph: one killing, different judicial roles

description.ht: Yon sivivan ak yon ansyen Premye minis parèt nan diferan etap jidisyè. Enskripsyon yo nan eleksyon pa ni efase dosye yo ni bay yon vèdik sou yo.
description.en: A survivor and a former prime minister appear at different judicial stages. Election registration neither erases those records nor supplies a verdict on them.

text.ht: Martine Moïse ak Claude Joseph parèt nan ras prezidansyèl la, men non yo nan dosye asasina Jovenel Moïse a pa bay yo menm wòl. Pou yon elektè konprann, fòk nou mete fonksyon, akizasyon ak desizyon nan lòd yo.
text.en: Martine Moïse and Claude Joseph appear in the presidential race, but their names in the Jovenel Moïse assassination record do not give them identical roles. Voters need responsibilities, allegations and decisions placed in sequence.

text.ht: Kominike Depatman Jistis ameriken an sou vèdik 8 Me 2026 la dekri Martine kòm Premyè dam ki te blese grav pandan atak 7 Jiyè 2021 an. Kominike Depatman Deta pou jou asasina a idantifye Joseph kòm Premye minis enterimè. Blesi yon sivivan ak responsablite yon chèf gouvènman se de pwen depa diferan. AP rapòte Martine Moïse te temwaye nan pwosè kat gason nan Miami an Mas 2026.
text.en: The U.S. Justice Department’s May 8, 2026 verdict statement describes Martine as the first lady seriously wounded during the July 7, 2021 attack. The State Department’s statement on the assassination date identifies Joseph as acting prime minister. A survivor’s injuries and a government leader’s responsibilities are different starting points. AP reported her testimony at four men’s Miami trial in March 2026.

text.ht: Vant Bèf Info rapòte ansyen òdonans 2024 la te voye toude devan tribinal kriminèl pou akizasyon konplisite. Men menm sous la rapòte Koudapèl Pòtoprens te anile òdonans lan 13 Oktòb 2025 epi mande yon nouvo enstriksyon. Rapò BINUH pou Jiyè–Septanm 2026 konfime odyans nan ankèt siplemantè a te kontinye an Jiyè ak Out.
text.en: Vant Bèf Info reports that the earlier 2024 order referred both for criminal trial over alleged complicity. The same source reports that the Port-au-Prince appeals court annulled that order on October 13, 2025 and required renewed investigation. BINUH’s July–September 2026 report confirms further hearings in the supplementary inquiry during July and August.

text.ht: Sa anpeche de rakousi: repete ansyen òdonans lan san anilasyon an, oswa rele anilasyon an yon akitman apre pwosè. Ozetazini, vèdik 8 Me a konsène Arcangel Pretel Ortiz, Antonio Intriago, Walter Veintemilla ak James Solages. Se pa yon kondanasyon Martine Moïse oswa Claude Joseph. Yon dosye ki gen plizyè akize pa fè koupabilite pase soti nan youn ale sou lòt.
text.en: That prevents two shortcuts: repeating the old order without its annulment, or treating annulment as acquittal after trial. In the United States, the May 8 verdict concerns Arcangel Pretel Ortiz, Antonio Intriago, Walter Veintemilla and James Solages. It is not a conviction of Martine Moïse or Claude Joseph. A multi-defendant case does not transfer guilt from one person to another.

text.ht: Nou pa pretann rezime tout transkripsyon ak desizyon yo. Enskripsyon eleksyon an pa tranche ankèt la nonplis. Egzamen politik la dwe suiv zak piblik chak kandida ak pwogram li; egzamen penal la bezwen prèv ak desizyon ki konsène moun nan presizeman. San separasyon sa a, yon elektè ka konfonn yon non ki site ak yon vèdik.
text.en: This does not summarize every transcript and decision. Registration does not settle the inquiry either. Political scrutiny should follow each candidate’s public acts and programme; criminal scrutiny requires evidence and decisions about that specific person. Without that distinction, voters can mistake a mentioned name for a verdict.

title.ht: Michel Martelly ak Etzer Emile: suiv lajan lekòl la jouk nan klas la
title.en: Michel Martelly vs Etzer Emile: follow school money into the classroom

description.ht: Yon dosye sou frè transfè ak de objektif bidjè montre poukisa lajan kolekte, lajan otorize ak lajan depanse pa menm bagay.
description.en: A transfer-fee record and two budget targets show why money collected, authorized and spent must remain distinct.

text.ht: Yon paran bezwen yon klas ki ouvè ak yon pwofesè ki la. Chif finansman yo itil si yo esplike kijan sèvis sa a rive sou timoun nan. Se sou chimen sa a dosye Michel Martelly ak pwopozisyon Etzer Emile ka konpare.
text.en: A parent needs an open classroom and a teacher present. Funding figures help when they explain how that service reaches a child. That chain provides a way to compare Michel Martelly’s record with Etzer Emile’s proposals.

text.ht: Sou Martelly, BRH konfime yon frè 1.50 dola ameriken sou transfè lajan, ki antre an vigè 1 Jen 2011. Yon desizyon yon tribinal ameriken te pran an 2023 rakonte pwomès finansman edikasyon an. Rapò Kou Siperyè Kont la anrejistre, pou 2011–2018, anviwon 120 milyon dola kolekte atravè BRH ak prèske 118 milyon transfere nan Trezò.
text.en: Under Martelly, the central bank confirms a US$1.50 transfer fee effective June 1, 2011. A 2023 U.S. court decision recounts the education-funding promise. The audit court’s report records about US$120 million collected through the central bank and nearly US$118 million transferred to the Treasury during 2011–2018.

text.ht: Peryòd sa a depase prezidans Martelly. Tablo a konsève anviwon 2.37 milyon dola kòm rès nan fen peryòd la; li pa rele montan sa a lajan disparèt. Pou evalye pwomès lekòl la, fòk kont resèt sa yo konekte ak depans, lekòl ak timoun ki te benefisye yo. Yon antre nan Trezò se yon etap nan chimen an.
text.en: That period extends beyond Martelly’s presidency. The table records about US$2.37 million remaining at its end; it does not call that missing money. Assessing the school promise requires connecting those receipts to spending, schools and children served. A Treasury entry is one step in the chain.

text.ht: Emile prezante yon lòt kalite chif: edikasyon ta resevwa 16 pousan depans piblik ki egzekite an 2029 ak 22 pousan bidjè nasyonal la an 2033. Premye mezi a se depans ki fèt; dezyèm nan se bidjè a. Nou pa ka fè diferans sis pwen an tounen yon amelyorasyon ki deja mezire. Se objektif kanpay, sou de baz diferan.
text.en: Emile offers a different kind of figure: education would receive 16 percent of public spending executed in 2029 and 22 percent of the national budget in 2033. The first measures actual spending; the second concerns the budget. The six-point difference cannot be treated as a measured improvement. These are campaign targets on different bases.

text.ht: Diferans lan se ant yon mekanis resèt ki te antre an pratik ak yon pwopozisyon sou plas edikasyon nan depans Leta. Egzamen ki mare yo ansanm lan senp: konbyen ki antre, konbyen ki otorize, konbyen ki peye epi ki sèvis timoun yo resevwa? Menm tablo anyèl sa a ta pèmèt yon paran konpare yon ansyen pwomès ak yon nouvo pwogram san konfonn lajan ki pase nan kont ak ansèyman ki fèt.
text.en: The difference is between a revenue mechanism put into practice and a proposal for education’s share of state expenditure. Their common test is simple: how much comes in, is authorized, is paid and reaches children as services? The same annual table would let a parent compare a past promise with a new programme without mistaking money moving through accounts for teaching delivered.

title.ht: Etzer Emile ak Olivier Barrau: apre yon pèt, kiyès ki pote chay la?
title.en: Etzer Emile vs Olivier Barrau: after a loss, who carries the cost?

description.ht: Yon prè ede kòmanse oswa elaji yon aktivite. Yon asirans ka ede apre yon chòk. Konpare dosye yo mande pou nou suiv risk la, pa sèlman lajan ki anonse a.
description.en: A loan can start or expand an activity. Insurance can help after a shock. Comparing these records means following risk as well as announced money.

text.ht: Ann pran yon ti biznis kòm egzanp: li resevwa yon prè, achte ekipman, epi yon katastwòf anpeche l travay. Lajan prè a te ede l kòmanse; sa pa esplike kijan li pral peye apre pèt la. Se de moman sa yo pwopozisyon Etzer Emile ak eksperyans asirans Olivier Barrau pèmèt nou egzamine.
text.en: Consider a hypothetical small business: it borrows, buys equipment, then a disaster stops it operating. The loan helped it start; that does not explain repayment after the loss. Those two moments provide a way to examine Etzer Emile’s proposals and Olivier Barrau’s insurance experience.

text.ht: Kanpay Emile la pwopoze prè san enterè pou 5,000 pwojè, yon milyon goud pou chak, ak yon fon garanti nan premye 100 jou yo. Valè prè sa yo fè senk milya goud. Yon garanti ka fasilite kredi, men fòk règ yo di ki pati pèt la bank, Leta ak moun ki prete a ap pote.
text.en: Emile’s campaign proposes interest-free loans of one million gourdes each for 5,000 projects, alongside a guarantee fund in the first 100 days. That gives five billion gourdes in loan value. A guarantee can facilitate lending, but rules must specify the losses borne by bank, state and borrower.

text.ht: Nan yon lòt dosye, PAM rapòte yon pilòt asirans AIC ak patnè li yo te lanse an 2022 pou 4,990 ti eksplwatè agrikòl nan 11 komin. Rapò AIC a idantifye Barrau kòm prezidan konsèy administrasyon nan ane sa a. Pwoteksyon an te depann de mezi lapli, ak yon maksimòm anviwon 900 dola ameriken pa moun, separe ant twòp lapli ak mank lapli.
text.en: In a separate record, WFP reports a 2022 insurance pilot launched with AIC and other partners for 4,990 smallholders in 11 communes. AIC’s report identifies Barrau as board president that year. Coverage depended on rainfall measures, with a maximum of about US$900 per farmer divided between excess rainfall and rainfall deficit.

text.ht: Sa pa yon sèl pwogram ni de pwomès kanpay ki menm jan. Dosye AIC a se yon aktivite konpayi ki dokimante; li pa poukont li pwogram prezidansyèl Barrau. Plafon 900 dola a pa yon peman tout patisipan resevwa. IFC esplike yon risk nan kalite asirans sa a: mezi ki deklanche peman an ka pa koresponn ak pèt reyèl yon moun.
text.en: These are separate programmes and different kinds of record. AIC’s activity does not, by itself, constitute Barrau’s presidential programme. The US$900 ceiling is not a payment received by every participant. IFC explains a risk in this insurance design: the payment trigger may not match an individual’s actual loss.

text.ht: Leson konparezon an se konekte finansman ak pwoteksyon. Pou Emile, garanti a bezwen yon règ klè sou sa ki rive lè yon pwojè pa ka remèt lajan an. Pou egzamine eksperyans Barrau a, bezwen gen done sou peman, delè ak pèt ki pa kouvri. Bay yon moun aksè ak lajan se yon etap; ede aktivite li kenbe apre yon chòk se yon lòt.
text.en: The comparison connects financing to protection. Emile’s guarantee needs clear rules for projects unable to repay. Assessing Barrau’s experience needs payouts, delays and uncovered losses. Access to money is one step; helping an activity survive a shock is another.

title.ht: Etzer Emile ak Jerry Tardieu: kiyès ki chwazi wout la, kiyès ki okipe antretyen li?
title.en: Etzer Emile vs Jerry Tardieu: who chooses the road, and who maintains it?

description.ht: Yon gwo plan envestisman ak yon deba sou pouvwa depatman yo rive sou menm kesyon: kijan yon desizyon nasyonal sèvi yon komin pandan lontan?
description.en: A large investment plan and a debate over departmental power meet at one question: how does a national decision keep serving a commune?

text.ht: Yon wout pa konnen ki pati majistra a oswa prezidan an ye. Men chwa kote pou konstwi l, lajan antretyen ak responsablite lè li kraze se desizyon politik. Se la pwogram enfrastrikti Etzer Emile ak pozisyon Jerry Tardieu sou òganizasyon Leta a rankontre.
text.en: A road does not know the mayor’s or president’s party. But choosing its location, paying for maintenance and answering when it fails are political decisions. That is where Etzer Emile’s infrastructure programme meets Jerry Tardieu’s position on state organization.

text.ht: Kanpay Emile la bay enfrastrikti 15 milya dola ameriken nan yon pwogram 30 milya. Li pwopoze reyabilite wout epi pwoteje yon liy antretyen sou plizyè ane pou chak enfrastrikti livre. Li anonse tou etid pwojè, pri referans ak yon tablo piblik sou avansman chantye. Se angajman kanpay, pa kontra nou verifye finanse.
text.en: Emile’s campaign assigns infrastructure US$15 billion within a US$30 billion programme. It proposes rehabilitating roads and protecting a multiyear maintenance line for each completed infrastructure project. It also promises project studies, reference prices and a public construction dashboard. These are campaign commitments, not verified funded contracts.

text.ht: An Me 2025, Tardieu te kritike lide gouvènè depatmantal nan avanpwojè Konstitisyon an. Juno7 rapòte li te pè konfli ak prezidan an, depans administrasyon ak diferans ant depatman rich ak depatman pòv. Li te defann yon Leta initè. Se pozisyon li te pran nan deba sa a, pa prèv yon nouvo Konstitisyon te antre an vigè.
text.en: In May 2025, Tardieu criticized proposed departmental governors. Juno7 reports his concerns about presidential rivalry, administrative costs and inequalities between richer and poorer departments. He defended a unitary state. That records his position in the debate, not the entry into force of a new constitution.

text.ht: Tèks avanpwojè a merite li tou: atik 68-6 mande kolaborasyon ak administrasyon santral sou plan devlopman, epi 68-8 mande rann kont ak rapò. Nou pa ka prezante otonomi ki pwopoze a kòm absans tout kontwòl. Men egzistans yon règ pa pwouve resous ak kontwòl yo ta mache nan pratik.
text.en: The draft also warrants reading: article 68-6 requires collaboration with central government on development plans, and 68-8 requires accountability and reporting. Proposed autonomy cannot simply be described as an absence of oversight. A written rule, however, does not establish that funding and scrutiny would work in practice.

text.ht: Pou yon komin, de kesyon yo mache ansanm. Yon plan Emile bezwen presize kiyès ki chwazi priyorite lokal yo ak kiyès ki reponn pou antretyen. Pozisyon Tardieu a bezwen esplike kijan yon sant desizyon nasyonal ap sèvi zòn ki gen mwens resous. Konparezon an deplase deba a soti nan gwosè bidjè ak non sistèm nan pou rive sou desizyon yon sitwayen ka suiv.
text.en: For a commune, the questions belong together. Emile’s plan needs to identify who sets local priorities and answers for maintenance. Tardieu’s position needs to explain how a national decision centre would serve places with fewer resources. The comparison moves from budget size and system labels to decisions citizens can follow.

title.ht: Muscadin ak Martelly: pwoteksyon piblik bezwen repons sou itilizasyon pouvwa
title.en: Jean Ernest Muscadin vs Michel Martelly: public protection needs answers about power

description.ht: Rapò Nasyonzini sou yon komisè ak sanksyon ameriken kont yon ansyen prezidan pa menm kalite dosye. Yo mande de chemen prèv diferan, ak menm egzijans presizyon an.
description.en: A UN report about a prosecutor and U.S. sanctions against a former president are different records. They require distinct evidentiary paths and the same precision.

text.ht: Lè yon dirijan rele tèt li yon pwoteksyon kont ensekirite, fòk piblik la kapab egzamine fason li sèvi ak pouvwa. Dosye Jean Ernest Muscadin ak Michel Martelly poze kesyon sa a nan de sans diferan: itilizasyon fòs Leta ak enfliyans sou rezo vyolan.
text.en: When a leader presents himself as protection against insecurity, the public must be able to examine his use of power. Jean Ernest Muscadin’s and Michel Martelly’s records raise that question in different ways: state force and influence over violent networks.

text.ht: Nan rapò Avril–Jen 2026 li a, BINUH site posib patisipasyon Muscadin nan omwen 76 egzekisyon san pwosè dokimante pou 2022–2025. Li di pa t gen pouswit jidisyè ki te kòmanse kont li pou sa. Se pa 76 moun ki mouri nan twa mwa rapò a, ni yon jijman penal sou komisè a.
text.en: BINUH’s April–June 2026 report cites Muscadin’s possible involvement in at least 76 summary executions documented for 2022–2025, saying no judicial proceedings had begun against him for them. That is neither a three-month death toll nor a criminal judgment against the prosecutor.

text.ht: Pou Martelly, Trezò ameriken te anonse sanksyon 20 Out 2024 sou baz akizasyon trafik dwòg, blanchiman ak patwonaj gang. Desizyon an entèdi kredi nan men enstitisyon finansye ameriken, sèten tranzaksyon chanj ak envestisman ameriken. Li se yon aksyon administratif sou lis NS-MBS, pa yon vèdik kriminèl oswa yon deklarasyon tout byen li bloke.
text.en: For Martelly, the U.S. Treasury announced sanctions on August 20, 2024 over alleged drug trafficking, money laundering and gang sponsorship. The action restricts U.S. financial-institution credit, certain foreign-exchange transactions and U.S. investment. It is an administrative NS-MBS action, not a criminal verdict or a blanket statement that all assets are frozen.

text.ht: Yon rapò sou vyolasyon ak yon sanksyon finansye pa bay menm dokiman ni menm mwayen pou egzamine yon zak. Pou Muscadin, egzamen an bezwen idantite viktim, sikonstans itilizasyon fòs ak yon ankèt endepandan. Pou Martelly, li bezwen tranzaksyon, entèmedyè ak repons sou zak otorite yo atribye l. Nou pa sipoze gen yon rezo komen ant de kandida yo.
text.en: A violations report and a financial designation do not provide the same records or route to examining conduct. For Muscadin, scrutiny needs victims’ identities, circumstances of force and independent investigation. For Martelly, it needs transactions, intermediaries and responses to the attributed conduct. This comparison establishes no shared network between the candidates.

text.ht: Absans yon kondanasyon pa efase kesyon politik yo; kesyon politik yo pa ranplase yon jijman. Yon elektè kapab mande menm angajman nan men toude: aksepte yon ankèt sou pwòp zak ou ak sou moun ki soutni w. Sekirite ki depann de lwayote pèsonèl san kontwòl endepandan kite sitwayen an san pwoteksyon lè pouvwa a chanje men.
text.en: The absence of a conviction does not erase political questions; political questions do not replace a trial. Voters can seek the same commitment from both: scrutiny of personal conduct and supporters’ conduct. Security depending on personal loyalty without independent checks leaves citizens vulnerable when power changes hands.

title.ht: Claude Joseph ak Etzer Emile: mezi ijans ak kapasite ki dwe rete
title.en: Claude Joseph vs Etzer Emile: emergency powers and capacity that must endure

description.ht: Youn te dirije yon kabinè apre asasina prezidan an. Lòt la pwopoze agrandi lapolis. Konparezon an suiv delè, kontwòl ak sa ki rete apre premye anons la.
description.en: One headed a cabinet after the president’s assassination. The other proposes expanding police. The comparison follows deadlines, oversight and what lasts after the first announcement.

text.ht: Yon operasyon ka reponn ak yon kriz san li pa konstwi sèvis ki rete. Yon rekritman ka ogmante kantite moun san li pa bay yon ekip ki pare. Konpare Claude Joseph ak Etzer Emile sou sekirite mande pou nou suiv tan desizyon an ak tan kapasite a pran pou devlope.
text.en: An operation can respond to a crisis without building a lasting service. Recruitment can increase headcount without producing a prepared unit. Comparing Claude Joseph and Etzer Emile on security requires following the timing of decisions and the time needed to develop capacity.

text.ht: Apre asasina Jovenel Moïse 7 Jiyè 2021, kabinè Claude Joseph t ap dirije a te deklare yon ijans 15 jou, selon rapò Nasyonzini S/2021/828. Mezi yo te gen mobilizasyon fòs sekirite, fouy, arestasyon ak restriksyon sou deplasman. Ariel Henry te pran fonksyon 20 Jiyè; Joseph te rete minis Afè Etranjè.
