text.en: After Jovenel Moïse’s July 7, 2021 assassination, Claude Joseph’s cabinet declared a 15-day emergency, according to UN report S/2021/828. Measures included security-force mobilization, searches, arrests and movement restrictions. Ariel Henry took office July 20; Joseph remained foreign minister.

text.ht: Pwogram Emile la pwopoze pase soti nan anviwon 13,000 polisye operasyonèl rive 26,000 an 2033. Li pwomèt akselere rekritman ak fòmasyon 1,000–2,000 polisye nan premye 100 jou yo, ansanm ak verifikasyon rekrit ak sanksyon pou abi. Chif depa a soti nan kanpay la. Akselere fòmasyon pa vle di tout rekrit fin pare nan jou 100 la.
text.en: Emile’s programme proposes increasing operational police from about 13,000 to 26,000 by 2033, with faster recruitment and training of 1,000–2,000 officers in the first 100 days, screening and sanctions for abuse. The baseline is the campaign’s. Faster training does not mean every recruit would be ready on day 100.

text.ht: De dosye yo montre yon diferans ant bay lòd ak bati yon enstitisyon. Pou desizyon 2021 yo, bezwen gen tras aplikasyon, limit ak kontwòl sou mezi ki touche dwa moun. Pou pwopozisyon Emile la, bezwen gen fòmatè, salè, ekipman ak ajan ki rete nan sèvis. Ni yon deklarasyon ijans ni yon chif rekrit pa mezire pwoteksyon yon katye poukont li.
text.en: The records distinguish issuing orders from building an institution. The 2021 decisions require a record of implementation, limits and oversight of measures affecting rights. Emile’s proposal requires trainers, pay, equipment and officers retained in service. Neither an emergency declaration nor a recruitment figure measures neighbourhood protection by itself.

text.ht: Rapò Nasyonzini an pa valide legalite chak mezi ni etabli Joseph te patisipe nan asasina a. Pwogram kanpay la pa yon rezilta Emile deja reyalize. Pwen pou swiv la se menm chenn nan: yon desizyon ki gen baz, yon ekip ki kapab aji, yon kontwòl endepandan ak sèvis ki kontinye. Se chenn sa a chak kandida dwe kapab esplike.
text.en: The UN report neither validates every measure’s legality nor establishes Joseph’s involvement in the assassination. The campaign programme is not an achievement already delivered by Emile. The common chain is a grounded decision, an operational team, independent oversight and continuing service. Each candidate should be able to explain it.

title.ht: Jerry Tardieu ak Jacky Lumarque: yon bous pa dwe kache kiyès ki peye ak kiyès ki chwazi
title.en: Jerry Tardieu vs Jacky Lumarque: a scholarship must identify who pays and who selects

description.ht: Yo te prezan nan yon lansman bous an 2020. Lyen sa a pa fè tout pwogram yo tounen yon sèl fon oswa tout lajan an tounen yon kado pèsonèl.
description.en: Both attended a 2020 scholarship launch. That connection does not merge the programmes into one fund or make the financing a personal gift.

text.ht: Pou yon elèv ki bezwen yon bous, kesyon an pa sèlman kiyès ki sou foto seremoni an. Li bezwen konnen si li kalifye, kiyès ki chwazi ak ki lajan ki disponib. Dosye Jerry Tardieu ak Jacky Lumarque pèmèt nou suiv diferans ant kontak politik, finansman ak seleksyon.
text.en: For a student seeking a scholarship, the question extends beyond who appears in the ceremony photograph. Eligibility, selection and available funding matter. Jerry Tardieu’s and Jacky Lumarque’s records allow us to distinguish political connections, financing and selection.

text.ht: Sou pwòp sit li, Tardieu te dekri lansman bous ekselans Ayiti–Frans an Desanm 2016. Kont sa a idantifye BRH kòm finansè premye gwoup la epi li rapòte yon angajman pou chwazi sou merit. Sa bay yon sous sou patenarya a; li pa etabli Tardieu te peye bous yo ak pwòp lajan li.
text.en: On his own website, Tardieu described the December 2016 Haiti–France excellence scholarship launch. That account identifies BRH as financier of the first cohort and reports a commitment to merit-based selection. It supplies a partnership record, not proof that Tardieu personally financed the scholarships.

text.ht: Le National rapòte Tardieu ak Lumarque te prezan nan lansman kanpay bous Lafrans 2020–2021 an. Anbasadè José Gomez te site BRH, Fondation Sogebank ak AUF pami patnè yo. Atik la te anonse tou yon nouvo dispozitif bous doktora Anténor Firmin. Plizyè mekanis parèt nan menm seremoni an; sa pa fè yo tout menm akò 2016 la.
text.en: Le National reports that Tardieu and Lumarque attended France’s 2020–2021 scholarship campaign launch. Ambassador José Gomez named BRH, Fondation Sogebank and AUF among partners. The article also announced a new Anténor Firmin doctoral scheme. Several mechanisms appeared at one ceremony; that does not make them all the 2016 agreement.

text.ht: Lumarque gen yon lòt responsablite pou egzamine: Université Quisqueya di li rektè li depi 2007. Sa pa fè chak bous etidyan inivèsite a resevwa yon reyalizasyon pèsonèl li. Menm jan an, inisyativ yon depite pa fè l pwopriyetè resous enstitisyon ki finanse yon pwogram.
text.en: Lumarque has a separate responsibility to examine: Université Quisqueya says he has been its rector since 2007. That does not turn every scholarship received by its students into his personal achievement. Similarly, a deputy’s initiative does not make him the owner of institutional resources funding a programme.

text.ht: Konparezon an mande yon chenn ki klè: finansè, administratè, jiri seleksyon ak benefisyè. Kritè ki pibliye ak rezilta ki verifyab ta pèmèt piblik la bay chak moun kredi pou travay li san kreye yon dèt politik pou elèv la. Nou pa etabli yon echanj bous kont vòt. Nou montre ki dokiman ki ka separe yon opòtinite ouvè ak yon favè yon moun ta reklame kòm byen pa li.
text.en: The comparison requires a clear chain: funder, administrator, selection panel and beneficiaries. Published criteria and verifiable outcomes would let the public credit each contribution without creating a political debt for students. This record establishes no scholarship-for-votes exchange. It identifies the documents distinguishing an open opportunity from a benefit claimed as someone’s personal possession.

title.ht: Olivier Barrau ak Munir Mourra: bank agrikòl la bezwen yon repons lè rekòt la pèdi
title.en: Olivier Barrau vs Munir Mourra: an agricultural bank needs an answer when a harvest fails

description.ht: Kredi, irigasyon ak asirans antre nan menm sezon agrikòl la. Yo pa rezoud menm pwoblèm nan, men règleman sou yo dwe mache ansanm.
description.en: Credit, irrigation and insurance belong to the same farming season. They address different problems, but their rules need to work together.

text.ht: Lè yon rekòt pèdi, yon nouvo prè pa otomatikman efase ansyen dèt la. Se rezon pou li pwopozisyon Munir Mourra sou finansman agrikòl ansanm ak eksperyans asirans konpayi Olivier Barrau a, san fè de mekanis yo tounen youn.
text.en: When a harvest fails, a new loan does not automatically erase old debt. That is why Munir Mourra’s agricultural-financing proposals deserve reading alongside the insurance experience of Olivier Barrau’s company, without treating the mechanisms as identical.

text.ht: Manifès MPH la pwopoze kreye yon bank agrikòl, netwaye kanal irigasyon ak mete sant distribisyon pwodwi agrikòl sou pye nan patenarya piblik-prive. Paj kandida pati a idantifye Munir Joseph Mourra kòm kandida ki pote manifès sa a. Se yon pwopozisyon sou kredi ak kondisyon pwodiksyon, pa yon bank nou verifye deja finanse oswa ouvè.
text.en: The MPH manifesto proposes an agricultural bank, irrigation-channel clearing and agricultural distribution centres through public-private partnerships. The party identifies Munir Joseph Mourra as the candidate carrying the manifesto. These are proposals on credit and production conditions, not a bank verified as funded or operating.

text.ht: An 2022, AIC te patisipe ak PAM, WRMS ak SCOR nan yon pilòt asirans pou 4,990 ti eksplwatè agrikòl. Rapò konpayi an idantifye Barrau kòm prezidan konsèy administrasyon an. PAM bay yon plafon anviwon 900 dola ameriken pou chak agrikiltè, separe ant twòp lapli ak mank lapli. Plafon sa a pa kantite lajan chak moun te resevwa.
text.en: In 2022, AIC participated with WFP, WRMS and SCOR in an insurance pilot for 4,990 smallholders. Its report identifies Barrau as board president. WFP gives a ceiling of about US$900 per farmer divided between excess rainfall and rainfall deficit. That ceiling is not an amount every farmer received.

text.ht: Kredi ede peye semans ak travay anvan vant lan. Irigasyon ka diminye kèk risk sou pwodiksyon. Asirans ka transfere yon pati risk finansye lè kondisyon kontra a reyini. Men yon mezi lapli ka pa mache ak pèt chak jaden; IFC idantifye limit sa a nan asirans ki baze sou yon endis. Twa zouti yo bezwen konekte, san pwomèt yo efase tout pèt.
text.en: Credit pays for inputs before sale. Irrigation can reduce some production risks. Insurance can transfer financial risk when contract conditions are met. But a rainfall measure may not match each field’s loss; IFC identifies that limitation in index insurance. The three tools need connecting without promising to erase every loss.

text.ht: Pou Mourra, bank la bezwen règ sou ranbousman apre yon dezas ak sou kredi ki ale nan men moun ki gen koneksyon politik. Pou egzamine eksperyans Barrau a, bezwen gen done sou peman ak sa asirans lan pa kouvri. Dosye 2022 a pa poukont li pwogram kanpay li. Konparezon an bay yon kesyon komen: èske yon move sezon kite agrikiltè a ak yon chemen pou reprann aktivite, oswa sèlman yon lòt dèt?
text.en: For Mourra, the bank needs rules on disaster repayment and politically connected lending. Assessing Barrau’s experience requires payouts and exclusions. The 2022 pilot is not, by itself, his campaign programme. Their common question is whether a bad season leaves farmers a route to restart, or simply another debt.

title.ht: Clarens Renois ak Junior Salomon: ki kontwòl ki rete lè alye yo sou pouvwa?
title.en: Clarens Renois vs Junior Salomon: what oversight remains when allies hold power?

description.ht: Yon siyati sou pak 2024 la ak yon manifestasyon OPL an 2025 montre poukisa responsablite politik bezwen plis pase etikèt alye oswa opozan.
description.en: A signature on the 2024 pact and an OPL protest in 2025 show why political accountability needs more than ally or opponent labels.

text.ht: Yon lidè ka patisipe nan yon antant san li pa dirije gouvènman ki soti ladan l. Yon manm pati ka manifeste kont yon enstitisyon kote yon lòt moun menm pati a chita. Dosye Clarens Renois ak Jean-Marie Junior Salomon montre de sitiyasyon sa yo.
text.en: A leader can participate in an agreement without running the resulting government. A party member can protest an institution that includes another figure from the same party. Clarens Renois’s and Jean-Marie Junior Salomon’s records illustrate those situations.

text.ht: Siyati Renois parèt sou pak politik Avril 2024 la pou Kolektif Pati Politik 30 Janvye 2023 a. Pak la te bay Edgard Leblanc Fils plas reprezantan kolektif la nan Konsèy Prezidansyèl la. Renois pa t moun sa a. Men siyati li bay yon baz pou egzamine angajman li te soutni ak sa li te fè pou suiv yo.
text.en: Renois’s signature appears on the April 2024 pact for the Collective of Political Parties of January 30, 2023. The pact assigned Edgard Leblanc Fils the collective’s Presidential Council representation. Renois was not that member. His signature nevertheless supplies a basis for examining the commitments he supported and his follow-through.

text.ht: An Jiyè 2025, Rezo Nòdwès rapòte yon manifestasyon anti-CPT Okay ki te enplike Salomon ak manm OPL. Atik la site sitou patisipan Hervé Saintilus, ki te kritike Leblanc, yon lòt figi OPL sou konsèy la. Nou pa bay Salomon tout pawòl Saintilus, ni fè prezans nan manifestasyon an prèv li te koupe tout lyen politik li.
text.en: In July 2025, Rezo Nòdwès reported an anti-CPT demonstration in Les Cayes involving Salomon and OPL members. It chiefly quotes participant Hervé Saintilus, who criticized Leblanc, another OPL figure on the council. We do not assign Saintilus’s every statement to Salomon or treat protest participation as proof of severed political ties.

text.ht: Se la tras desizyon yo vin enpòtan. Pou Renois, li bezwen montre pozisyon li sou angajman pak la ak mekanis kontwòl yo. Pou Salomon, bezwen gen manda ak desizyon pati ki esplike pozisyon li te defann. Yon kolektif pati, yon reprezantan sou konsèy ak tout moun yon pati pa yon sèl aktè.
text.en: That makes decision records important. Renois’s record needs his positions on the pact’s commitments and oversight mechanisms. Salomon’s needs the mandates and party decisions explaining his position. A party collective, its council representative and every individual in a party are not one actor.

text.ht: Konparezon an pa transfere zak Leblanc sou youn nan de kandida yo. Li egzamine kijan yon politisyen rann relasyon li ak pouvwa a vizib: sa li te otorize, sa li te konteste ak sa li te mande kòm repons. Se dokiman sa yo ki ka fè rann kont kontinye menm lè yon alye gen plas nan gouvènman.
text.en: The comparison does not transfer Leblanc’s actions to either candidate. It examines how politicians make their relationship with power visible: what they authorized, challenged and demanded in response. Those records allow accountability to continue when an ally holds a place in government.

title.ht: Dominique Dupuy ak Savannah Savary: menm egzijans presizyon, lajan ki gen règ diferan
title.en: Dominique Dupuy vs Savannah Savary: the same precision, different rules for money

description.ht: Yon desizyon sou depans diplomasi ak yon kont sou antrepriz familyal pa menm bilan. Yo ede esplike ki enfòmasyon piblik la bezwen pou evalye chak kandida.
description.en: A diplomatic-spending decision and an account of family businesses are different records. They help identify what the public needs to assess each candidate.

text.ht: Rann kont pa vle di mande tout moun egzakteman menm papye. Yon minis sèvi ak lajan piblik; yon antreprenè gen enterè prive ki ka vin touche desizyon Leta. Dosye Dominique Dupuy ak Savannah Savary montre kijan egzijans presizyon an rete menm pandan dokiman ki nesesè yo chanje.
text.en: Accountability does not mean demanding exactly the same papers from everyone. A minister uses public resources; an entrepreneur has private interests that may intersect with state decisions. Dominique Dupuy’s and Savannah Savary’s records show how the same requirement for precision can require different documents.

text.ht: An Jiyè 2024, Dupuy te defann rapèl diplomat kòm yon refòm pou adapte depans ak mwayen peyi a. Métropole te rapòte plis pase 80 diplomat ak manm reprezantasyon ta konsène. Minis la pa t pibliye lis la nan entèvansyon sa a; li te mete aksan sou konpetans ak wotasyon, pandan li rejte motif politik oswa klanik.
text.en: In July 2024, Dupuy defended diplomatic recalls as reform to align expenditure with Haiti’s means. Métropole reported that more than 80 diplomats and representation staff were reportedly affected. She did not publish the list during that appearance, emphasizing competence and rotation while rejecting political or factional motives.

text.ht: Savary, nan entèvyou Haitian Times an Oktòb 2026, dekri Distillerie 1928 ak Habitation Robert kòm antrepriz li eritye, ki anplwaye plis pase 100 moun. Li pa t bay detay finansye, poutèt li te pè tounen yon sib. Sa se kont li bay sou biznis yo; nou pa prezante l kòm yon odit sou anplwa, dèt oswa byen li.
text.en: In an October 2026 Haitian Times interview, Savary describes inheriting Distillerie 1928 and Habitation Robert and says they employ more than 100 people. She declined financial details, citing fear of becoming a target. That is her account, not our audit of employment, debt or assets.

text.ht: Pou Dupuy, kantite rapèl pa kantite ekonomi. Egzamen an bezwen depans anvan ak apre, ranplasman ak sèvis konsilè moun resevwa. Pou Savary, kantite anplwaye pa richès pèsonèl; egzamen an bezwen enterè ekonomik ki ka enfliyanse yon desizyon piblik ak règ pou evite sa. Yon risk sekirite pa retire kesyon sa yo, men li mande yon fason responsab pou pibliye enfòmasyon yo.
text.en: For Dupuy, recalls do not measure savings. Assessment needs expenditure before and after, replacements and consular service. For Savary, employment does not measure personal wealth; assessment needs economic interests that could affect public decisions and safeguards against that influence. Security concerns do not erase those questions, but require responsible disclosure.

text.ht: Sa nou pa dwe fè se envante yon ekonomi sou baz yon kantite moun, oswa yon favè Leta sou baz yon biznis familyal. Konparezon an swiv sa chak kandida te gen dwa deside epi ki tras desizyon sa yo kite. Se konsa yon lektè ka egzamine depans piblik ak enterè prive san konfonn yo.
text.en: The comparison must not invent savings from a headcount or state favour from a family business. It follows what each candidate had authority to decide and the records those decisions leave. That lets readers examine public spending and private interests without conflating them.

title.ht: Etzer Emile ak René St-Fort: kiyès ki asire pwofesè a resevwa salè li?
title.en: Etzer Emile vs René St-Fort: who makes sure the teacher gets paid?

description.ht: Yon pwogram komen ak yon pi gwo bidjè ka ede lekòl. Men fòk lajan rive kote pwofesè a ap travay, nan dat li dwe resevwa l.
description.en: A common curriculum and a larger budget can help schools. Money must also reach the teacher, on the date it is due.

text.ht: Ann imajine yon lekòl ki resevwa yon nouvo pwogram leson, men pwofesè li pa resevwa salè. Dokiman an ka bon; pwoblèm sal klas la rete. Se egzanp sa a ki konekte pozisyon René St-Fort sou ansèyman ak angajman Etzer Emile sou finansman edikasyon.
text.en: Imagine a school receiving a new curriculum while its teacher goes unpaid. The document may be good; the classroom problem remains. That example connects René St-Fort’s position on teaching to Etzer Emile’s education-financing commitments.

text.ht: Nan entèvyou Vant Bèf Info 15 Me 2026 la, St-Fort te defann pwogram lekòl komen ak amelyorasyon kalite ansèyman. Li te kritike salè pwofesè ki pa ase epi ki pa rive regilyèman. Entèvyou sa a pa bay yon bidjè oswa yon kalandriye pou korije sitiyasyon an.
text.en: In his May 15, 2026 Vant Bèf Info interview, St-Fort advocated common school curricula and better teaching quality. He criticized inadequate, irregular teachers’ pay. That interview provides neither a budget nor a timetable for correcting the problem.

text.ht: Pwogram Emile la pwomèt salè regilye, fòmasyon ak lojman pou pwofesè nan zòn riral. Li fikse rekritman ak fòmasyon 6,000 pwofesè an 2029, 15,000 an 2033. Se objektif kanpay; yon kantite rekritman anonse pa pwouve Leta kapab peye chak moun chak mwa.
text.en: Emile’s programme promises regular pay, training and rural housing for teachers. It sets recruitment-and-training targets of 6,000 teachers in 2029 and 15,000 in 2033. These are campaign targets; an announced recruitment figure does not establish capacity to pay everyone monthly.

text.ht: Pwogram nan bay edikasyon 16% depans piblik ki fèt toutbon an 2029, epi 22% bidjè nasyonal la an 2033. De pousantaj sa yo pa mezire menm bagay. Yon bidjè otorize depans; depans ki fèt montre sa ki peye. Li pa kòrèk pou li de chif yo kòm yon sèl liy pwogrè san lòt enfòmasyon.
text.en: The programme assigns education 16% of public spending actually executed in 2029, then 22% of the national budget in 2033. Those percentages measure different things. A budget authorizes spending; execution records spending that occurs. They cannot form a single progress line without further information.

text.ht: Se la elektè a ka fè toude presize lide yo: konbyen pwofesè ki sou lis salè, ki reta pou regle an premye, ak ki dat peman pou respekte? Pou Emile, sa teste mwayen ki dèyè chif yo. Pou St-Fort, sa mare kalite leson ak kondisyon moun k ap anseye a. Yon lekòl bezwen toude; yon pi bèl dokiman pa ranplase youn nan yo.
text.en: Voters can ask both for the teacher payroll, the arrears addressed first and the payment dates to meet. For Emile, that tests the means behind the figures. For St-Fort, it connects lesson quality to teachers’ working conditions. A school needs both; a better document cannot replace either.

title.ht: Etzer Emile ak Joanas Gué: achte lokal mande peye pwodiktè a alè
title.en: Etzer Emile vs Joanas Gué: buying local means paying producers on time

description.ht: An 2010, lide sèvi ak achte manje pou soutni pwodiksyon lokal te deja sou tab la. Konparezon an suiv chemen ant kontra, livrezon ak peman.
description.en: Using food purchases to support local production was on the table in 2010. This comparison follows the path from contract to delivery and payment.

text.ht: Pou yon pwodiktè, vann ak Leta ka louvri yon mache. Men si li peye semans, travayè ak transpò anvan li resevwa lajan li, yon gwo kliyan ka kreye yon gwo bezwen kredi tou. Sa se yon pwoblèm pou rezoud nan politik acha lokal, pa yon akizasyon sou yon kontra patikilye.
text.en: Selling to the state can open a market for a producer. But paying for seed, workers and transport before receiving payment can also create a large borrowing need. That is a policy problem for local purchasing, not an allegation about a particular contract.

text.ht: An Mas 2010, apre tranblemanntè a, minis agrikilti Joanas Gué te defann lide dirije plis èd manje nan achte pwodwi ayisyen. Rapò Métropole la dokimante pozisyon li nan epòk la. Li pa pwouve konbyen acha apèl li a te lakòz, ni ki rezilta tout kontra sa yo te bay.
text.en: In March 2010, after the earthquake, agriculture minister Joanas Gué advocated directing more food assistance toward Haitian purchases. Métropole documents his position then. It does not establish how many purchases his appeal caused or all their results.

text.ht: Pwogram Emile la pwopoze acha lokal pou kantin lekòl yo. Nan pati ekonomi an, li pwomèt 30% kontra piblik pou ti antrepriz ayisyen, epi peman founisè Leta yo nan 60 jou ak enterè otomatik pou reta. Se angajman kanpay; nou pa prezante yo kòm règ ki deja aplike.
text.en: Emile proposes local purchasing for school meals. His economic programme promises 30% of public contracts for Haitian small businesses and payment of state suppliers within 60 days, with automatic late-payment interest. These are campaign commitments, not rules presented as already implemented.

text.ht: Gen yon eksperyans pou egzamine san bay youn nan kandida yo kredi otomatik: an Jen 2026, yon responsab PAM rapòte pwogram kantin òganizasyon an te rive nan 650,000 timoun, ak prèske twa ka manje yo ki soti nan pwodiksyon lokal. Se done PAM sou pwòp pwogram li, pa tout kantin peyi a, ni prèv yon lyen dirèk ak apèl Gué an 2010.
text.en: An existing experience deserves examination without automatic credit to either candidate: in June 2026, a WFP official reported its school-meal programme reaching 650,000 children, with nearly three-quarters of meals locally produced. These are WFP’s programme figures, not every Haitian canteen or proof of a direct link to Gué’s 2010 appeal.

text.ht: Kesyon ki ka separe yon lide ak yon mache ki mache se dat yo: kiyès ki siyen lòd acha a, kiyès ki konfime livrezon, epi kilè lajan rive? Dwe gen yon chemen pou ti pwodiktè ki pa gen ase lajan pou tann de mwa. Sinon, yon politik ki fèt pou ede yo ka pi fasil sèvi antrepriz ki deja gen kapital.
text.en: Dates can separate an idea from a functioning market: who signs the order, who confirms delivery and when does payment arrive? Small producers need a route that does not require financing a two-month wait. Otherwise a policy intended to help them may be easier for firms that already have capital to use.

title.ht: Muscadin ak Munir Mourra: yon machin blende pa yon bidjè sekirite
title.en: Jean Ernest Muscadin vs Munir Mourra: an armored vehicle is not a security budget

description.ht: Sitwayen ka achte yon ekipman. Yon Leta bezwen peye itilizasyon li, antretyen li ak kontwòl li pandan plizyè ane. Se de responsablite pou egzamine ansanm.
description.en: Citizens can buy equipment. A state must fund its use, maintenance and oversight for years. Those responsibilities deserve examining together.

text.ht: Yon machin blende ka rive nan yon seremoni. Gaz, reparasyon ak salè moun k ap sèvi avè l ap vini apre. Konpare dosye Jean Ernest Muscadin ak manifès Munir Mourra a mande pou suiv depans sa yo ansanm ak achte ekipman an.
text.en: An armored vehicle can arrive at a ceremony. Fuel, repairs and the wages of those using it follow. Comparing Jean Ernest Muscadin’s record with Munir Mourra’s manifesto means following those costs alongside the equipment purchase.

text.ht: An Mas 2023, jounalis Theriel Thelus te lanse yon apèl pou de machin blende pou Muscadin. An Jen, Juno7 rapòte livrezon yon Nissan Patrol blende. Thelus te bay yon pri total 100,000 dola: 45,000 pou machin nan, 55,000 pou blende li. Se chif li te deklare; nou pa verifye yon fakti oswa kont tout ranmasaj lajan an.
text.en: In March 2023, journalist Theriel Thelus appealed for two armored vehicles for Muscadin. In June, Juno7 reported delivery of one armored Nissan Patrol. Thelus stated a $100,000 total: $45,000 for the vehicle and $55,000 for armor. Those are his figures, not an invoice or full fundraising account audited by us.

text.ht: Manifès MPH kandida Munir Joseph Mourra pote a pwopoze ogmante bidjè lajistis, lapolis ak lame 100%, ansanm ak pwofesyonalizasyon ak ekipman. Sa se yon pwopozisyon nasyonal, pa yon bidjè nou verifye vote oswa egzekite. Double yon bidjè sou papye pa esplike poukont li ki depans ki priyoritè oswa ki sèvis k ap amelyore.
text.en: The MPH manifesto carried by Munir Joseph Mourra proposes increasing justice, police and army budgets by 100%, alongside professionalization and equipment. That is a national proposal, not a verified enacted or executed budget. Doubling a paper budget does not itself identify priority spending or improved services.

text.ht: Muscadin kite pòs komisè li nan yon demisyon minis lajistis la aksepte an Novanm 2026. Sa fè kesyon pwopriyete machin nan pi konkrè: sou non kiyès li ye, epi ki règ ki kontwole itilizasyon li apre depa a? Dosye a pa pwouve kado a te ilegal oswa li finanse kanpay la. Li mande yon envantè ak yon akò itilizasyon.
text.en: Muscadin left his prosecutor’s post in a resignation accepted by the justice minister in November 2026. That makes vehicle ownership concrete: whose name holds the title, and what governs use after departure? The record does not establish an unlawful donation or campaign financing. It calls for an inventory and use agreement.

text.ht: Pou Mourra, kesyon an se kiyès ki peye achte, antretyen ak ranplasman ekipman pandan plizyè ane. Pou Muscadin, se kiyès ki posede ak kontwole sa donatè yo finanse. Yon sèvis piblik dwe kapab kontinye lè yon dirijan kite pòs li. Se tès sa a yon ekipman popilè ak yon gwo pousantaj bidjè dwe pase.
text.en: For Mourra, the question is who funds equipment purchase, maintenance and replacement over years. For Muscadin, it is who owns and controls what donors financed. A public service must continue when a leader leaves office. That is a test for both popular equipment and a large budget percentage.

title.ht: Jerry Tardieu ak Jude Célestin: apre finansman an, ki byen ak ki sèvis ki rete?
title.en: Jerry Tardieu vs Jude Célestin: after the financing, what assets and services remain?

description.ht: Yon otèl prive ak ekipman yon enstitisyon piblik pa menm dosye. Toude montre poukisa chif finansman bezwen mache ak kont sou sa li livre.
description.en: A private hotel and public equipment are different records. Both show why financing figures need accounts of what they delivered.

text.ht: Yon gwo kantite lajan pa yon bilan. Jerry Tardieu ak Jude Célestin gen dosye sou de kalite aktivite diferan: finansman yon otèl prive ak acha ekipman pou yon enstitisyon Leta. Nou pa ka klase yo ak yon sèl chif. Nou kapab egzamine fason pou verifye sa ki rete apre depans yo.
text.en: A large sum is not a performance record. Jerry Tardieu and Jude Célestin have records in different activities: financing a private hotel and purchasing equipment for a state institution. One figure cannot rank them. We can examine how to verify what remains after spending.

text.ht: Rapò anyèl IFC 2011 la idantifye Tardieu kòm chèf egzekitif Oasis Hotel. Li dekri yon prè 7.5 milyon dola ameriken ki te ede atire 15 milyon lòt dola nan men envestisè. Se yon prè ak kapital envestisman, pa yon don kanpay oswa yon deklarasyon richès pèsonèl. Rapò a pa bay kont aktyèl otèl la.
text.en: IFC’s 2011 annual report identifies Tardieu as Oasis Hotel’s chief executive. It describes a US$7.5 million loan helping attract another US$15 million from investors. Those are borrowing and investment capital, not a campaign donation or personal-wealth declaration. The report does not provide the hotel’s current accounts.

text.ht: Rapò komisyon Sena 2016 sou PetroCaribe egzamine ekipman pou CNE, kote li idantifye Célestin kòm responsab nan peryòd la. Li site yon alokasyon 80 milyon dola ameriken. Yon liy kontra bay 81 kamyon sou 100, ak 2,565,000 dola dedui pou kantite ki pa livre a. Rele 19 kamyon sa yo disparèt ta efase koreksyon tablo a fè a.
text.en: The Senate commission’s 2016 PetroCaribe report examines CNE equipment, identifying Célestin as its head during the period. It cites a US$80 million allocation. A contract entry records 81 trucks out of 100, with US$2,565,000 deducted for the undelivered quantity. Calling those 19 trucks missing would erase the table’s adjustment.

text.ht: Men komisyon an soulve yon limit reyèl: li pa t jwenn yon envantè konplè CNE pou evalye tout ekipman yo ak egzistans yo. Se yon ankèt palmantè, pa yon kondanasyon Célestin. Menm jan an, yon rapò finansè sou yon otèl pa yon odit endepandan tout rezilta li yo.
text.en: The commission raises a real limitation: it lacked an exhaustive CNE inventory to assess all the equipment and its existence. This is a parliamentary inquiry, not Célestin’s conviction. Similarly, a financier’s hotel account is not an independent audit of all its outcomes.

text.ht: Pou egzamine eksperyans Tardieu, fòk lajan prete, obligasyon ranbousman ak rezilta antrepriz la separe. Pou Célestin, kontra, peman, idantifikasyon machin ak antretyen dwe konekte. De chemen diferan mennen nan menm egzijans lan: montre sèvis ki soti nan lajan an. Se konsa eksperyans jesyon ka sèvi yon agiman elektoral ki verifyab.
text.en: Assessing Tardieu requires separating borrowing, repayment obligations and business outcomes. For Célestin, contracts, payments, machine identifiers and maintenance must connect. Different paths lead to the same requirement: show the service the money produced. That makes management experience an electoral argument voters can check.

title.ht: Martine Moïse ak Dermalog: siyati ak enfliyans se de kesyon diferan
title.en: Martine Moïse and Dermalog: a signature and influence are different questions

description.ht: Yon kontra kat idantifikasyon, akizasyon sou enfliyans ak yon demanti klè: dosye a mande suiv desizyon yo, san fè yon plent tounen yon kondanasyon.
description.en: An identity-card contract, influence allegations and an explicit denial: following the decisions means keeping a complaint distinct from a conviction.

text.ht: Yon kat idantifikasyon pèmèt yon sitwayen pwouve kiyès li ye. Lè Leta chanje sistèm nan, kesyon an depase non konpayi ki fè kat la: kiyès ki chwazi l, sou ki baz, epi kiyès ki dwe rann kont? Se kesyon sa yo ki bay dosye Dermalog la enpòtans nan egzamen kandidati Martine Moïse.
text.en: An identification card lets a citizen establish who they are. When the state changes the system, the question extends beyond the card-maker’s name: who chose it, on what grounds and who must account for the decision? Those questions make Dermalog relevant to scrutiny of Martine Moïse’s candidacy.

text.ht: Nan rapò 7 Out 2019 yo a, CONHANE, RNDDH, CE-JILAP ak CARDH dekri yon kontra 27.7 milyon dola ameriken. Yo rapòte de avi defavorab Lakou Siperyè Kont yo, an Fevriye ak Avril 2018. Yo rapòte tou pozisyon gouvènman an: mande avi Lakou a te obligatwa, men suiv li pa t obligatwa. Dapre rapò a, Konsèy minis la te otorize direktè ONI a siyen an Avril 2018.
text.en: Their August 7, 2019 report describes a US$27.7 million contract. CONHANE, RNDDH, CE-JILAP and CARDH report unfavorable Court of Accounts opinions in February and April 2018. They also record the government’s position: requesting the court’s opinion was mandatory, following it was not. According to the report, the cabinet authorized ONI’s director to sign in April 2018.

text.ht: Rapò a idantifye minis ak direktè ONI a kòm reprezantan Leta nan kontra a; li pa idantifye Martine kòm siyatè. Li rapòte akizasyon sou enfliyans li nan pwosesis la. Sa yo se de kesyon diferan. Absans yon siyati pa rezoud tout kesyon sou enfliyans; yon akizasyon sou enfliyans pa pwouve li te deside oswa resevwa lajan.
text.en: The report identifies ministers and ONI’s director as state representatives in the contract; it does not identify Martine as a signatory. It relays allegations about her influence in the process. These are different questions. An absent signature does not settle influence; an influence allegation does not establish that she decided or received money.

text.ht: Repons li a dwe parèt nan menm istwa a. Nan demanti HaitiLibre pibliye 10 Desanm 2018 la, biwo premye dam nan te niye li te siyen kontra a oswa sèvi ak enfliyans li pou fè yo siyen l. Biwo a te esplike sou vwayaj ofisyèl li ka rankontre lòt delegasyon ayisyen ki la pou lòt rezon. Nou pa prezante yon rankont kòm prèv yon antant.
text.en: Her response belongs in the same story. In the denial HaitiLibre published December 10, 2018, her office denied that she signed or used her influence to secure the contract. It said official travel could bring encounters with other Haitian delegations there for different reasons. An encounter is not proof of an arrangement.

text.ht: Juno7 rapòte 14 sitwayen te depoze yon plent 19 Out 2019 kont li ak lòt responsab. Yon plent mande lajistis egzamine akizasyon; li pa yon vèdik. Nan dokiman nou egzamine yo, nou pa jwenn yon desizyon final nan dosye sa a. Nou pa gen kopi orijinal kontra siyen an, avi Lakou yo oswa tout dosye gref la nonplis.
text.en: Juno7 reported 14 citizens filing a complaint against her and other officials on August 19, 2019. A complaint asks justice to examine allegations; it is not a verdict. The material reviewed yielded no final decision in this matter. Nor did we obtain the original signed contract, court opinions or complete court file.

text.ht: Sa ki ka fè istwa a avanse se dokiman ki mare yon moun ak yon desizyon: korespondans sou chwa konpayi an, otorizasyon, siyati, ak dosye peman. Kesyon pou Martine se ki wòl egzak li te genyen, si li te genyen youn. Pou lòt otorite yo, se sou ki baz yo te angaje Leta. Se la egzamen an dwe rive, pi lwen pase non fanmi an ak bri politik la.
text.en: The story advances through records linking people to decisions: supplier-selection correspondence, authorizations, signatures and payments. The question for Martine is her precise role, if any. For other officials, it is the basis on which they committed the state. Scrutiny needs to reach those decisions, beyond a family name and political noise.

title.ht: Martine Moïse ak malarya: kisa objektif 2020 a te tounen?
title.en: Martine Moïse and malaria: what became of the 2020 goal?

description.ht: An 2018, li te soutni eliminasyon malarya. Done sante 2025 yo montre maladi a toujou la. Yo louvri yon kesyon sou kontinite politik, san bay yon sèl moun responsablite pou tout rezilta peyi a.
description.en: In 2018, she backed malaria elimination. Health data for 2025 show the disease persisted. They raise a policy-continuity question without assigning one person all national outcomes.

text.ht: An Avril 2018, objektif la te klè: elimine malarya ann Ayiti an 2020. Yon kominike Sant Carter sou Jounen mondyal malarya a mete Martine Moïse bò kote responsab ak patnè sante ki te soutni angajman an. Se yon pati nan dosye piblik li ki merite egzamine, menm jan ak dosye kontwovès yo.
text.en: In April 2018, the goal was clear: eliminate malaria in Haiti by 2020. A Carter Center release on World Malaria Day places Martine Moïse alongside officials and health partners supporting that commitment. This part of her public record deserves examination alongside the controversies.

text.ht: Kominike a pa prezante l sèlman kòm madanm prezidan an. Li idantifye l kòm prezidan mekanis kowòdinasyon nasyonal Fon mondyal kont SIDA, tibèkiloz ak malarya. Wòl sa a enpòtan, men li bezwen byen defini. Fon mondyal esplike komite sa yo kowòdone demann finansman epi siveye sibvansyon; sa pa vle di prezidan komite a jere chak depans oswa dirije tout pwogram sante.
text.en: The release presents her as more than the president’s wife: it identifies her as chair of the Global Fund’s Country Coordinating Mechanism. That role matters and needs defining. The Global Fund describes committees coordinating funding requests and overseeing grants; this does not make the chair manager of every expenditure or director of all health programmes.

text.ht: Tablo MSPP pou 2025 la montre maladi a toujou la: li bay 36,465 nouvo ka konfime. Grandans gen 20,687, Sid gen 12,222. Ansanm, se anviwon nèf ka sou dis nan tablo a. Se ka sistèm nan konfime, pa yon konte tout enfeksyon ki egziste. Chif yo pou 2025, pa pou 2026.
text.en: MSPP’s 2025 table shows malaria still present: it records 36,465 new confirmed cases. Grand’Anse accounts for 20,687 and Sud for 12,222, together about nine in ten of the table’s cases. These are cases the system confirmed, not all existing infections. The figures concern 2025, not 2026.

text.ht: De dokiman sa yo pa pwouve Martine te lakòz ka sa yo, ni yon lajan te detounen. Yo pa pèmèt evalye tout travay pèsonèl li. Anplis, kominike 2018 la mete ministè sante a nan tèt efò Malaria Zero a ak plizyè patnè. Nou pa ka fè tout aktivite patnè yo tounen yon sèl sibvansyon oswa yon sèl desizyon premye dam nan.
text.en: These documents do not establish that Martine caused those cases or that money was diverted. They cannot assess all her individual work. The 2018 release also places the health ministry at the head of the Malaria Zero effort with multiple partners. Their activities cannot be merged into one grant or one first-lady decision.

text.ht: Men yo bay kesyon presi pou yon kandidati: pandan manda li nan komite a, ki rapò siveyans li te resevwa, ki obstak li te idantifye, ki koreksyon li te mande? Repons lan bezwen dat, pwosè-vèbal reyinyon ak rezilta, pa sèlman yon foto seremoni. Pou yon fanmi Grandans, kesyon politik la senp: ki sèvis tès ak tretman ki rete lè seremoni an fini?
text.en: They do yield precise candidacy questions: during her committee tenure, what oversight reports did she receive, what obstacles did she identify and what corrections did she seek? Answers need dates, meeting minutes and outcomes, beyond a ceremony photograph. For a family in Grand’Anse, the political question is simple: what testing and treatment remain when the ceremony ends?
